```
param(
    [switch]$Silent
)

$BasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations"
$ScanPaths = @(
    "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
    "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
)

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower()
}

function Get-TodayExportFiles {
    param([string[]]$Paths)

    $now = Get-Date

    $datePatterns = @(
        $now.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }

    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            continue
        }

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip"
            } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        $results += $files
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([System.IO.FileInfo[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    $group = $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }

    return $group
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo]$ZipFile,
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName

        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = if ($GroupFiles.Count -gt 0) {
        Get-NormalizedBaseName $GroupFiles[0].Name
    } else {
        ""
    }

    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param([string]$BasePath, [string]$Today)

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    $previousFile = Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -File -Filter "*_master-history.md" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    return $previousFile
}

$now = Get-Date
$today = $now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
$todayFolder = Join-Path $BasePath $today
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

$historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
$previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $BasePath -Today $today

$todayExports = Get-TodayExportFiles -Paths $ScanPaths
$latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $todayExports
$importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

$latestImportSource = if ($importSource) { $importSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

$content = @()
$content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
$content += ""
$content += "- Date: $($now.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'))"
$content += "- Last Updated: $($now.ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
$content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
$content += ""

if ($importSource) {
    $content += "- Import Source Type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    if ($importSource.ContainerFile) {
        $content += "- Source Archive: $($importSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
    }
    if ($importSource.ExtractPath) {
        $content += "- Extracted To: $($importSource.ExtractPath)"
    }
    $content += ""
}

$content += "---"
$content += ""

$content += "## Previous Running History"
$content += ""

if ($previousHistory) {
    $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
}
else {
    $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
}

$content += ""
$content += "---"
$content += ""

$content += "## Today's Latest Export"
$content += ""

if ($importSource) {
    $content += "- Source File: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    $content += "- Last Write Time: $($importSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
    $content += "- File Type: $($importSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
    $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $importSource.ContainerFile.Name)"
    $content += ""
    $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    $content += ""

    try {
        $raw = Get-Content -Path $importSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
        $content += $raw
    }
    catch {
        $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += $_.Exception.Message
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
}
else {
    $content += "_No export file for today was found in the scan paths._"
}

$content += ""
$content += "---"
$content += ""
$content += "## New Notes"
$content += ""
$content += "_Add today's notes below._"
$content += ""

Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8

if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $historyFile
}

Write-Host "Updated: $historyFile"
if ($importSource) {
    Write-Host "Imported from: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    Write-Host "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    if ($importSource.ContainerFile) {
        Write-Host "Archive source: $($importSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
    }
}
else {
    Write-Host "No export found for today."
}
```

## Copilot

Yes — now I can see how they work together.

## What the two scripts do

### `Sync-DailyConversationHistory.ps1`
This is the **collector/builder**.
It:
- scans Downloads and backup folders
- finds today’s export files
- may extract a zip
- chooses the best import source
- builds today’s:
  - `yyyy-MM-dd_master-history.md`
- places it in:
  - `H:\AM\DailyConversations\yyyy-MM-dd\`

### `Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1`
This is the **repo sync/push** script.
It:
- copies today’s files into the Git repo
- commits them
- pushes them

---

# Best place to add splitting
The best place is:

## **`Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1`**
Why:
- it already copies the final files into the repo
- splitting should happen on the repo copy, not the source/working copy
- it avoids interfering with the daily master-history build process
- it keeps responsibilities clean:
  - script 1 = build history
  - script 2 = prepare/publish repo artifacts

That is the cleanest design.

---

# One bug I noticed in `Sync-DailyConversationHistory.ps1`
This line is risky:

```powershell
$content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $importSource.ContainerFile.Name)"
```

If `ContainerFile` is `$null` for standalone markdown/json, that can break.

It should really be something like:

```powershell
$detectedVersionSource = if ($importSource.ContainerFile) { $importSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $importSource.ImportFile.Name }
$content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
```

That is unrelated to splitting, but worth fixing.

Maybe just apply the small null-safety fix above.

Add:
- a splitting function
- generation of `*_parts` folders
- split all `.md` files copied into the repo target folder

That gives you:
- same automation as now
- same task scheduler behavior
- plus repo-readable split parts automatically

# Best revised `Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1`
Here is the version I recommend using.

```powershell
param(
    [switch]$Silent
)

$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations"
$RepoPath = "E:\Co-Pilot-Chat-History"
$BranchName = "upload-chat-history"
$ChunkLineCount = 2000

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    # Clear old generated parts so repeated runs stay clean
    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -File -Filter "${baseName}_part_*.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }
}

$today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
$monthFolder = (Get-Date).ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()
$monthFolder = switch -Regex ($monthFolder) {
    '^jan-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jan', 'january' }
    '^feb-' { $monthFolder -replace '^feb', 'february' }
    '^mar-' { $monthFolder -replace '^mar', 'march' }
    '^apr-' { $monthFolder -replace '^apr', 'april' }
    '^may-' { $monthFolder -replace '^may', 'may' }
    '^jun-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jun', 'june' }
    '^jul-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jul', 'july' }
    '^aug-' { $monthFolder -replace '^aug', 'august' }
    '^sep-' { $monthFolder -replace '^sep', 'september' }
    '^oct-' { $monthFolder -replace '^oct', 'october' }
    '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november' }
    '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december' }
    default { $monthFolder }
}

$RepoSubfolder = "${monthFolder}-recovery\$today"
$TodayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
$RepoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $RepoSubfolder

if (-not (Test-Path $TodayFolder)) {
    Write-Host "Today's source folder not found: $TodayFolder"
    exit 1
}

if (-not (Test-Path $RepoPath)) {
    Write-Host "Repo path not found: $RepoPath"
    exit 1
}

Push-Location $RepoPath

try {
    git checkout $BranchName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName"
    }

    git pull origin $BranchName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName"
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RepoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

    # Copy today's master history file
    $masterHistory = Join-Path $TodayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    if (Test-Path $masterHistory) {
        Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $RepoTargetFolder -Force
    }

    # Copy extracted files if they exist
    $ExtractedRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
    if (Test-Path $ExtractedRoot) {
        $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $ExtractedRoot -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt"
            }

        foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $RepoTargetFolder -Force
        }
    }

    # Split all markdown files in the repo target folder into parts
    $markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoTargetFolder -File -Filter *.md -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
        Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $RepoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
    }

    git add $RepoSubfolder

    $status = git status --porcelain
    if (-not $status) {
        Write-Host "No changes to commit."
        exit 0
    }

    $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $today"
    git commit -m $commitMessage
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Git commit failed."
    }

    git push origin $BranchName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Git push failed."
    }

    Write-Host "Synced chat history to repo: $RepoSubfolder"
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}
```

## 2) `Sync-DailyConversationHistory.ps1`

This is your collector/builder script.  
I kept behavior the same, but fixed the null-risk around detected version.

```powershell name=Sync-DailyConversationHistory.ps1
param(
    [switch]$Silent
)

$BasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations"
$ScanPaths = @(
    "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
    "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
)

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower()
}

function Get-TodayExportFiles {
    param([string[]]$Paths)

    $now = Get-Date

    $datePatterns = @(
        $now.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $now.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }

    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            continue
        }

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip"
            } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        $results += $files
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([System.IO.FileInfo[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    $group = $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }

    return $group
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo]$ZipFile,
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [System.IO.FileInfo[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName

        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = if ($GroupFiles.Count -gt 0) {
        Get-NormalizedBaseName $GroupFiles[0].Name
    } else {
        ""
    }

    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param([string]$BasePath, [string]$Today)

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    $previousFile = Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -File -Filter "*_master-history.md" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    return $previousFile
}

$now = Get-Date
$today = $now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
$todayFolder = Join-Path $BasePath $today
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

$historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
$previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $BasePath -Today $today

$todayExports = Get-TodayExportFiles -Paths $ScanPaths
$latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $todayExports
$importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

$latestImportSource = if ($importSource) { $importSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

$content = @()
$content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
$content += ""
$content += "- Date: $($now.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'))"
$content += "- Last Updated: $($now.ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
$content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
$content += ""

if ($importSource) {
    $content += "- Import Source Type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    if ($importSource.ContainerFile) {
        $content += "- Source Archive: $($importSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
    }
    if ($importSource.ExtractPath) {
        $content += "- Extracted To: $($importSource.ExtractPath)"
    }
    $content += ""
}

$content += "---"
$content += ""

$content += "## Previous Running History"
$content += ""

if ($previousHistory) {
    $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
}
else {
    $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
}

$content += ""
$content += "---"
$content += ""

$content += "## Today's Latest Export"
$content += ""

if ($importSource) {
    $detectedVersionSource = if ($importSource.ContainerFile) { $importSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $importSource.ImportFile.Name }

    $content += "- Source File: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    $content += "- Last Write Time: $($importSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
    $content += "- File Type: $($importSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
    $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
    $content += ""
    $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    $content += ""

    try {
        $raw = Get-Content -Path $importSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
        $content += $raw
    }
    catch {
        $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += $_.Exception.Message
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
}
else {
    $content += "_No export file for today was found in the scan paths._"
}

$content += ""
$content += "---"
$content += ""
$content += "## New Notes"
$content += ""
$content += "_Add today's notes below._"
$content += ""

Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8

if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $historyFile
}

Write-Host "Updated: $historyFile"
if ($importSource) {
    Write-Host "Imported from: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    Write-Host "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    if ($importSource.ContainerFile) {
        Write-Host "Archive source: $($importSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
    }
}
else {
    Write-Host "No export found for today."
}
```

## 3) `Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1`

This is the one I updated to also create split `.txt` chunks for all `.md` files copied into the repo folder.

```powershell name=Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1
param(
    [switch]$Silent
)

$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations"
$RepoPath = "E:\Co-Pilot-Chat-History"
$BranchName = "upload-chat-history"
$ChunkLineCount = 2000

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -File -Filter "${baseName}_part_*.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {

    }
}

    '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november' }
    '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december' }
    default { $monthFolder }
}

$RepoSubfolder = "${monthFolder}-recovery\$today"
$TodayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
$RepoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $RepoSubfolder

if (-not (Test-Path $TodayFolder)) {
    Write-Host "Today's source folder not found: $TodayFolder"
    exit 1
}

if (-not (Test-Path $RepoPath)) {
    Write-Host "Repo path not found: $RepoPath"

}

Push-Location $RepoPath

try {

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

    }

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

    }

    $ExtractedRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
    if (Test-Path $ExtractedRoot) {
        $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $ExtractedRoot -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt"
            }

        foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $RepoTargetFolder -Force
        }
    }

    $markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $RepoTargetFolder -File -Filter *.md -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
        Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $RepoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
    }

    git add $RepoSubfolder

    $status = git status --porcelain
    if (-not $status) {
        Write-Host "No changes to commit."
        exit 0
    }

    $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $today"
    git commit -m $commitMessage
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Git commit failed."
    }

    git push origin $BranchName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Git push failed."
    }

    Write-Host "Synced chat history to repo: $RepoSubfolder"
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}
```

---

## What changed
The only functional enhancement is in `Sync-ChatHistoryToRepo.ps1`:

- every `.md` copied into the repo target folder is also split into:
  - `<basename>_parts\<basename>_part_001.txt`
  - `<basename>_parts\<basename>_part_002.txt`
  - etc.

## Example result
If today is `2026-05-20`, you may get:

```text
E:\Co-Pilot-Chat-History\may-2026-recovery\2026-05-20\
  2026-05-20_master-history.md
  2026-05-20_master-history_parts\
    2026-05-20_master-history_part_001.txt
    2026-05-20_master-history_part_002.txt
```


- split `.txt` files exist

Your current repo-sync script still copies extracted files **flat into the target date folder**, which means files from different extracted subfolders could overwrite each other if they share names.

## What is wrong now

In `FormLedgerMenu.vb`, option `(3)` calls `OpenViewChecksPromptFlow()`. That method asks 3 questions with `ShowPromptDialog(...)`, which opens `FormLedgerPrompt`, a stock grey modal dialog with a `TextBox` and OK/Cancel buttons. That is exactly what your screenshot shows and why it feels wrong compared to DOS. Then, after collecting `cust`, `chk`, and `yr`, it opens `New FormLedgerView()` without using any of them. citeturn0fetch0turn0fetch2

The DOS screenshot shows the correct behavior: the menu stays on-screen and the prompt appears inline at the bottom. So the right fix is not “restyle the popup”; it is “remove the popup flow for this menu path.” citeturn0fetch0

### 1. Remove the modal prompt flow from `FormLedgerMenu`
Delete or stop using:

### 2. Add an inline prompt area to `FormLedgerMenu`
Keep the menu visible and add, near the bottom of the form:
- a prompt label
- a single-line textbox

You can do this either:

### 3. Implement a 3-step inline prompt sequence
When `(3)` is chosen:
1. show inline prompt: `Enter customer name [Enter = all customers] ?`

3. on Enter, store value and prompt: `Enter Year [Enter = All Years] ?`
4. on final Enter, open `FormLedgerView` with those values

On Esc during prompt mode:

- return to normal Checks menu state

That matches the DOS interaction much more closely than a modal dialog. The base class already has global ESC handling, so you’ll need to intercept/override that while prompt mode is active. citeturn0fetch1

Right now `FormLedgerView` has no constructor or properties for startup filters. It only reads from its own controls on load. Add public properties like:

## Practical styling guidance for the inline prompt

To match the DOS screen better:
- prompt background: same dark/black area as the menu
- prompt text: white
- input textbox:
  - black background
  - white or yellow text
  - fixed border or none
- use a monospaced or DOS-feeling font if available
- place it above the bottom bar, left-aligned, not centered

`DosMenuFormBase` currently builds:
- black header
- dark gray body
- bottom close bar

So place the prompt in the body area near the bottom, not in a popup. citeturn0fetch1

# Replace `AMiOffice/FormLedgerMenu.vb`

```vbnet name=AMiOffice/FormLedgerMenu.vb
﻿Option Strict Off
Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Partial Public Class FormLedgerMenu
    Inherits DosMenuFormBase

    Private Enum ViewChecksPromptStep
        None = 0
        Customer = 1
        CheckNumber = 2
        Year = 3
    End Enum

    Private ReadOnly pnlPromptHost As New Panel()
    Private ReadOnly lblPrompt As New Label()
    Private ReadOnly txtPrompt As New TextBox()

    Private _viewChecksPromptStep As ViewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
    Private _viewChecksCustomer As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksCheckNumber As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksYear As String = ""

    Protected Overrides Sub OnLoad(e As EventArgs)
        MyBase.OnLoad(e)

        SetMenuTitle("CHECKS")

        ' No version/build on this menu
        ShowVersionInHeader = False
        UpdateHeaderClock()

        ' One vertical column, indented left, fixed-width buttons
        StretchButtonsToPanelWidth = False
        ButtonFixedWidthPx = 620
        flpLeft.Padding = New Padding(24, 0, 0, 0)

        ' Disable the second column entirely
        flpRight.Visible = False
        flpRight.Enabled = False

        ' The bottom ESC Close button is now in the base bottom bar,
        ' so do NOT add it as a menu button.
        flpLeft.AutoScroll = False

        Me.Width = 1000
        Me.Height = 720

        BuildLedgerMenu()
        BuildInlinePromptUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildLedgerMenu()
        ClearMenu()

        Dim p = flpLeft

        AddMenuButton(p, "1", "Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts", Sub() NotYet("Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "2", "Delete Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "3", "View Checks", Sub() BeginViewChecksPromptFlow())
        AddMenuButton(p, "5", "View Companys Totals", Sub()
                                                          Using f As New FormLedgerCompanyTotals()
                                                              f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                          End Using
                                                      End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "6", "Add OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Add OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "7", "Delete OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "8", "View OTHER Checks", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormOtherChecksView()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "9", "Find a Check #", Sub()
                                                    Using f As New FormFindByCheckNumber()
                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                    End Using
                                                End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "0", "Find an Invoice #", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormFindByInvoiceNumber()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "A", "Find Checks that don't balance.", Sub()
                                                                    Using f As New FormLedgerDoesntBalance()
                                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                                    End Using
                                                                End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "S", "Sales Employee's checks", Sub()
                                                             Using f As New FormSalesEmployeesChecksMenu()
                                                                 f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                             End Using
                                                         End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildInlinePromptUi()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        pnlPromptHost.Dock = DockStyle.Bottom
        pnlPromptHost.Height = 80
        pnlPromptHost.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32)
        pnlPromptHost.Padding = New Padding(18, 10, 18, 12)

        lblPrompt.AutoSize = False
        lblPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        lblPrompt.Height = 26
        lblPrompt.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        lblPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        lblPrompt.BackColor = pnlPromptHost.BackColor
        lblPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)

        txtPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        txtPrompt.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle
        txtPrompt.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        txtPrompt.MaxLength = 100

        AddHandler txtPrompt.KeyDown, AddressOf OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown

        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(txtPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(lblPrompt)

        Controls.Add(pnlPromptHost)
        pnlPromptHost.BringToFront()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BeginViewChecksPromptFlow()
        _viewChecksCustomer = ""
        _viewChecksCheckNumber = ""
        _viewChecksYear = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer

        ShowPrompt("Enter customer name [Enter = all customers] ?", "")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPrompt(promptText As String, currentValue As String)
        lblPrompt.Text = promptText
        txtPrompt.Text = currentValue
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = True
        txtPrompt.SelectionStart = txtPrompt.TextLength
        txtPrompt.SelectionLength = 0
        txtPrompt.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub HidePrompt()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        lblPrompt.Text = ""
        txtPrompt.Text = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
        Me.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None Then
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            e.Handled = True
            HidePrompt()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode <> Keys.Enter Then
            Return
        End If

        e.SuppressKeyPress = True
        e.Handled = True

        Dim value As String = txtPrompt.Text.Trim()

        Select Case _viewChecksPromptStep
            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer
                _viewChecksCustomer = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                ShowPrompt("Enter Check Number [Enter = All Checks] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                _viewChecksCheckNumber = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                ShowPrompt("Enter Year [Enter = All Years] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                _viewChecksYear = value
                HidePrompt()
                OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
                Return
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
        Using f As New FormLedgerView()
            f.InitialCustomerFilter = _viewChecksCustomer
            f.InitialCheckFilter = _viewChecksCheckNumber
            f.InitialYearFilter = NormalizeYearFilter(_viewChecksYear)
            f.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Function NormalizeYearFilter(value As String) As String
        Dim s As String = If(value, "").Trim()

        If s = "" Then
            Return ""
        End If

        Dim yearNum As Integer
        If Integer.TryParse(s, yearNum) Then
            If s.Length <= 2 Then
                If yearNum <= 79 Then
                    Return (2000 + yearNum).ToString()
                Else
                    Return (1900 + yearNum).ToString()
                End If
            End If

            If s.Length = 4 Then
                Return s
            End If
        End If

        Return s
    End Function

End Class
```

```vbnet name=AMiOffice/FormLedgerView.vb
    Private Sub ApplyInitialFilters()
        txtCustomer.Text = InitialCustomerFilter.Trim()
        txtCheck.Text = InitialCheckFilter.Trim()

        If yearText <> "" AndAlso cmbYear.Items.Contains(yearText) Then
            cmbYear.SelectedItem = yearText

    Private Sub PopulatePicklists()
        cmbMonth.Items.Clear()
        cmbMonth.Items.Add("") ' all
        For m As Integer = 1 To 12
            cmbMonth.Items.Add(m.ToString("00"))

        cmbMonth.SelectedIndex = 0

        cmbYear.Items.Clear()
        cmbYear.Items.Add("") ' all
        ' We don't know min/max upfront; just provide a reasonable range + all.
        For y As Integer = Date.Today.Year To 1986 Step -1
            cmbYear.Items.Add(y.ToString())
        Next
        cmbYear.SelectedIndex = 0
    End Sub

    Private Sub LoadData()
        Dim path = LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur

        ' Clear current view so we never display stale data if the file is missing/unreadable.
        _all.Clear()
        dgv.DataSource = Nothing
        lblTotal.Text = "Total: $0.00"

        If Not System.IO.File.Exists(path) Then
            UiFileErrors.ShowMissingRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, path)
            Return
        End If

        Try
            _all.AddRange(LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(path))
        Catch ex As Exception
            UiFileErrors.ShowUnableToReadRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, path, ex)
        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub ApplyFilters()
        Dim cust As String = txtCustomer.Text.Trim()
        Dim chk As String = txtCheck.Text.Trim()
        Dim year As String = If(TryCast(cmbYear.SelectedItem, String), "").Trim()
        Dim month As String = If(TryCast(cmbMonth.SelectedItem, String), "").Trim()

        Dim q = _all.AsEnumerable()

        If cust <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.Customer, "").IndexOf(cust, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
        End If

        If chk <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.CheckNumber, "").IndexOf(chk, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
        End If

        If year <> "" Then
            Dim yy As String = year.Substring(year.Length - 2) ' DOS compared last 2 digits
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.DateText, "").EndsWith(yy, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End If

        If month <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.DateText, "").StartsWith(month, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End If

        Dim list = q.ToList()
        dgv.DataSource = list

        Dim total As Decimal = list.Sum(Function(e) e.Amount)
        lblTotal.Text = $"Total: {total:C}"
    End Sub

    ' Invoice details

    Private Sub OnMainGridSelectionChanged()
        If dgv.SelectedRows.Count = 0 Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Select a check row above to view invoice details.")
            Return
        End If

        Dim entry = TryCast(dgv.SelectedRows(0).DataBoundItem, LedgerEntry)
        If entry Is Nothing Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Select a check row above to view invoice details.")
            Return
        End If

        ShowInvoiceDetails(entry)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ClearInvoiceDetails(statusMsg As String)
        dgvInvoice.DataSource = Nothing
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text = statusMsg
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowInvoiceDetails(entry As LedgerEntry)
        If Not _invIndexReady Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Loading invoice index, please wait...")
            Return
        End If

        Dim key As String = BuildKey(entry.Customer, entry.CheckNumber)
        Dim invoiceNumbers As List(Of Long) = Nothing

        If Not _invIndex.TryGetValue(key, invoiceNumbers) OrElse
           invoiceNumbers Is Nothing OrElse invoiceNumbers.Count = 0 Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("No invoice details available (check predates CHECK.INV coverage or has no invoices).")
            Return
        End If

        Dim invChkPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk
        Dim rows As New List(Of InvoiceDetailRow)()

        For Each invNo As Long In invoiceNumbers
            Dim rec = InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(invChkPath, invNo)
            rows.Add(New InvoiceDetailRow() With {
                .InvoiceNumber = invNo,
                .Amount = If(rec.IsFound, rec.Amount.ToString("C"), "Unavailable"),
                .CompanyCode = If(rec.IsFound, rec.CompanyCode, ""),
                .Status = If(rec.IsFound, rec.FlagDescription, "Unavailable")
            })
        Next

        dgvInvoice.DataSource = rows
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text =
            $"Check #{entry.CheckNumber.Trim()}  |  Customer: {entry.Customer.TrimEnd()}  |  {invoiceNumbers.Count} invoice(s)"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartLoadCheckInvIndex()
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text = "Loading CHECK.INV index..."
        Dim path As String = LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv

        Task.Run(
            Sub()
                Dim idx As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Long))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

                Try
                    If System.IO.File.Exists(path) Then
                        Dim blocks = CheckInvReader.ReadAll(path)
                        For Each b In blocks
                            Dim key As String = BuildKey(b.CustomerCode, b.CheckNumber)
                            Dim lst As List(Of Long) = Nothing
                            If Not idx.TryGetValue(key, lst) Then
                                lst = New List(Of Long)()
                                idx(key) = lst
                            End If
                            If b.Invoices IsNot Nothing Then
                                For Each invStr In b.Invoices
                                    Dim invNo As Long
                                    If Long.TryParse(invStr.Trim(), invNo) Then
                                        lst.Add(invNo)
                                    End If
                                Next
                            End If
                        Next
                    End If
                Catch
                    ' Best-effort; proceed with the empty index built so far.
                End Try

                Try
                    If Not Me.IsDisposed Then
                        Me.Invoke(Sub()
                                      _invIndex = idx
                                      _invIndexReady = True
                                      OnMainGridSelectionChanged()
                                  End Sub)
                    End If
                Catch __e As ObjectDisposedException
                    ' Form was closed while the background task was running; ignore.
                End Try
            End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function BuildKey(code As String, checkNum As String) As String
        Return If(code, "").TrimEnd() & "|" & If(checkNum, "").Trim()
    End Function

End Class
```

For button **(3)**:

- no more grey popup dialog
- prompt happens inline on the Checks menu form
- Enter advances through the 3 DOS-like prompts
- Esc cancels prompt mode
- the entered values are actually applied to `FormLedgerView`
- the ledger view itself is styled darker/DOS-like instead of default Windows grey

## Copilot

Good — these errors are straightforward.

## What happened

### 1. `BC30037 Character is not valid` on line 1
That almost certainly means the file was pasted with a **hidden Unicode/BOM character** at the start of `FormLedgerMenu.vb`.

Specifically, this usually comes from the leading invisible character before:

```vb
Option Strict Off
```

In the replacement I gave, line 1 began with:

```vb
﻿Option Strict Off
```

That invisible character can trigger exactly this error in some paste/edit situations.

### 2. The `Option` / `Imports` errors
Those are just downstream from line 1 being malformed. Once the hidden character is removed, those usually disappear.

### 3. `WFO1000` on the `Initial...Filter` properties
Those are WinForms designer warnings because the designer sees public properties on a form and wants serialization guidance.

They are not logic errors, but we should fix them cleanly.

---

# Fixes

## Fix 1: replace the first lines of `FormLedgerMenu.vb`
Make sure the file begins **exactly** like this, with no hidden leading character:

```vb
Option Strict Off
Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms
```

If needed:
- delete line 1 completely
- retype it manually
- save as UTF-8 without weird leading characters if your editor allows it

---

## Fix 2: suppress designer serialization warnings cleanly
In `FormLedgerView.vb`, add these imports:

```vb
Imports System.ComponentModel
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Linq
Imports System.Threading.Tasks
Imports System.Windows.Forms
```

Then decorate the three public properties like this:

```vb
<Browsable(False)>
<DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)>
Public Property InitialCustomerFilter As String = ""

<Browsable(False)>
<DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)>
Public Property InitialCheckFilter As String = ""

<Browsable(False)>
<DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)>
Public Property InitialYearFilter As String = ""
```

That should eliminate the `WFO1000` warnings.

```vbnet name=AMiOffice/FormLedgerMenu.vb
Option Strict Off
Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Partial Public Class FormLedgerMenu
    Inherits DosMenuFormBase

    Private Enum ViewChecksPromptStep
        None = 0
        Customer = 1
        CheckNumber = 2
        Year = 3
    End Enum

    Private ReadOnly pnlPromptHost As New Panel()
    Private ReadOnly lblPrompt As New Label()
    Private ReadOnly txtPrompt As New TextBox()

    Private _viewChecksPromptStep As ViewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
    Private _viewChecksCustomer As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksCheckNumber As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksYear As String = ""

    Protected Overrides Sub OnLoad(e As EventArgs)
        MyBase.OnLoad(e)

        SetMenuTitle("CHECKS")

        ShowVersionInHeader = False
        UpdateHeaderClock()

        StretchButtonsToPanelWidth = False
        ButtonFixedWidthPx = 620
        flpLeft.Padding = New Padding(24, 0, 0, 0)

        flpRight.Visible = False
        flpRight.Enabled = False

        flpLeft.AutoScroll = False

        Me.Width = 1000
        Me.Height = 720

        BuildLedgerMenu()
        BuildInlinePromptUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildLedgerMenu()
        ClearMenu()

        Dim p = flpLeft

        AddMenuButton(p, "1", "Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts", Sub() NotYet("Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "2", "Delete Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "3", "View Checks", Sub() BeginViewChecksPromptFlow())
        AddMenuButton(p, "5", "View Companys Totals", Sub()
                                                          Using f As New FormLedgerCompanyTotals()
                                                              f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                          End Using
                                                      End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "6", "Add OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Add OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "7", "Delete OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "8", "View OTHER Checks", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormOtherChecksView()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "9", "Find a Check #", Sub()
                                                    Using f As New FormFindByCheckNumber()
                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                    End Using
                                                End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "0", "Find an Invoice #", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormFindByInvoiceNumber()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "A", "Find Checks that don't balance.", Sub()
                                                                    Using f As New FormLedgerDoesntBalance()
                                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                                    End Using
                                                                End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "S", "Sales Employee's checks", Sub()
                                                             Using f As New FormSalesEmployeesChecksMenu()
                                                                 f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                             End Using
                                                         End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildInlinePromptUi()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        pnlPromptHost.Dock = DockStyle.Bottom
        pnlPromptHost.Height = 80
        pnlPromptHost.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32)
        pnlPromptHost.Padding = New Padding(18, 10, 18, 12)

        lblPrompt.AutoSize = False
        lblPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        lblPrompt.Height = 26
        lblPrompt.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        lblPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        lblPrompt.BackColor = pnlPromptHost.BackColor
        lblPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)

        txtPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        txtPrompt.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle
        txtPrompt.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        txtPrompt.MaxLength = 100

        AddHandler txtPrompt.KeyDown, AddressOf OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown

        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(txtPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(lblPrompt)

        Controls.Add(pnlPromptHost)
        pnlPromptHost.BringToFront()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BeginViewChecksPromptFlow()
        _viewChecksCustomer = ""
        _viewChecksCheckNumber = ""
        _viewChecksYear = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer

        ShowPrompt("Enter customer name [Enter = all customers] ?", "")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPrompt(promptText As String, currentValue As String)
        lblPrompt.Text = promptText
        txtPrompt.Text = currentValue
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = True
        txtPrompt.SelectionStart = txtPrompt.TextLength
        txtPrompt.SelectionLength = 0
        txtPrompt.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub HidePrompt()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        lblPrompt.Text = ""
        txtPrompt.Text = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
        Me.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None Then
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            e.Handled = True
            HidePrompt()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode <> Keys.Enter Then
            Return
        End If

        e.SuppressKeyPress = True
        e.Handled = True

        Dim value As String = txtPrompt.Text.Trim()

        Select Case _viewChecksPromptStep
            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer
                _viewChecksCustomer = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                ShowPrompt("Enter Check Number [Enter = All Checks] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                _viewChecksCheckNumber = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                ShowPrompt("Enter Year [Enter = All Years] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                _viewChecksYear = value
                HidePrompt()
                OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
                Return
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
        Using f As New FormLedgerView()
            f.InitialCustomerFilter = _viewChecksCustomer
            f.InitialCheckFilter = _viewChecksCheckNumber
            f.InitialYearFilter = NormalizeYearFilter(_viewChecksYear)
            f.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Function NormalizeYearFilter(value As String) As String
        Dim s As String = If(value, "").Trim()

        If s = "" Then
            Return ""
        End If

        Dim yearNum As Integer
        If Integer.TryParse(s, yearNum) Then
            If s.Length <= 2 Then
                If yearNum <= 79 Then
                    Return (2000 + yearNum).ToString()
                Else
                    Return (1900 + yearNum).ToString()
                End If
            End If

            If s.Length = 4 Then
                Return s
            End If
        End If

        Return s
    End Function

End Class
```

```vbnet name=AMiOffice/FormLedgerView.vb
        lblInvoiceStatus.Font = New Font("Consolas", 10.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)

        dgvInvoice.Dock = DockStyle.Fill
        dgvInvoice.ReadOnly = True
        dgvInvoice.AllowUserToAddRows = False
        dgvInvoice.AllowUserToDeleteRows = False
        dgvInvoice.AutoGenerateColumns = False
        dgvInvoice.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.FullRowSelect
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersHeightSizeMode = DataGridViewColumnHeadersHeightSizeMode.AutoSize
        dgvInvoice.BackgroundColor = Color.Black
        dgvInvoice.GridColor = Color.DimGray
        dgvInvoice.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle
        dgvInvoice.EnableHeadersVisualStyles = False
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.Black
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Yellow
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.Black
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Yellow
        dgvInvoice.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.Font = New Font("Consolas", 10.0F, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        dgvInvoice.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.Black
        dgvInvoice.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.White
        dgvInvoice.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(48, 48, 48)
        dgvInvoice.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.White
        dgvInvoice.DefaultCellStyle.Font = New Font("Consolas", 10.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        dgvInvoice.RowHeadersVisible = False

        dgvInvoice.Columns.Add(New DataGridViewTextBoxColumn() With {
            .DataPropertyName = "InvoiceNumber",
            .HeaderText = "Invoice #",
            .Width = 110
        })
        dgvInvoice.Columns.Add(New DataGridViewTextBoxColumn() With {
            .DataPropertyName = "Amount",
            .HeaderText = "Amount",
            .Width = 110
        })
        dgvInvoice.Columns.Add(New DataGridViewTextBoxColumn() With {

        })

        pnlInvoice.Controls.Add(lblInvoiceStatus)
        pnlInvoice.Controls.Add(lblInvoiceTitle)

        AddHandler btnRefresh.Click,
            Sub()
                LoadData()
                ApplyFilters()
            End Sub

        AddHandler txtCustomer.TextChanged, Sub() ApplyFilters()
        AddHandler txtCheck.TextChanged, Sub() ApplyFilters()
        AddHandler cmbYear.SelectedIndexChanged, Sub() ApplyFilters()
        AddHandler cmbMonth.SelectedIndexChanged, Sub() ApplyFilters()
        AddHandler dgv.SelectionChanged, Sub() OnMainGridSelectionChanged()

        Controls.Add(dgv)
        Controls.Add(pnlInvoice)
        Controls.Add(topPanel)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ApplyInitialFilters()
        txtCustomer.Text = InitialCustomerFilter.Trim()
        txtCheck.Text = InitialCheckFilter.Trim()

        Dim yearText As String = InitialYearFilter.Trim()
        If yearText <> "" AndAlso cmbYear.Items.Contains(yearText) Then
            cmbYear.SelectedItem = yearText
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub PopulatePicklists()
        cmbMonth.Items.Clear()
        cmbMonth.Items.Add("")
        For m As Integer = 1 To 12
            cmbMonth.Items.Add(m.ToString("00"))
        Next
        cmbMonth.SelectedIndex = 0

        cmbYear.Items.Clear()
        cmbYear.Items.Add("")
        For y As Integer = Date.Today.Year To 1986 Step -1
            cmbYear.Items.Add(y.ToString())
        Next
        cmbYear.SelectedIndex = 0
    End Sub

    Private Sub LoadData()
        Dim path = LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur

        _all.Clear()
        dgv.DataSource = Nothing
        lblTotal.Text = "Total: $0.00"

        If Not System.IO.File.Exists(path) Then
            UiFileErrors.ShowMissingRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, path)
            Return
        End If

        Try
            _all.AddRange(LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(path))
        Catch ex As Exception
            UiFileErrors.ShowUnableToReadRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, path, ex)
        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub ApplyFilters()
        Dim cust As String = txtCustomer.Text.Trim()
        Dim chk As String = txtCheck.Text.Trim()
        Dim year As String = If(TryCast(cmbYear.SelectedItem, String), "").Trim()
        Dim month As String = If(TryCast(cmbMonth.SelectedItem, String), "").Trim()

        Dim q = _all.AsEnumerable()

        If cust <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.Customer, "").IndexOf(cust, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
        End If

        If chk <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.CheckNumber, "").IndexOf(chk, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
        End If

        If year <> "" Then
            Dim yy As String = year.Substring(year.Length - 2)
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.DateText, "").EndsWith(yy, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End If

        If month <> "" Then
            q = q.Where(Function(e) If(e.DateText, "").StartsWith(month, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        End If

        Dim list = q.ToList()
        dgv.DataSource = list

        Dim total As Decimal = list.Sum(Function(e) e.Amount)
        lblTotal.Text = $"Total: {total:C}"
    End Sub

    Private Sub OnMainGridSelectionChanged()
        If dgv.SelectedRows.Count = 0 Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Select a check row above to view invoice details.")
            Return
        End If

        Dim entry = TryCast(dgv.SelectedRows(0).DataBoundItem, LedgerEntry)
        If entry Is Nothing Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Select a check row above to view invoice details.")
            Return
        End If

        ShowInvoiceDetails(entry)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ClearInvoiceDetails(statusMsg As String)
        dgvInvoice.DataSource = Nothing
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text = statusMsg
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowInvoiceDetails(entry As LedgerEntry)
        If Not _invIndexReady Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("Loading invoice index, please wait...")
            Return
        End If

        Dim key As String = BuildKey(entry.Customer, entry.CheckNumber)
        Dim invoiceNumbers As List(Of Long) = Nothing

        If Not _invIndex.TryGetValue(key, invoiceNumbers) OrElse
           invoiceNumbers Is Nothing OrElse invoiceNumbers.Count = 0 Then
            ClearInvoiceDetails("No invoice details available (check predates CHECK.INV coverage or has no invoices).")
            Return
        End If

        Dim invChkPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk
        Dim rows As New List(Of InvoiceDetailRow)()

        For Each invNo As Long In invoiceNumbers
            Dim rec = InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(invChkPath, invNo)
            rows.Add(New InvoiceDetailRow() With {
                .InvoiceNumber = invNo,
                .Amount = If(rec.IsFound, rec.Amount.ToString("C"), "Unavailable"),
                .CompanyCode = If(rec.IsFound, rec.CompanyCode, ""),
                .Status = If(rec.IsFound, rec.FlagDescription, "Unavailable")
            })
        Next

        dgvInvoice.DataSource = rows
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text =
            $"Check #{entry.CheckNumber.Trim()}  |  Customer: {entry.Customer.TrimEnd()}  |  {invoiceNumbers.Count} invoice(s)"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartLoadCheckInvIndex()
        lblInvoiceStatus.Text = "Loading CHECK.INV index..."
        Dim path As String = LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv

        Task.Run(
            Sub()
                Dim idx As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Long))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

                Try
                    If System.IO.File.Exists(path) Then
                        Dim blocks = CheckInvReader.ReadAll(path)
                        For Each b In blocks
                            Dim key As String = BuildKey(b.CustomerCode, b.CheckNumber)
                            Dim lst As List(Of Long) = Nothing
                            If Not idx.TryGetValue(key, lst) Then
                                lst = New List(Of Long)()
                                idx(key) = lst
                            End If
                            If b.Invoices IsNot Nothing Then
                                For Each invStr In b.Invoices
                                    Dim invNo As Long
                                    If Long.TryParse(invStr.Trim(), invNo) Then
                                        lst.Add(invNo)
                                    End If
                                Next
                            End If
                        Next
                    End If
                Catch
                End Try

                Try
                    If Not Me.IsDisposed Then
                        Me.Invoke(Sub()
                                      _invIndex = idx
                                      _invIndexReady = True
                                      OnMainGridSelectionChanged()
                                  End Sub)
                    End If
                Catch __e As ObjectDisposedException
                End Try
            End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function BuildKey(code As String, checkNum As String) As String
        Return If(code, "").TrimEnd() & "|" & If(checkNum, "").Trim()
    End Function

End Class
```

That’s probably a bit too tall for the Checks menu if you also want a prompt region at the bottom.

or

may work better.

So I would adjust only `FormLedgerMenu.vb`:

```vbnet name=AMiOffice/FormLedgerMenu.vb
Option Strict Off

Imports System
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Partial Public Class FormLedgerMenu
    Inherits DosMenuFormBase

    Private Enum ViewChecksPromptStep
        None = 0
        Customer = 1
        CheckNumber = 2
        Year = 3
    End Enum

    Private ReadOnly pnlPromptHost As New Panel()
    Private ReadOnly pnlPromptSeparator As New Panel()
    Private ReadOnly lblPrompt As New Label()
    Private ReadOnly txtPrompt As New TextBox()

    Private _viewChecksPromptStep As ViewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
    Private _viewChecksCustomer As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksCheckNumber As String = ""
    Private _viewChecksYear As String = ""

    Protected Overrides Sub OnLoad(e As EventArgs)
        MyBase.OnLoad(e)

        SetMenuTitle("CHECKS")

        ShowVersionInHeader = False
        UpdateHeaderClock()

        StretchButtonsToPanelWidth = False
        ButtonFixedWidthPx = 620
        flpLeft.Padding = New Padding(24, 0, 0, 0)

        flpRight.Visible = False
        flpRight.Enabled = False

        flpLeft.AutoScroll = False

        Me.Width = 1000
        Me.Height = 720

        BuildLedgerMenu()
        TightenChecksMenuButtons()
        BuildInlinePromptUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildLedgerMenu()
        ClearMenu()

        Dim p = flpLeft

        AddMenuButton(p, "1", "Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts", Sub() NotYet("Add Checks to ledger & cash receipts"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "2", "Delete Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "3", "View Checks", Sub() BeginViewChecksPromptFlow())

        AddMenuButton(p, "6", "Add OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Add OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "7", "Delete OTHER Checks", Sub() NotYet("Delete OTHER Checks"))
        AddMenuButton(p, "8", "View OTHER Checks", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormOtherChecksView()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "9", "Find a Check #", Sub()
                                                    Using f As New FormFindByCheckNumber()
                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                    End Using
                                                End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "0", "Find an Invoice #", Sub()
                                                       Using f As New FormFindByInvoiceNumber()
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                       End Using
                                                   End Sub)
        AddMenuButton(p, "A", "Find Checks that don't balance.", Sub()
                                                                    Using f As New FormLedgerDoesntBalance()
                                                                        f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                                    End Using

        AddMenuButton(p, "S", "Sales Employee's checks", Sub()
                                                             Using f As New FormSalesEmployeesChecksMenu()
                                                                 f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                             End Using
                                                         End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Sub TightenChecksMenuButtons()
        For Each c As Control In flpLeft.Controls
            Dim btn = TryCast(c, Button)
            If btn IsNot Nothing Then
                btn.Height = 30
                btn.Margin = New Padding(3, 3, 3, 4)
                btn.Font = New Font("Segoe UI", 11.0F, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point)
            End If
        Next
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildInlinePromptUi()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        pnlPromptHost.Dock = DockStyle.Bottom
        pnlPromptHost.Height = 96
        pnlPromptHost.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32)
        pnlPromptHost.Padding = New Padding(12, 8, 12, 10)

        pnlPromptSeparator.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        pnlPromptSeparator.Height = 2
        pnlPromptSeparator.BackColor = Color.Silver

        lblPrompt.AutoSize = False
        lblPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        lblPrompt.Height = 28
        lblPrompt.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        lblPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        lblPrompt.BackColor = pnlPromptHost.BackColor
        lblPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        lblPrompt.Padding = New Padding(0, 8, 0, 0)

        txtPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        txtPrompt.Height = 30
        txtPrompt.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle
        txtPrompt.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        txtPrompt.MaxLength = 100
        txtPrompt.Margin = New Padding(0, 6, 0, 0)

        AddHandler txtPrompt.KeyDown, AddressOf OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown

        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(txtPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(lblPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(pnlPromptSeparator)

        Controls.Add(pnlPromptHost)
        pnlPromptHost.BringToFront()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BeginViewChecksPromptFlow()
        _viewChecksCustomer = ""
        _viewChecksCheckNumber = ""
        _viewChecksYear = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer

        ShowPrompt("Enter customer name [Enter = all customers] ?", "")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPrompt(promptText As String, currentValue As String)
        lblPrompt.Text = promptText
        txtPrompt.Text = currentValue
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = True
        txtPrompt.SelectionStart = txtPrompt.TextLength
        txtPrompt.SelectionLength = 0
        txtPrompt.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub HidePrompt()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        lblPrompt.Text = ""
        txtPrompt.Text = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
        Me.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None Then
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            e.Handled = True
            HidePrompt()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode <> Keys.Enter Then
            Return
        End If

        e.SuppressKeyPress = True
        e.Handled = True

        Dim value As String = txtPrompt.Text.Trim()

        Select Case _viewChecksPromptStep
            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer
                _viewChecksCustomer = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                ShowPrompt("Enter Check Number [Enter = All Checks] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                _viewChecksCheckNumber = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                ShowPrompt("Enter Year [Enter = All Years] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                _viewChecksYear = value
                HidePrompt()
                OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
                Return
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
        Using f As New FormLedgerView()
            f.InitialCustomerFilter = _viewChecksCustomer
            f.InitialCheckFilter = _viewChecksCheckNumber
            f.InitialYearFilter = NormalizeYearFilter(_viewChecksYear)
            f.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Function NormalizeYearFilter(value As String) As String
        Dim s As String = If(value, "").Trim()

        If s = "" Then
            Return ""
        End If

        Dim yearNum As Integer
        If Integer.TryParse(s, yearNum) Then
            If s.Length <= 2 Then
                If yearNum <= 79 Then
                    Return (2000 + yearNum).ToString()
                Else
                    Return (1900 + yearNum).ToString()
                End If
            End If

            If s.Length = 4 Then
                Return s
            End If
        End If

        Return s
    End Function

End Class
```
