Copilot said: # 1. Executive Summary Today’s work focused on
1. Executive Summary
Today’s work focused on closing out the remaining active Checks-menu polish item in the AMi modernization effort: (A) Find checks that don't balance, implemented in FormLedgerDoesntBalance.vb in AMiWinForms. The central decision was to keep the current VB logic for this feature, because it is already useful and appears to perform meaningful validation against legacy data files, even though the DOS VM currently appears to do nothing when (A) is selected. That DOS uncertainty means strict parity for this one item is still unresolved, so today’s work prioritized visual consistency and operator usability over speculative flow rewrites.
The starting point was a fully functioning WinForms report screen that already loaded ledger/check/invoice data and identified imbalance cases. The file provided by the operator was FormLedgerDoesntBalance.vb, which contains the following major logic components:
•	RunReportAsync() for asynchronous report generation
•	ComputeRows(...) for building mismatch rows
•	ApplyFilterAndBind() for filter application and sorting
•	dgv_RowPrePaint for row highlighting
•	BuildKey(...), SafeTrim(...), SafeTrimEnd(...), and Csv(...)
•	nested helper types:
o	FilterMode
o	ProgressInfo
o	BalanceRow
The business logic in that form was intentionally preserved. It reads:
•	LEDGER.CUR via LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(...)
•	CHECK.INV via CheckInvReader.ReadAll(...)
•	INVOICE.CHK via InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(...)
using paths from:
•	LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur
•	LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv
•	LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk
It then builds a composite customer/check key using BuildKey(code, checkNum), indexes invoice mappings, resolves invoice amounts, caches invoice amounts in amtCache, and identifies two major categories of exceptions:
1.	No CHECK.INV mapping
2.	Mapped checks whose invoice totals do not balance to the check amount, including cases where invoice references exist but invoice records cannot be found
The tolerance rule stayed intact:
•	Tolerance = 1D which preserves the known DOS-era behavior that differences under one dollar are treated as acceptable.
The primary implementation work today was a styling and usability pass on FormLedgerDoesntBalance so it would look more like the rest of the DOS-inspired application rather than like a generic Windows utility form. The screen was changed to include:
•	dark charcoal/black background
•	black top header area
•	upper-left large yellow CHECKS title
•	upper-right yellow date/time clock
•	silver toolbar buttons
•	darker DataGridView
•	(ESC) Close button and keyboard support
•	DOS-like visual treatment overall
An explicit compile/debug issue came up when adding the clock: Timer was ambiguous because both System.Windows.Forms and System.Threading were imported. That was resolved by explicitly using:
•	System.Windows.Forms.Timer
Another UI issue involved the progress display during report generation. Initially, the status line showed something like “Computing rows... (28,500/51,350)” all on one line, which was visibly truncated. The fix was to split that into a two-line status block:
•	top line = status message, e.g. Computing rows...
•	bottom line = rolling numbers, e.g. 28,500/51,350
This version was preferred by the operator and looked better in practice. However, after computation completed and the grid displayed results, part of the old “Computing...” message still appeared to remain in the status area. That is not blocking release, but it is explicitly on the list for tomorrow to either:
•	change to “Report complete” / “Computations complete”, or
•	clear the transient computation text entirely
A visual refinement was also needed for the grid body text. The initial styled version left all result rows looking bold, which made the list too heavy. The grid body was updated to use regular-weight text while keeping column headers bold. Forced bold formatting on highlighted rows was also removed.
Row highlight colors then went through several iterations based on actual screenshots. Originally:
•	the no-invoice rows looked too gold/saturated yellow
•	the mismatch rows looked too strong/pastel-pink-red
These were softened multiple times until the operator approved the final look:
•	lighter pale yellow for rows with no invoice mapping
•	soft milky pink for rows with invoice deltas
The operator ultimately confirmed that the latest yellow and pink look fine.
Another important near-future cleanup item was identified: the upper-left CHECKS title font in this form is still only an approximation and does not match the exact Castellar/Castella-style font used on the Main Menu and Checks Menu. This needs to be standardized so all upper-left header titles across DOS-styled forms use the same exact font definition and size.
Publishing and deployment were also discussed because this is a rebuilt Visual Studio/VB environment after a crash. The operator wanted to publish a build as a standalone executable that could be copied to workstations and run. We clarified that:
•	ClickOnce is not appropriate for that goal
•	Folder publish is the correct approach
•	ideally use self-contained + single-file + win-x64 + Release if minimizing workstation runtime dependencies is important
The operator did publish a build and test it on the virtual machine, and reported that it is looking really good.
At the end of the session, one additional infrastructure item surfaced: there had previously been a build counter that incremented a build number by reading/updating a text file, but that mechanism was apparently not restored after the crash/rebuild. That now needs to be reinstated. This was explicitly added to tomorrow’s list, along with:
•	the status cleanup after computation
•	title font standardization
•	validating with users whether DOS (A) ever actually did anything
Overall, today was a productive closeout/polish/release session. The current build is good enough to publish, the VM run looks good, and the remaining work is now a focused set of small cleanup items plus one open product question about DOS parity for (A).

3. Key Technical Findings
•	FormLedgerDoesntBalance.vb is already a substantial functional implementation, not just a UI shell.
•	The core business logic is organized around:
o	RunReportAsync()
o	ComputeRows(...)
o	ApplyFilterAndBind()
o	dgv_RowPrePaint
•	The form distinguishes between:
o	rows with no CHECK.INV mapping
o	rows with invoice mappings whose totals do not match the check amount
•	ComputeRows(...) uses a cache:
o	Dim amtCache As New Dictionary(Of Long, Decimal)() to avoid repeatedly reading invoice records for duplicate invoice references.
•	The composite relationship key is built using:
o	BuildKey(code, checkNum) = trimmed customer code + "|" + trimmed check number
•	Missing CHECK.INV data causes rows to be flagged as:
o	"No CHECK.INV mapping"
•	Missing invoice records in INVOICE.CHK cause rows to be flagged via note text:
o	"Invoices not found in INVOICE.CHK"
•	The logic currently considers a row unbalanced when:
o	no mapped invoice amounts were found, or
o	Math.Abs(delta) >= Tolerance
•	The DOS-era tolerance assumption remains baked into:
o	Private Const Tolerance As Decimal = 1D

o	status message on top

•	Ambiguous timer issue occurred because of:
o	Imports System.Windows.Forms
o	Imports System.Threading and both namespaces expose a Timer.
•	Correct fix was to explicitly declare:
o	Private ReadOnly tmrClock As System.Windows.Forms.Timer = New System.Windows.Forms.Timer()
•	DataGridView body text looked too heavy when styled bold; regular body font is visually preferable.
•	Highlight colors had to be tuned in the context of the dark DOS-like theme; saturated gold/pink felt wrong.

### 1) The truncated/lingering “Computing...” issue
In `FormLedgerDoesntBalance.vb`, progress updates currently go through a **single label**:

```vb
If p.Total > 0 Then
    lblStatus.Text = $"{p.Message}  ({p.Current:N0}/{p.Total:N0})"
Else
    lblStatus.Text = p.Message
End If
```

and later, after results bind, it gets replaced by:

```vb
lblStatus.Text = $"Showing: {showing:N0} | Total: {allRows.Count:N0} | No mapping: {noMap:N0} | Delta rows: {deltaRows:N0}"
```

So the current GitHub-visible file does **not** contain the two-label fix you described earlier; it still uses one label, which explains why the long “Computing...” text can truncate and/or linger. citeturn0commentary0

### 2) The build counter mechanism
The repo clearly still contains the build-counter pieces:

- `AMiOffice/build-counter.txt` currently contains `28`
- `AMiOffice/Generated/BuildInfo.g.vb` contains:
  - `ProductVersion = "1.0.0"`
  - `BuildNumber = "28"`
  - `DisplayVersion = "AMiOffice v1.0.0 (Build 28)"`
- `FormMainMenu.vb` reads and displays `BuildInfo.DisplayVersion`
- `FormAbout.vb` also reads `BuildInfo.DisplayVersion`
- `AMiOffice.vbproj` defines:
  - `<BuildNumber Condition="'$(BuildNumber)'==''">0</BuildNumber>`
  - `<FileVersion>$(Version).$(BuildNumber)</FileVersion>`
  - `<InformationalVersion>$(Version) (Build $(BuildNumber))</InformationalVersion>`
  - `<BuildInfoFile>...\Generated\BuildInfo.g.vb</BuildInfoFile>` citeturn0commentary1turn0commentary0

```vb
            If p.Total > 0 Then

    End Sub
```

```
        Await RunReportAsync()
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnCopyRow_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim r As BalanceRow = TryCast(dgv.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If r Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim text As String =
            r.Customer & vbTab &
            r.DateText & vbTab &
            r.CheckNumber & vbTab &
            r.CheckAmount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceCount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceSum & vbTab &
            r.Delta & vbTab &
            r.Note

        Clipboard.SetText(text)
        lblStatus.Text = "Copied selected row to clipboard."
        lblStatusCount.Text = ""
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnExportCsv_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
        If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
            MessageBox.Show(Me, "There are no rows to export.", ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
            Return
        End If

        Using sfd As New SaveFileDialog()
            sfd.Title = "Export CSV"
            sfd.Filter = "CSV (*.csv)|*.csv|All files (*.*)|*.*"
            sfd.FileName = $"LedgerDoesntBalance_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv"
            If sfd.ShowDialog(Me) <> DialogResult.OK Then Return

            Try
                Dim sb As New StringBuilder()
                sb.AppendLine("Customer,Date,CheckNumber,CheckAmount,InvoiceCount,InvoiceSum,Delta,Note")

                For Each r In rows
                    sb.AppendLine(
                        Csv(r.Customer) & "," &
                        Csv(r.DateText) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckNumber) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckAmount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceCount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceSum) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Delta) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Note)
                    )
                Next

                IO.File.WriteAllText(sfd.FileName, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8)
                lblStatus.Text = $"Exported {rows.Count:N0} row(s) to CSV."
                lblStatusCount.Text = ""
            Catch ex As Exception
                MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
            End Try
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub cboFilter_SelectedIndexChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        ApplyFilterAndBind()
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_SelectionChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_RowPrePaint(sender As Object, e As DataGridViewRowPrePaintEventArgs)
        Dim row As DataGridViewRow = dgv.Rows(e.RowIndex)
        Dim data As BalanceRow = TryCast(row.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If data Is Nothing Then Return

        row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
        row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black

        If data.IsNoMapping Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(250, 245, 190)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(253, 249, 205)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
            Return
        End If

        Dim absDelta As Decimal = Math.Abs(data.DeltaValue)
        If absDelta >= LargeDeltaSevere Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(249, 232, 236)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 238, 241)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        ElseIf absDelta >= LargeDeltaWarn Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 239, 242)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(254, 244, 246)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Async Function RunReportAsync() As Task
        If cts IsNot Nothing Then
            cts.Cancel()
            cts.Dispose()
            cts = Nothing
        End If

        cts = New CancellationTokenSource()
        Dim token As CancellationToken = cts.Token

        btnRefresh.Enabled = False
        btnCancel.Enabled = True
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = False
        btnExportCsv.Enabled = False
        btnClose.Enabled = False
        cboFilter.Enabled = False
        lblStatus.Text = "Starting..."
        lblStatusCount.Text = ""
        dgv.DataSource = Nothing
        allRows = New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim ledgerPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur
        Dim checkInvPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv
        Dim invoiceChkPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk

        If Not IO.File.Exists(ledgerPath) Then
            UiFileErrors.ShowMissingRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, ledgerPath)
            lblStatus.Text = "Missing LEDGER.CUR"
            lblStatusCount.Text = ""
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True
            Return
        End If

        Dim progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo) =
            New Progress(Of ProgressInfo)(
                Sub(p As ProgressInfo)
                    If token.IsCancellationRequested Then Return

                    lblStatus.Text = p.Message

                    If p.Total > 0 Then
                        lblStatusCount.Text = $"{p.Current:N0}/{p.Total:N0}"
                    Else
                        lblStatusCount.Text = ""
                    End If
                End Sub
            )

        Try
            Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) =
                Await Task.Run(Function() ComputeRows(ledgerPath, checkInvPath, invoiceChkPath, token, progress), token)

            If token.IsCancellationRequested Then
                lblStatus.Text = "Cancelled"
                lblStatusCount.Text = ""
                Return
            End If

            allRows = rows
            ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Catch ex As OperationCanceledException
            lblStatus.Text = "Cancelled"
            lblStatusCount.Text = ""
        Catch ex As Exception
            lblStatus.Text = "Error running report"
            lblStatusCount.Text = ""
            MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
        Finally
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True

            Dim current As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
            btnExportCsv.Enabled = (current IsNot Nothing AndAlso current.Count > 0)
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Sub ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Dim mode As String = TryCast(cboFilter.SelectedItem, String)
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mode) Then mode = FilterMode.AllUnbalanced

        Dim filtered As IEnumerable(Of BalanceRow) = allRows

        Select Case mode
            Case FilterMode.NoMapping
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping)
            Case FilterMode.DeltaOnly
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping)
            Case Else
        End Select

        Dim sorted As List(Of BalanceRow) =
            filtered.OrderByDescending(Function(r) If(r.IsNoMapping, Decimal.MaxValue, Math.Abs(r.DeltaValue))).ToList()

        dgv.DataSource = sorted

        Dim noMap As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim deltaRows As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim showing As Integer = sorted.Count

        lblStatus.Text = "Report complete"
        lblStatusCount.Text = $"Showing: {showing:N0} | Total: {allRows.Count:N0} | No mapping: {noMap:N0} | Delta rows: {deltaRows:N0}"

        btnExportCsv.Enabled = (showing > 0)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function ComputeRows(
        ledgerPath As String,
        checkInvPath As String,
        invoiceChkPath As String,
        token As CancellationToken,
        progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo)
    ) As List(Of BalanceRow)

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading ledger...", 0, 0))

        Dim ledger As List(Of LedgerEntry) = LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(ledgerPath)
        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading CHECK.INV...", 0, 0))

        Dim invIndex As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Long))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        If IO.File.Exists(checkInvPath) Then
            Try
                Dim blocks = CheckInvReader.ReadAll(checkInvPath)
                Dim i As Integer = 0
                For Each b In blocks
                    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                    i += 1
                    If (i Mod 250) = 0 Then
                        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Indexing CHECK.INV...", i, blocks.Count))
                    End If

                    Dim key = BuildKey(b.CustomerCode, b.CheckNumber)
                    Dim lst As List(Of Long) = Nothing
                    If Not invIndex.TryGetValue(key, lst) Then
                        lst = New List(Of Long)()
                        invIndex(key) = lst
                    End If

                    If b.Invoices IsNot Nothing Then
                        For Each s In b.Invoices
                            Dim n As Long
                            If Long.TryParse(If(s, "").Trim(), n) Then
                                lst.Add(n)
                            End If
                        Next
                    End If
                Next
            Catch
            End Try
        End If

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", 0, ledger.Count))

        Dim amtCache As New Dictionary(Of Long, Decimal)()
        Dim rows As New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim idx As Integer = 0
        For Each e In ledger
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

            idx += 1
            If (idx Mod 250) = 0 Then
                progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", idx, ledger.Count))
            End If

            Dim key = BuildKey(e.Customer, e.CheckNumber)

            Dim invNos As List(Of Long) = Nothing
            Dim hasMapping As Boolean = invIndex.TryGetValue(key, invNos)

            If Not hasMapping OrElse invNos Is Nothing OrElse invNos.Count = 0 Then
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = 0,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = 0D,
                    .DeltaValue = 0D,
                    .Note = "No CHECK.INV mapping",
                    .IsNoMapping = True
                })
                Continue For
            End If

            Dim sum As Decimal = 0D
            Dim foundAny As Boolean = False

            For Each invNo In invNos
                token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

                Dim a As Decimal = 0D
                If amtCache.TryGetValue(invNo, a) Then
                    sum += a
                    foundAny = True
                Else
                    Dim rec = InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(invoiceChkPath, invNo)
                    If rec.IsFound Then
                        a = rec.Amount
                        amtCache(invNo) = a
                        sum += a
                        foundAny = True
                    Else
                        amtCache(invNo) = 0D
                    End If
                End If
            Next

            Dim delta As Decimal = sum - e.Amount
            Dim unbalanced As Boolean = (Not foundAny) OrElse (Math.Abs(delta) >= Tolerance)

            If unbalanced Then
                Dim note As String = If(Not foundAny, "Invoices not found in INVOICE.CHK", "")
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = invNos.Count,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = sum,
                    .DeltaValue = delta,
                    .Note = note,
                    .IsNoMapping = False
                })
            End If
        Next

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Done.", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
        Return rows
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub FireAndForget(t As Task)
        If t Is Nothing Then Return

        t.ContinueWith(
            Sub(completed As Task)
                Dim ignored = completed.Exception
            End Sub,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted,
            TaskScheduler.Default
        )
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function BuildKey(code As String, checkNum As String) As String
        Return If(code, "").TrimEnd() & "|" & If(checkNum, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrim(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrimEnd(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").TrimEnd()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function Csv(s As String) As String
        Dim v As String = If(s, "")
        Dim mustQuote As Boolean =
            (v.Contains(","c) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Quote) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Cr) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Lf))

        If mustQuote Then
            v = v.Replace("""", """""")
            v = """" & v & """"
        End If

        Return v
    End Function

    Private NotInheritable Class FilterMode
        Public Const AllUnbalanced As String = "All unbalanced"
        Public Const NoMapping As String = "No CHECK.INV mapping"
        Public Const DeltaOnly As String = "Delta rows (has mapping)"
    End Class

    Private NotInheritable Class ProgressInfo
        Public ReadOnly Property Message As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Current As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Total As Integer

        Public Sub New(message As String, current As Integer, total As Integer)
            Me.Message = message
            Me.Current = current
            Me.Total = total
        End Sub
    End Class

    Private Class BalanceRow
        Public Property Customer As String
        Public Property DateText As String
        Public Property CheckNumber As String

        Public Property CheckAmountValue As Decimal
        Public Property InvoiceCountValue As Integer
        Public Property InvoiceSumValue As Decimal
        Public Property DeltaValue As Decimal

        Public Property Note As String
        Public Property IsNoMapping As Boolean

        Public ReadOnly Property CheckAmount As String
            Get
                Return CheckAmountValue.ToString("C")
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceCount As String
            Get
                Return InvoiceCountValue.ToString()
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceSum As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", InvoiceSumValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property Delta As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", DeltaValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class
End Class
```

```vbnet
    Private Sub btnCancel_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        If cts IsNot Nothing Then cts.Cancel()
    End Sub

    Private Async Sub btnRefresh_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)

    End Sub

    Private Sub btnCopyRow_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim r As BalanceRow = TryCast(dgv.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If r Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim text As String =
            r.Customer & vbTab &
            r.DateText & vbTab &
            r.CheckNumber & vbTab &
            r.CheckAmount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceCount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceSum & vbTab &
            r.Delta & vbTab &
            r.Note

        Clipboard.SetText(text)
        lblStatusTop.Text = "Copied selected row to clipboard."
        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnExportCsv_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
        If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
            MessageBox.Show(Me, "There are no rows to export.", ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
            Return
        End If

        Using sfd As New SaveFileDialog()
            sfd.Title = "Export CSV"
            sfd.Filter = "CSV (*.csv)|*.csv|All files (*.*)|*.*"
            sfd.FileName = $"LedgerDoesntBalance_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv"
            If sfd.ShowDialog(Me) <> DialogResult.OK Then Return

            Try
                Dim sb As New StringBuilder()
                sb.AppendLine("Customer,Date,CheckNumber,CheckAmount,InvoiceCount,InvoiceSum,Delta,Note")

                For Each r In rows
                    sb.AppendLine(
                        Csv(r.Customer) & "," &
                        Csv(r.DateText) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckNumber) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckAmount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceCount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceSum) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Delta) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Note)
                    )
                Next

                IO.File.WriteAllText(sfd.FileName, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8)
                lblStatusTop.Text = $"Exported {rows.Count:N0} row(s) to CSV."
                lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            Catch ex As Exception
                MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
            End Try
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub cboFilter_SelectedIndexChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        ApplyFilterAndBind()
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_SelectionChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_RowPrePaint(sender As Object, e As DataGridViewRowPrePaintEventArgs)
        Dim row As DataGridViewRow = dgv.Rows(e.RowIndex)
        Dim data As BalanceRow = TryCast(row.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If data Is Nothing Then Return

        row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
        row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black

        If data.IsNoMapping Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(250, 245, 190)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(253, 249, 205)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
            Return
        End If

        Dim absDelta As Decimal = Math.Abs(data.DeltaValue)
        If absDelta >= LargeDeltaSevere Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(249, 232, 236)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 238, 241)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        ElseIf absDelta >= LargeDeltaWarn Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 239, 242)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(254, 244, 246)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Async Function RunReportAsync() As Task
        If cts IsNot Nothing Then
            cts.Cancel()
            cts.Dispose()
            cts = Nothing
        End If

        cts = New CancellationTokenSource()
        Dim token As CancellationToken = cts.Token

        btnRefresh.Enabled = False
        btnCancel.Enabled = True
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = False
        btnExportCsv.Enabled = False
        btnClose.Enabled = False
        cboFilter.Enabled = False
        lblStatusTop.Text = "Starting..."
        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
        dgv.DataSource = Nothing
        allRows = New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim ledgerPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur
        Dim checkInvPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv
        Dim invoiceChkPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk

        If Not IO.File.Exists(ledgerPath) Then
            UiFileErrors.ShowMissingRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, ledgerPath)
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Missing LEDGER.CUR"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True
            Return
        End If

        Dim progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo) =
            New Progress(Of ProgressInfo)(
                Sub(p As ProgressInfo)
                    If token.IsCancellationRequested Then Return

                    lblStatusTop.Text = p.Message

                    If p.Total > 0 Then
                        lblStatusBottom.Text = $"{p.Current:N0}/{p.Total:N0}"
                    Else
                        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
                    End If
                End Sub
            )

        Try
            Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) =
                Await Task.Run(Function() ComputeRows(ledgerPath, checkInvPath, invoiceChkPath, token, progress), token)

            If token.IsCancellationRequested Then
                lblStatusTop.Text = "Cancelled"
                lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
                Return
            End If

            allRows = rows
            ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Catch ex As OperationCanceledException
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Cancelled"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
        Catch ex As Exception
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Error running report"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
        Finally
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True

            Dim current As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
            btnExportCsv.Enabled = (current IsNot Nothing AndAlso current.Count > 0)
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Sub ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Dim mode As String = TryCast(cboFilter.SelectedItem, String)
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mode) Then mode = FilterMode.AllUnbalanced

        Dim filtered As IEnumerable(Of BalanceRow) = allRows

        Select Case mode
            Case FilterMode.NoMapping
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping)
            Case FilterMode.DeltaOnly
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping)
            Case Else
        End Select

        Dim sorted As List(Of BalanceRow) =
            filtered.OrderByDescending(Function(r) If(r.IsNoMapping, Decimal.MaxValue, Math.Abs(r.DeltaValue))).ToList()

        dgv.DataSource = sorted

        Dim noMap As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim deltaRows As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim showing As Integer = sorted.Count

        lblStatusTop.Text = "Report complete"
        lblStatusBottom.Text = $"Showing: {showing:N0} | Total: {allRows.Count:N0} | No mapping: {noMap:N0} | Delta rows: {deltaRows:N0}"

        btnExportCsv.Enabled = (showing > 0)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function ComputeRows(
        ledgerPath As String,
        checkInvPath As String,
        invoiceChkPath As String,
        token As CancellationToken,
        progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo)
    ) As List(Of BalanceRow)

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading ledger...", 0, 0))

        Dim ledger As List(Of LedgerEntry) = LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(ledgerPath)
        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading CHECK.INV...", 0, 0))

        Dim invIndex As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Long))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        If IO.File.Exists(checkInvPath) Then
            Try
                Dim blocks = CheckInvReader.ReadAll(checkInvPath)
                Dim i As Integer = 0
                For Each b In blocks
                    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                    i += 1
                    If (i Mod 250) = 0 Then
                        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Indexing CHECK.INV...", i, blocks.Count))
                    End If

                    Dim key = BuildKey(b.CustomerCode, b.CheckNumber)
                    Dim lst As List(Of Long) = Nothing
                    If Not invIndex.TryGetValue(key, lst) Then
                        lst = New List(Of Long)()
                        invIndex(key) = lst
                    End If

                    If b.Invoices IsNot Nothing Then
                        For Each s In b.Invoices
                            Dim n As Long
                            If Long.TryParse(If(s, "").Trim(), n) Then
                                lst.Add(n)
                            End If
                        Next
                    End If
                Next
            Catch
            End Try
        End If

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", 0, ledger.Count))

        Dim amtCache As New Dictionary(Of Long, Decimal)()
        Dim rows As New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim idx As Integer = 0
        For Each e In ledger
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

            idx += 1
            If (idx Mod 250) = 0 Then
                progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", idx, ledger.Count))
            End If

            Dim key = BuildKey(e.Customer, e.CheckNumber)

            Dim invNos As List(Of Long) = Nothing
            Dim hasMapping As Boolean = invIndex.TryGetValue(key, invNos)

            If Not hasMapping OrElse invNos Is Nothing OrElse invNos.Count = 0 Then
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = 0,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = 0D,
                    .DeltaValue = 0D,
                    .Note = "No CHECK.INV mapping",
                    .IsNoMapping = True
                })
                Continue For
            End If

            Dim sum As Decimal = 0D
            Dim foundAny As Boolean = False

            For Each invNo In invNos
                token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

                Dim a As Decimal = 0D
                If amtCache.TryGetValue(invNo, a) Then
                    sum += a
                    foundAny = True
                Else
                    Dim rec = InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(invoiceChkPath, invNo)
                    If rec.IsFound Then
                        a = rec.Amount
                        amtCache(invNo) = a
                        sum += a
                        foundAny = True
                    Else
                        amtCache(invNo) = 0D
                    End If
                End If
            Next

            Dim delta As Decimal = sum - e.Amount
            Dim unbalanced As Boolean = (Not foundAny) OrElse (Math.Abs(delta) >= Tolerance)

            If unbalanced Then
                Dim note As String = If(Not foundAny, "Invoices not found in INVOICE.CHK", "")
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = invNos.Count,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = sum,
                    .DeltaValue = delta,
                    .Note = note,
                    .IsNoMapping = False
                })
            End If
        Next

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Done.", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
        Return rows
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub FireAndForget(t As Task)
        If t Is Nothing Then Return

        t.ContinueWith(
            Sub(completed As Task)
                Dim ignored = completed.Exception
            End Sub,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted,
            TaskScheduler.Default
        )
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function BuildKey(code As String, checkNum As String) As String
        Return If(code, "").TrimEnd() & "|" & If(checkNum, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrim(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrimEnd(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").TrimEnd()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function Csv(s As String) As String
        Dim v As String = If(s, "")
        Dim mustQuote As Boolean =
            (v.Contains(","c) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Quote) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Cr) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Lf))

        If mustQuote Then
            v = v.Replace("""", """""")
            v = """" & v & """"
        End If

        Return v
    End Function

    Private NotInheritable Class FilterMode
        Public Const AllUnbalanced As String = "All unbalanced"
        Public Const NoMapping As String = "No CHECK.INV mapping"
        Public Const DeltaOnly As String = "Delta rows (has mapping)"
    End Class

    Private NotInheritable Class ProgressInfo
        Public ReadOnly Property Message As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Current As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Total As Integer

        Public Sub New(message As String, current As Integer, total As Integer)
            Me.Message = message
            Me.Current = current
            Me.Total = total
        End Sub
    End Class

    Private Class BalanceRow
        Public Property Customer As String
        Public Property DateText As String
        Public Property CheckNumber As String

        Public Property CheckAmountValue As Decimal
        Public Property InvoiceCountValue As Integer
        Public Property InvoiceSumValue As Decimal
        Public Property DeltaValue As Decimal

        Public Property Note As String
        Public Property IsNoMapping As Boolean

        Public ReadOnly Property CheckAmount As String
            Get
                Return CheckAmountValue.ToString("C")
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceCount As String
            Get
                Return InvoiceCountValue.ToString()
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceSum As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", InvoiceSumValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property Delta As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", DeltaValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class
End Class
```

Your pasted file had an internal mismatch:
- fields defined as:
  - `lblStatusTop`
  - `lblStatusBottom`
- but parts of the code still used:
  - `lblStatus`
  - `lblStatusCount`

So even before runtime behavior, that version was inconsistent.

This replacement makes the naming consistent everywhere.

The best way to do this is to centralize the title styling in one place, instead of manually setting:

- color
- size
- alignment

independently in each form.

## Copilot

Yes — the screenshot makes the problem clear.

## What’s happening
The old progress label is **still occupying space in the command bar after the report finishes**, and the completed text is not fully replacing/relayouting that status area. That’s why you still see a leftover truncated:

- `Compu`

at the far right.

So this is not really a compute-logic issue anymore — it’s a **layout/status-control issue**.

## Most likely cause
Your current UI uses:

- `pnlCommands` as a **left-to-right `FlowLayoutPanel`**
- `pnlStatus` as another flow panel inside it

When the report is running, the status panel grows to fit the progress text.  
After completion, the text changes, but the layout and autosizing behavior in the flow panel is leaving that right-edge clipped fragment behind.

In other words:
- the labels changed,
- but the flow layout is still rendering badly in that narrow remaining space.

## Best fix
Instead of letting the status area float as an autosized flow-layout item on the right, make it a **fixed-width status panel**.

That will stop the label from collapsing into a narrow leftover strip.

---

# What to change

## Replace this block in `BuildUi()`
```vb
lblStatusTop.AutoSize = True
lblStatusTop.Margin = New Padding(14, 2, 0, 0)
lblStatusTop.ForeColor = Color.Gainsboro
```

Right now you have:

# Why this should solve the visible `Compu`
Because this change does two things:

1. **prevents the status panel from auto-collapsing oddly**
2. **forces both labels into a fixed drawing area**

So instead of a leftover narrow label region showing `Compu`, the status area gets redrawn in a predictable fixed-width block.

---

# My diagnosis from the screenshot
The issue is **not** that the old string literally remains in memory.  
It’s that the status control area is being laid out too narrowly at the far right of a `FlowLayoutPanel`, so only part of the current text is visible.

That’s why you see:
- `Compu`

instead of a clean replacement.

---

Make the two edits:
1. fixed-width `pnlStatus` / labels
2. shorter completion summary line

Then rebuild and test again.

After completion, the far right should cleanly show something like:

- `Report complete`
- `1,234/1,234  No map: 500  Delta: 734`

instead of the leftover truncated word.

```vbnet
Imports System.Linq

    Private Sub btnCancel_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        If cts IsNot Nothing Then cts.Cancel()
    End Sub

    Private Async Sub btnRefresh_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Await RunReportAsync()
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnCopyRow_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim r As BalanceRow = TryCast(dgv.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If r Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim text As String =
            r.Customer & vbTab &
            r.DateText & vbTab &
            r.CheckNumber & vbTab &
            r.CheckAmount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceCount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceSum & vbTab &
            r.Delta & vbTab &
            r.Note

        Clipboard.SetText(text)
        lblStatusTop.Text = "Copied selected row to clipboard."
        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnExportCsv_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
        If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
            MessageBox.Show(Me, "There are no rows to export.", ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
            Return
        End If

        Using sfd As New SaveFileDialog()
            sfd.Title = "Export CSV"
            sfd.Filter = "CSV (*.csv)|*.csv|All files (*.*)|*.*"
            sfd.FileName = $"LedgerDoesntBalance_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv"
            If sfd.ShowDialog(Me) <> DialogResult.OK Then Return

            Try
                Dim sb As New StringBuilder()
                sb.AppendLine("Customer,Date,CheckNumber,CheckAmount,InvoiceCount,InvoiceSum,Delta,Note")

                For Each r In rows
                    sb.AppendLine(
                        Csv(r.Customer) & "," &
                        Csv(r.DateText) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckNumber) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckAmount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceCount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceSum) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Delta) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Note)
                    )
                Next

                IO.File.WriteAllText(sfd.FileName, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8)
                lblStatusTop.Text = $"Exported {rows.Count:N0} row(s) to CSV."
                lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            Catch ex As Exception
                MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
            End Try
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub cboFilter_SelectedIndexChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        ApplyFilterAndBind()
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_SelectionChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Sub dgv_RowPrePaint(sender As Object, e As DataGridViewRowPrePaintEventArgs)
        Dim row As DataGridViewRow = dgv.Rows(e.RowIndex)
        Dim data As BalanceRow = TryCast(row.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If data Is Nothing Then Return

        row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor
        row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
        row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black

        If data.IsNoMapping Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(250, 245, 190)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(253, 249, 205)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.Font = dgv.DefaultCellStyle.Font
            Return
        End If

        Dim absDelta As Decimal = Math.Abs(data.DeltaValue)
        If absDelta >= LargeDeltaSevere Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(249, 232, 236)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 238, 241)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        ElseIf absDelta >= LargeDeltaWarn Then
            row.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(252, 239, 242)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = Color.Black
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = Color.FromArgb(254, 244, 246)
            row.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = Color.Black
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Async Function RunReportAsync() As Task
        If cts IsNot Nothing Then
            cts.Cancel()
            cts.Dispose()
            cts = Nothing
        End If

        cts = New CancellationTokenSource()
        Dim token As CancellationToken = cts.Token

        btnRefresh.Enabled = False
        btnCancel.Enabled = True
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = False
        btnExportCsv.Enabled = False
        btnClose.Enabled = False
        cboFilter.Enabled = False
        lblStatusTop.Text = "Starting..."
        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
        dgv.DataSource = Nothing
        allRows = New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim ledgerPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.LedgerCur
        Dim checkInvPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.CheckInv
        Dim invoiceChkPath As String = LegacyDataPaths.InvoiceChk

        If Not IO.File.Exists(ledgerPath) Then
            UiFileErrors.ShowMissingRequiredFile(Me, ScreenTitle, ledgerPath)
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Missing LEDGER.CUR"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True
            Return
        End If

        Dim progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo) =
            New Progress(Of ProgressInfo)(
                Sub(p As ProgressInfo)
                    If token.IsCancellationRequested Then Return

                    lblStatusTop.Text = p.Message

                    If p.Total > 0 Then
                        lblStatusBottom.Text = $"{p.Current:N0}/{p.Total:N0}"
                    Else
                        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
                    End If
                End Sub
            )

        Try
            Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) =
                Await Task.Run(Function() ComputeRows(ledgerPath, checkInvPath, invoiceChkPath, token, progress), token)

            If token.IsCancellationRequested Then
                lblStatusTop.Text = "Cancelled"
                lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
                Return
            End If

            allRows = rows
            ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Catch ex As OperationCanceledException
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Cancelled"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
        Catch ex As Exception
            lblStatusTop.Text = "Error running report"
            lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
        Finally
            btnRefresh.Enabled = True
            btnCancel.Enabled = False
            btnClose.Enabled = True
            cboFilter.Enabled = True

            Dim current As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
            btnExportCsv.Enabled = (current IsNot Nothing AndAlso current.Count > 0)
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Sub ApplyFilterAndBind()
        Dim mode As String = TryCast(cboFilter.SelectedItem, String)
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mode) Then mode = FilterMode.AllUnbalanced

        Dim filtered As IEnumerable(Of BalanceRow) = allRows

        Select Case mode
            Case FilterMode.NoMapping
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping)
            Case FilterMode.DeltaOnly
                filtered = filtered.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping)
            Case Else
        End Select

        Dim sorted As List(Of BalanceRow) =
            filtered.OrderByDescending(Function(r) If(r.IsNoMapping, Decimal.MaxValue, Math.Abs(r.DeltaValue))).ToList()

        dgv.DataSource = sorted

        Dim noMap As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim deltaRows As Integer = allRows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsNoMapping).Count()
        Dim showing As Integer = sorted.Count

        lblStatusTop.Text = "Report complete"
        lblStatusBottom.Text = $"{showing:N0}/{allRows.Count:N0}  No map: {noMap:N0}  Delta: {deltaRows:N0}"

        btnExportCsv.Enabled = (showing > 0)
        btnCopyRow.Enabled = (dgv.CurrentRow IsNot Nothing AndAlso dgv.CurrentRow.DataBoundItem IsNot Nothing)
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function ComputeRows(
        ledgerPath As String,
        checkInvPath As String,
        invoiceChkPath As String,
        token As CancellationToken,
        progress As IProgress(Of ProgressInfo)
    ) As List(Of BalanceRow)

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading ledger...", 0, 0))

        Dim ledger As List(Of LedgerEntry) = LedgerCurReader.ReadAll(ledgerPath)
        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Loading CHECK.INV...", 0, 0))

        Dim invIndex As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of Long))(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        If IO.File.Exists(checkInvPath) Then
            Try
                Dim blocks = CheckInvReader.ReadAll(checkInvPath)
                Dim i As Integer = 0
                For Each b In blocks
                    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                    i += 1
                    If (i Mod 250) = 0 Then
                        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Indexing CHECK.INV...", i, blocks.Count))
                    End If

                    Dim key = BuildKey(b.CustomerCode, b.CheckNumber)
                    Dim lst As List(Of Long) = Nothing
                    If Not invIndex.TryGetValue(key, lst) Then
                        lst = New List(Of Long)()
                        invIndex(key) = lst
                    End If

                    If b.Invoices IsNot Nothing Then
                        For Each s In b.Invoices
                            Dim n As Long
                            If Long.TryParse(If(s, "").Trim(), n) Then
                                lst.Add(n)
                            End If
                        Next
                    End If
                Next
            Catch
                ' best effort
            End Try
        End If

        token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", 0, ledger.Count))

        Dim amtCache As New Dictionary(Of Long, Decimal)()
        Dim rows As New List(Of BalanceRow)()

        Dim idx As Integer = 0
        For Each e In ledger
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

            idx += 1
            If (idx Mod 250) = 0 Then
                progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", idx, ledger.Count))
            End If

            Dim key = BuildKey(e.Customer, e.CheckNumber)

            Dim invNos As List(Of Long) = Nothing
            Dim hasMapping As Boolean = invIndex.TryGetValue(key, invNos)

            If Not hasMapping OrElse invNos Is Nothing OrElse invNos.Count = 0 Then
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = 0,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = 0D,
                    .DeltaValue = 0D,
                    .Note = "No CHECK.INV mapping",
                    .IsNoMapping = True
                })
                Continue For
            End If

            Dim sum As Decimal = 0D
            Dim foundAny As Boolean = False

            For Each invNo In invNos
                token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()

                Dim a As Decimal = 0D
                If amtCache.TryGetValue(invNo, a) Then
                    sum += a
                    foundAny = True
                Else
                    Dim rec = InvoiceChkReader.ReadRecord(invoiceChkPath, invNo)
                    If rec.IsFound Then
                        a = rec.Amount
                        amtCache(invNo) = a
                        sum += a
                        foundAny = True
                    Else
                        amtCache(invNo) = 0D
                    End If
                End If
            Next

            Dim delta As Decimal = sum - e.Amount
            Dim unbalanced As Boolean = (Not foundAny) OrElse (Math.Abs(delta) >= Tolerance)

            If unbalanced Then
                Dim note As String = If(Not foundAny, "Invoices not found in INVOICE.CHK", "")
                rows.Add(New BalanceRow With {
                    .Customer = SafeTrimEnd(e.Customer),
                    .DateText = SafeTrimEnd(e.DateText),
                    .CheckNumber = SafeTrim(e.CheckNumber),
                    .CheckAmountValue = e.Amount,
                    .InvoiceCountValue = invNos.Count,
                    .InvoiceSumValue = sum,
                    .DeltaValue = delta,
                    .Note = note,
                    .IsNoMapping = False
                })
            End If
        Next

        progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Done.", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
        Return rows
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub FireAndForget(t As Task)
        If t Is Nothing Then Return

        t.ContinueWith(
            Sub(completed As Task)
                Dim ignored = completed.Exception
            End Sub,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted,
            TaskScheduler.Default
        )
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function BuildKey(code As String, checkNum As String) As String
        Return If(code, "").TrimEnd() & "|" & If(checkNum, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrim(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").Trim()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function SafeTrimEnd(s As String) As String
        Return If(s, "").TrimEnd()
    End Function

    Private Shared Function Csv(s As String) As String
        Dim v As String = If(s, "")
        Dim mustQuote As Boolean =
            (v.Contains(","c) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Quote) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Cr) OrElse v.Contains(ControlChars.Lf))

        If mustQuote Then
            v = v.Replace("""", """""")
            v = """" & v & """"
        End If

        Return v
    End Function

    Private NotInheritable Class FilterMode
        Public Const AllUnbalanced As String = "All unbalanced"
        Public Const NoMapping As String = "No CHECK.INV mapping"
        Public Const DeltaOnly As String = "Delta rows (has mapping)"
    End Class

    Private NotInheritable Class ProgressInfo
        Public ReadOnly Property Message As String
        Public ReadOnly Property Current As Integer
        Public ReadOnly Property Total As Integer

        Public Sub New(message As String, current As Integer, total As Integer)
            Me.Message = message
            Me.Current = current
            Me.Total = total
        End Sub
    End Class

    Private Class BalanceRow
        Public Property Customer As String
        Public Property DateText As String
        Public Property CheckNumber As String

        Public Property CheckAmountValue As Decimal
        Public Property InvoiceCountValue As Integer
        Public Property InvoiceSumValue As Decimal
        Public Property DeltaValue As Decimal

        Public Property Note As String
        Public Property IsNoMapping As Boolean

        Public ReadOnly Property CheckAmount As String
            Get
                Return CheckAmountValue.ToString("C")
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceCount As String
            Get
                Return InvoiceCountValue.ToString()
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property InvoiceSum As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", InvoiceSumValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property

        Public ReadOnly Property Delta As String
            Get
                Return If(IsNoMapping, "", DeltaValue.ToString("C"))
            End Get
        End Property
    End Class
End Class
```

## @testsubject117

weird. it's done now, but it says done. 51,250/51,351. why didn't it go through all 51, 351?

## Copilot

Because the **last progress update is only sent every 250 rows**, but the report can finish between update ticks.

In your code, progress is reported here:

```vb
If (idx Mod 250) = 0 Then
    progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", idx, ledger.Count))
End If
```

So if the total is `51,351`, the last periodic update before the end is:

- `51,250`

Then the loop finishes the remaining 101 rows, and after that the code sends:

```vb
progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Done.", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
```

So:

- it **did** process all `51,351`
- but the last live “Computing rows...” counter only reached the previous 250-row checkpoint

## Why you saw that
Most likely the UI briefly showed:
- `Done.`
- but still had the previous count:
  - `51,250/51,351`

That means the final completion text updated, but the bottom line was not replaced yet in the exact way you expected.

## Best fix
When the report completes, don’t leave the progress counter there.  
Explicitly overwrite it in `ApplyFilterAndBind()` with the final completed wording you chose.

Use:

```vb
lblStatusTop.Text = "Report complete"
lblStatusBottom.Text = $"{allRows.Count:N0} checked"
```

That will remove the stale `51,250/51,351`.

## Optional better live-progress fix
If you also want the live progress to always end on the exact final number before completion, add one final progress report after the loop and before `"Done."`:

```vb
progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Computing rows...", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
progress?.Report(New ProgressInfo("Done.", ledger.Count, ledger.Count))
```

But honestly, if the final display becomes:

- `Report complete`
- `51,351 checked`

then that’s enough and cleaner.

## Short answer
It probably **did** go through all `51,351`; the `51,250` is just the **last periodic progress checkpoint**, not the final processed count. The fix is to overwrite that stale progress line with your final completion message.

```vbnet
    Private Sub UpdateClock()
        lblHeaderClock.Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("dddd  MM-dd-yyyy      hh:mm:ss tt")

    Private Sub btnCancel_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)

    End Sub

    Private Sub btnCopyRow_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim r As BalanceRow = TryCast(dgv.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem, BalanceRow)
        If r Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim text As String =
            r.Customer & vbTab &
            r.DateText & vbTab &
            r.CheckNumber & vbTab &
            r.CheckAmount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceCount & vbTab &
            r.InvoiceSum & vbTab &
            r.Delta & vbTab &
            r.Note

        Clipboard.SetText(text)
        lblStatusTop.Text = "Copied selected row to clipboard."
        lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
    End Sub

    Private Sub btnExportCsv_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Dim rows As List(Of BalanceRow) = TryCast(dgv.DataSource, List(Of BalanceRow))
        If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then
            MessageBox.Show(Me, "There are no rows to export.", ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
            Return
        End If

        Using sfd As New SaveFileDialog()
            sfd.Title = "Export CSV"
            sfd.Filter = "CSV (*.csv)|*.csv|All files (*.*)|*.*"
            sfd.FileName = $"LedgerDoesntBalance_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv"
            If sfd.ShowDialog(Me) <> DialogResult.OK Then Return

            Try
                Dim sb As New StringBuilder()
                sb.AppendLine("Customer,Date,CheckNumber,CheckAmount,InvoiceCount,InvoiceSum,Delta,Note")

                For Each r In rows
                    sb.AppendLine(
                        Csv(r.Customer) & "," &
                        Csv(r.DateText) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckNumber) & "," &
                        Csv(r.CheckAmount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceCount) & "," &
                        Csv(r.InvoiceSum) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Delta) & "," &
                        Csv(r.Note)
                    )
                Next

                IO.File.WriteAllText(sfd.FileName, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8)
                lblStatusTop.Text = $"Exported {rows.Count:N0} row(s) to CSV."
                lblStatusBottom.Text = ""
            Catch ex As Exception
                MessageBox.Show(Me, ex.ToString(), ScreenTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
            End Try
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub cboFilter_SelectedIndexChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
```
