Do **not** just disable everything globally if you can avoid it. The safest fix is: **restore the quarantined DLL with an exception, then add exclusions for your repo/build folders and, if needed, add an Advanced Threat Defense exception for the built EXE/process.** Bitdefender’s docs say restored files can be automatically whitelisted if you enable **“Create exception for the restored files”** in Quarantine settings, and that file/folder exclusions are managed under **Protection → Antivirus → Settings → Manage Exceptions**. Advanced Threat Defense exceptions are separate and apply to running processes, not folders. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/2092/?utm_source=openai))

## What likely happened
Bitdefender quarantined `AMiOffice.dll`, so MSBuild later couldn’t copy or overwrite the build output. That would explain the “access denied”/copy failure immediately after the antivirus event. Consumer Bitdefender products include both traditional antivirus scanning and behavior-based protection like **Advanced Threat Defense**, so excluding only `bin`/`obj` from antivirus scans may not stop a later process-based detection on the built app. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/121668/?utm_source=openai))

## What to do now, in order

### 1. Restore the quarantined file correctly
Open Bitdefender **as Administrator**, then:
- go to **Protection**
- open **Antivirus**
- go to **Settings**
- choose **Manage quarantine**
- in **View Settings**, turn on **Create exception for the restored files**
- then select the quarantined `AMiOffice.dll` and click **Restore**. Bitdefender says restored files are returned to their original folder and automatically whitelisted when that setting is enabled. It also notes admin rights may be required to restore to protected locations. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/2092/?utm_source=openai))

If the restore still fails, don’t panic — rebuilding can regenerate the DLL once exclusions are set.

### 2. Add antivirus folder exclusions for your repo/build folders
Under **Protection → Antivirus → Settings → Manage Exceptions → Add an Exception**, add at least:
- your repo root, e.g. `C:\Users\CapnKirk\source\repos\AmiWinForms`
- or, if you prefer narrower scope, the project folders plus `bin` and `obj`

Bitdefender’s consumer support docs specifically allow excluding files/folders from antivirus scans via this path. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/13427/?utm_source=openai))

**My recommendation:** exclude the **repo root** for this specific development repo, not your entire `source\repos` tree unless you truly want that. That’s safer.

### 3. Add an Advanced Threat Defense exception if the EXE/DLL keeps getting flagged
Bitdefender’s docs say **Advanced Threat Defense** exceptions are for **applications/processes**, not folders. So if AV exclusions are in place but `AMiOffice.exe` still gets blocked at runtime/build time:
- go to **Protection**
- open **Advanced Threat Defense**
- add an exception for `AMiOffice.exe` (and possibly Visual Studio build-related output if needed)

This matters because ATD monitors running behavior, and folder exclusions alone may not stop it. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/130706/?utm_source=openai))

### 4. If needed, add a Ransomware Remediation exception
Bitdefender also documents separate **Ransomware Remediation** exclusions for trusted apps. If the issue appears as suspicious file modification or repeated rollback/protection behavior while your app runs, add a remediation exception for the app as well. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/16792/?utm_source=openai))

### 5. Rebuild cleanly
After exclusions are added:
- close Visual Studio
- end any stuck `AMiOffice.exe` / `dotnet.exe` if present
- delete `bin` and `obj`
- reopen Visual Studio
- build again

If the quarantined DLL wasn’t restored, a clean rebuild should recreate it once protection stops intercepting it.

## If you want Bitdefender to stop scanning “source and other folders”
You can exclude folders from **Antivirus** scanning, but that does **not** automatically disable all other modules. File/folder exclusions are configured in **Manage Exceptions** under Antivirus. For behavior monitoring, use **Advanced Threat Defense exceptions** for the executable/process. If you truly need full temporary suspension for troubleshooting, Bitdefender has a documented “temporarily disable protection” flow, but that’s best used only briefly while you confirm the cause. ([bitdefender.com](https://www.bitdefender.com/consumer/support/answer/13427/?utm_source=openai))

## Most likely cause
The biggest red flag is the inline lambdas inside `AddMenuButton(...)` calls in VB:

```vbnet
Sub() NotYet("Placeholder Item A")
```

Those are legal VB, but because this is an inherited WinForms form on .NET 10, and given the exact stack trace references local variable signature serialization, I suspect the compiler is choking on one of those closures in this context.

## Safer rewrite
Instead of inline lambdas, use named click handlers or small private methods.

```vbnet

        MyBase.OnLoad(e)

        SetMenuTitle("MISCELLANEOUS MENU - PLACEHOLDER")

        ShowVersionInHeader = False
        UpdateHeaderClock()

        StretchButtonsToPanelWidth = False

        flpRight.Padding = New Padding(12, 0, 24, 0)

        Me.Height = 720

        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "A", "Placeholder Item A - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderA)
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "B", "Placeholder Item B - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderB)
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "C", "Placeholder Item C - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderC)
```

## Copilot

This new stack trace points to a **compiler/options parse crash**, not your `FormMiscMenu` code. It’s crashing while parsing **imports/global imports/compiler options**. So the next step is **not** to keep editing the form — it’s to inspect project settings / `.vbproj` / global imports.

## Most likely causes
One of these is probably malformed:

- a bad **global import** in the project settings
- something corrupted in the `.vbproj`
- a broken response/options entry being passed to `vbc`
- less likely, a weird character introduced into a file that affects parsing

Because the stack includes:

- `ParseOneImportsDirective`
- `ParseImportsStatement`
- `OptionsValidator.ParseImports`
- `VisualBasicCommandLineParser.ParseGlobalImports`

that strongly suggests the issue is around **Imports configuration**, not menu logic.

---

## Fastest test
### 1. Unload and reload the project / inspect `.vbproj`
In Visual Studio:
- right-click project
- **Edit Project File**

Look for anything suspicious like:

```xml
<Import Include="...">
```

or malformed entries under VB settings / item groups.

### 2. Check project-level imported namespaces
In project properties:
- open **References** / **Imported Namespaces** if available for VB
- see if there is a blank, malformed, or strange namespace entry

A malformed imported namespace can crash older or buggy VB compiler paths.

---

## Important question
Did this start **only after** creating `FormMiscMenu`, or after changing any project settings too?

If you only added a new form file, then the project file may have gotten weirdly modified by the designer/tooling.

Not just reverting code in `FormMainMenu`, but actually:

- remove `FormMiscMenu.Designer.vb`
- remove `FormMiscMenu.resx` if it exists

from the project

Then build again.

If it still crashes, the form file is not the cause.

---

## Also inspect for file corruption at top of `FormMiscMenu.vb`
Sometimes a pasted bad character or broken header can confuse the compiler.

The file should begin exactly like this:

```vbnet
Option Strict Off
Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Windows.Forms
```

No text before it, no stray `<Global...` designer attribute, no duplicate `Class`, no merged designer content.

But again, your current stack trace suggests project/global imports more than this specific file.

Close Visual Studio, then delete:

- `bin`
- `obj`

Then reopen and build.

Because the compiler command line or cached design-time build state may be corrupted.

## Copilot

Then the click is reaching the **wrong handler**.

If clicking `(3)` still shows **Not Yet Implemented**, but `FormMainMenu.vb` already has:

```vbnet
Case "3"
    Using f As New FormMiscMenu()
        f.ShowDialog(Me)
    End Using
```

then one of these is true:

1. there is **another handler** for menu keys/buttons still mapped to `3`
2. the visible button’s click action was created earlier and still points to `NotYet("Miscellaneous Menu")`
3. the main menu button-building code is wiring the button directly to `NotYet(...)` instead of using `HandleMenuKey`

## Most likely cause
Your menu buttons are probably added with something like:

```vbnet
AddMenuButton(..., "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", Sub() NotYet("Miscellaneous Menu"))
```

So:
- keyboard `3` may use `HandleMenuKey`
- but clicking the visible button may use the delegate attached when the button was created

That would explain why clicking still gives Not Yet Implemented.

---

## What to check
In `FormMainMenu.vb`, find the code that builds the buttons — likely in something like:
- `BuildMainMenu()`
- `OnLoad()`
- or similar

Look specifically for the line for button `3`.

### If you find this:
```vbnet
AddMenuButton(flpRight, "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", Sub() NotYet("Miscellaneous Menu"))
```

change it to:

```vbnet
AddMenuButton(flpRight, "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", Sub() HandleMenuKey("3"))
```

or, even better if supported:

```vbnet
AddMenuButton(flpRight, "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", AddressOf OpenMiscMenu)
```

with:

```vbnet
Private Sub OpenMiscMenu()
    Using f As New FormMiscMenu()
        f.ShowDialog(Me)
    End Using
End Sub
```

---

## Best fix
Use a dedicated method.

### Add this to `FormMainMenu.vb`:
```vbnet
Private Sub OpenMiscMenu()
    Using f As New FormMiscMenu()
        f.ShowDialog(Me)
    End Using
End Sub
```

### Then make the button creation line:
```vbnet
AddMenuButton(flpRight, "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", AddressOf OpenMiscMenu)
```

And keep:

```vbnet
Case "3"
    OpenMiscMenu()
```

That way both:
- keyboard `3`
- clicking the button

do the same thing.

---

## Short answer
The **button click delegate** is probably still wired to `NotYet(...)`, even though the keyboard handler was changed.

### Find and fix the button creation line for `3`.

Most likely change:
```vbnet
AddMenuButton(... "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", Sub() NotYet("Miscellaneous Menu"))
```

to:
```vbnet
AddMenuButton(... "3", "Miscellaneous Menu", AddressOf OpenMiscMenu)
```

```
        Dim btn As New Button()

        btn.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft

        btn.FlatAppearance.MouseDownBackColor = Color.FromArgb(64, 64, 64)
        btn.AutoEllipsis = True

        MyBase.OnResize(e)
        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpLeft)
        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpRight)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ResizeButtonsToPanel(panel As FlowLayoutPanel)
        If panel Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim targetWidth As Integer =
            panel.ClientSize.Width -
            panel.Padding.Left - panel.Padding.Right -
            SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth - 6

        If targetWidth < 150 Then targetWidth = 150

        For Each c As Control In panel.Controls
            Dim btn = TryCast(c, Button)
            Dim lbl = TryCast(c, Label)

            If btn IsNot Nothing Then
                btn.Width = targetWidth
            ElseIf lbl IsNot Nothing Then
                lbl.Width = targetWidth
            End If
        Next
    End Sub

    Private Sub FormMainMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs) Handles Me.KeyPress
        Dim ch As String = e.KeyChar.ToString()
        If ch = vbCr OrElse ch = vbLf Then Return
        HandleMenuKey(ch)
    End Sub

    Private Sub HandleMenuKey(ch As String)
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(ch) Then Return

        Dim up As String = ch
        If up.Length = 1 AndAlso Char.IsLetter(up(0)) Then
            up = up.ToUpperInvariant()
        End If

        Select Case up

            Case "B" : NotYet("Invoice Generator")
            Case "C"

                    f.ShowDialog(Me)

            Case "H" : NotYet("Quick Message Flashing")

                    BackupService.RunBackupPriceListAndRolodex()
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup complete." & Environment.NewLine & AppPaths.BackupDir,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
                Catch ex As Exception
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup failed: " & ex.Message,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
                Finally
                    Cursor = Cursors.Default
                End Try

            Case "J" : NotYet("Print Out Customers Actual Names (spool real names)")
            Case "K" : NotYet("Cash Disbursements (BILL)")
            Case "L" : NotYet("Business Expenses Account (password)")
            Case "M" : NotYet("Quotation Form Generator (QUOTE)")
            Case "N" : NotYet("Rolodex (PHONE)")

            Case "O" : NotYet("Copy Spec Index")
            Case "P" : NotYet("Entire Ledger Viewing (ENTIRE)")
            Case "Q" : NotYet("Word Processor")

            Case "T" : NotYet("Change Date or Time")
            Case "X" : NotYet("Typewriter Mode")
            Case "Y" : NotYet("Ed Dean's Personal Backup")
            Case "Z"
                Using f As New FormPersonalCalendar()

            Case "1"

            Case "3"

            Case "4" : NotYet("Add Entries to Log Book")
            Case "6" : NotYet("Cadmium Cards")
            Case "7" : NotYet("Emergency PAYROLL System")

            Case "?"
                Using f As New FormAbout()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case Else
                ' ignore unknown keys
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub NotYet(feature As String)
        MessageBox.Show("Not implemented yet: " & feature, "Port status", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
    End Sub

End Class
```

## Copilot

`FormMainMenu.vb` looks correct. So if `(3)` still shows **Not Yet Implemented**, then the **FormMiscMenu itself is opening**, and one of its placeholder buttons is being clicked immediately after open — or more likely, **you’re seeing the placeholder submenu item behavior and interpreting it as the main menu action**.

To make sure, here’s the correct `FormMiscMenu.vb` you should have. When `(3)` opens it, the new screen title will clearly say placeholder, and only **its internal A–F buttons** will show “Not Yet Implemented” when clicked.

```vbnet
Option Strict Off
Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FormMiscMenu
    Inherits DosMenuFormBase

    Protected Overrides Sub OnLoad(e As EventArgs)
        MyBase.OnLoad(e)

        SetMenuTitle("MISCELLANEOUS MENU - PLACEHOLDER")

        ShowVersionInHeader = False
        UpdateHeaderClock()

        StretchButtonsToPanelWidth = False
        ButtonFixedWidthPx = 420

        flpLeft.Padding = New Padding(24, 0, 12, 0)
        flpRight.Padding = New Padding(12, 0, 24, 0)

        Me.Width = 1000
        Me.Height = 720

        BuildMiscMenu()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BuildMiscMenu()
        ClearMenu()

        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "A", "Placeholder Item A - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderA)
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "B", "Placeholder Item B - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderB)
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "C", "Placeholder Item C - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderC)

        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "D", "Placeholder Item D - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderD)
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "E", "Placeholder Item E - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderE)
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "F", "Placeholder Item F - Not Yet Implemented", AddressOf ShowPlaceholderF)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderA()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item A")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderB()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item B")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderC()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item C")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderD()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item D")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderE()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item E")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPlaceholderF()
        NotYet("Placeholder Item F")
    End Sub
End Class
```

That is the behavior you asked for.

```
                                                           f.ShowDialog(Me)

                                                                     Using f As New FormLedgerDoesntBalance()
                                                                         f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                                     End Using

        AddMenuButton(p, "S", "Sales Employee's checks", Sub()
                                                             Using f As New FormSalesEmployeesChecksMenu()
                                                                 f.ShowDialog(Me)
                                                             End Using
                                                         End Sub)
    End Sub

    Private Sub TightenChecksMenuButtons()
        For Each c As Control In flpLeft.Controls
            Dim btn = TryCast(c, Button)
            If btn IsNot Nothing Then
                btn.Height = 30
                btn.Margin = New Padding(3, 3, 3, 4)
                btn.Font = New Font("Segoe UI", 11.0F, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point)

    Private Sub BuildInlinePromptUi()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        pnlPromptHost.Dock = DockStyle.Bottom
        pnlPromptHost.Height = 96
        pnlPromptHost.BackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32)

        pnlPromptSeparator.Height = 2
        pnlPromptSeparator.BackColor = Color.Silver

        lblPrompt.AutoSize = False
        lblPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        lblPrompt.Height = 28
        lblPrompt.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        lblPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        lblPrompt.BackColor = pnlPromptHost.BackColor
        lblPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        lblPrompt.Padding = New Padding(0, 8, 0, 0)

        txtPrompt.Dock = DockStyle.Top
        txtPrompt.Height = 30
        txtPrompt.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle
        txtPrompt.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtPrompt.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtPrompt.Font = New Font("Consolas", 13.0F, FontStyle.Regular, GraphicsUnit.Point)
        txtPrompt.MaxLength = 100
        txtPrompt.Margin = New Padding(0, 6, 0, 0)

        AddHandler txtPrompt.KeyDown, AddressOf OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown

        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(txtPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(lblPrompt)
        pnlPromptHost.Controls.Add(pnlPromptSeparator)

        Controls.Add(pnlPromptHost)
        pnlPromptHost.BringToFront()
    End Sub

    Private Sub BeginViewChecksPromptFlow()
        _viewChecksCustomer = ""
        _viewChecksCheckNumber = ""
        _viewChecksYear = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer

        ShowPrompt("Enter customer name [Enter = all customers] ?", "")
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPrompt(promptText As String, currentValue As String)
        lblPrompt.Text = promptText
        txtPrompt.Text = currentValue
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = True
        txtPrompt.SelectionStart = txtPrompt.TextLength
        txtPrompt.SelectionLength = 0
        txtPrompt.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub HidePrompt()
        pnlPromptHost.Visible = False
        lblPrompt.Text = ""
        txtPrompt.Text = ""
        _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None
        Me.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub OnPromptTextBoxKeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.None Then
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            e.Handled = True
            HidePrompt()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode <> Keys.Enter Then
            Return
        End If

        e.SuppressKeyPress = True
        e.Handled = True

        Dim value As String = txtPrompt.Text.Trim()

        Select Case _viewChecksPromptStep
            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Customer
                _viewChecksCustomer = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                ShowPrompt("Enter Check Number [Enter = All Checks] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.CheckNumber
                _viewChecksCheckNumber = value
                _viewChecksPromptStep = ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                ShowPrompt("Enter Year [Enter = All Years] ?", "")
                Return

            Case ViewChecksPromptStep.Year
                _viewChecksYear = value
                HidePrompt()
                OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
                Return
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenLedgerViewWithPromptValues()
        Using f As New FormLedgerView()
            f.InitialCustomerFilter = _viewChecksCustomer
            f.InitialCheckFilter = _viewChecksCheckNumber
            f.InitialYearFilter = NormalizeYearFilter(_viewChecksYear)
            f.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Function NormalizeYearFilter(value As String) As String
        Dim s As String = If(value, "").Trim()

        If s = "" Then
            Return ""
        End If

        Dim yearNum As Integer
        If Integer.TryParse(s, yearNum) Then
            If s.Length <= 2 Then
                If yearNum <= 79 Then
                    Return (2000 + yearNum).ToString()
                Else
                    Return (1900 + yearNum).ToString()
                End If
            End If

            If s.Length = 4 Then
                Return s
            End If
        End If

        Return s
    End Function

End Class
```

## @testsubject117

can (For Future Use) be made smaller and have it move so it's below Misc. Menu?

## Copilot

Yes — but **not just by changing `FormMiscMenu.vb` alone**.

That title is being drawn by your shared base form, `DosMenuFormBase`, via `SetMenuTitle(...)`. So if you want:

- `MISC. MENU`
- with **`(For Future Use)`** underneath
- and the second line in a **smaller font**

then the change needs to happen in the **title-rendering logic in `DosMenuFormBase`**.

## Best approach
Keep `FormMiscMenu.vb` simple and pass a two-line title idea, but teach the base form to render:

- first line = normal title font
- second line = smaller subtitle font

## Most likely current setup
You probably have something like:
- a label for the menu title
- `SetMenuTitle(text As String)` sets `lblMenuTitle.Text = text`

If so, just putting a line break in the string may move the text down, but it **won’t make the second line smaller** unless you add separate subtitle support.

---

## Recommended solution
Add a subtitle capability to `DosMenuFormBase`, such as:

- `SetMenuTitle("MISC. MENU")`
- `SetMenuSubtitle("(For Future Use)")`

Then the base form shows:
- main title large
- subtitle smaller below it

## If you want a quick temporary test
You can try this in `FormMiscMenu.vb`:

```vbnet

```

### But:
- it may or may not display correctly
- it will likely use the **same font size** for both lines
- alignment may not look great

So it is only a quick experiment, not the best final solution.

---

## Best next step
Please paste the relevant part of **`DosMenuFormBase.vb`**, especially:
- the title label declaration
- `SetMenuTitle(...)`
- any title layout code

Then I can give you the **exact code** to make:

- `MISC. MENU`
- subtitle `(For Future Use)`

- proper spacing underneath

Yes, it can absolutely be done — but the right place to do it is **`DosMenuFormBase`**, not just `FormMiscMenu.vb`.

## @testsubject117

trying to publish get this: The expression "[System.Int32]::Parse('32') + 1" cannot be evaluated. 

## Copilot

That error is from your `.vbproj` MSBuild expression during publish.  
The safest fix is to stop using `Int32.Parse(...)` there and use an MSBuild property-function conversion that won’t choke during publish.

Replace your entire project file with this version:

```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>WinExe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0-windows</TargetFramework>
    <StartupObject>AMiOffice.My.MyApplication</StartupObject>
    <EnableNETAnalyzers>false</EnableNETAnalyzers>

    <UseWindowsForms>true</UseWindowsForms>
    <MyType>WindowsForms</MyType>

    <AssemblyTitle>AMiOffice</AssemblyTitle>
    <Product>AMiOffice</Product>
    <Company>Kirk Saffell</Company>
    <Description>AMiOffice Application</Description>

    <Version>1.0.0</Version>
    <AssemblyVersion>1.0.0.0</AssemblyVersion>

    <!-- Default fallback only; GenerateBuildInfo should replace this -->
    <BuildNumber Condition="'$(BuildNumber)'==''">0</BuildNumber>

    <FileVersion>$(Version).$(BuildNumber)</FileVersion>
    <ProductVersion>$(Version)</ProductVersion>
    <InformationalVersion>$(Version) (Build $(BuildNumber))</InformationalVersion>

    <GenerateAssemblyInfo>true</GenerateAssemblyInfo>

    <BuildInfoFile>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\Generated\BuildInfo.g.vb</BuildInfoFile>

    <Copyright>Copyright Kirk Saffell 2026</Copyright>
    <Title>AMiOfficeApplication</Title>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)'=='Release'">
    <DebugType>portable</DebugType>
    <DebugSymbols>true</DebugSymbols>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Update="FormAbout.Designer.vb">
      <DependentUpon>FormAbout.vb</DependentUpon>
    </Compile>
    <EmbeddedResource Update="FormAbout.resx">
      <DependentUpon>FormAbout.vb</DependentUpon>
    </EmbeddedResource>
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Hard-stop: never compile stray repo-root folders -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="..\My Project\**\*.vb" />
    <Compile Remove="..\obj\**\*.vb" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Remove="ESC Logo.jpg" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <EmbeddedResource Include="ESC Logo.jpg">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>Never</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </EmbeddedResource>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Update="My Project\Application.Designer.vb">
      <DesignTime>True</DesignTime>
      <AutoGen>True</AutoGen>
      <DependentUpon>Application.myapp</DependentUpon>
    </Compile>

    <Compile Update="My Project\Resources.Designer.vb">
      <DesignTime>True</DesignTime>
      <AutoGen>True</AutoGen>
      <DependentUpon>Resources.resx</DependentUpon>
    </Compile>

    <Compile Update="My Project\Settings.Designer.vb">
      <DesignTimeSharedInput>True</DesignTimeSharedInput>
      <AutoGen>True</AutoGen>
      <DependentUpon>Settings.settings</DependentUpon>
    </Compile>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <EmbeddedResource Update="My Project\Resources.resx">
      <CustomToolNamespace>My.Resources</CustomToolNamespace>
      <Generator>VbMyResourcesResXFileCodeGenerator</Generator>
      <LastGenOutput>Resources.Designer.vb</LastGenOutput>
    </EmbeddedResource>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Update="My Project\Application.myapp">
      <Generator>MyApplicationCodeGenerator</Generator>
      <LastGenOutput>Application.Designer.vb</LastGenOutput>
    </None>

    <None Update="My Project\Settings.settings">
      <CustomToolNamespace>My</CustomToolNamespace>
      <Generator>SettingsSingleFileGenerator</Generator>
      <LastGenOutput>Settings.Designer.vb</LastGenOutput>
    </None>
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Prevent compiling any stray BuildInfo file from the project root -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="BuildInfo.g.vb" />
    <Compile Remove="$(BuildInfoFile)" />
    <Compile Remove="FormMiscMenu.Designer.vb" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <EmbeddedResource Remove="FormMiscMenu.resx" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Increment build number on Release builds only -->
  <Target Name="IncrementBuildCounter" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile" Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Release'">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <BuildCounterFile>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\build-counter.txt</BuildCounterFile>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <WriteLinesToFile Condition="!Exists('$(BuildCounterFile)')" File="$(BuildCounterFile)" Overwrite="true" Lines="0" />

    <ReadLinesFromFile File="$(BuildCounterFile)">
      <Output TaskParameter="Lines" ItemName="BuildCounterLines" />
    </ReadLinesFromFile>

    <PropertyGroup>
      <CurrentBuildNumber>%(BuildCounterLines.Identity)</CurrentBuildNumber>
      <CurrentBuildNumber Condition="'$(CurrentBuildNumber)' == ''">0</CurrentBuildNumber>
      <BuildNumber>$([MSBuild]::Add($(CurrentBuildNumber), 1))</BuildNumber>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <WriteLinesToFile File="$(BuildCounterFile)" Overwrite="true" Lines="$(BuildNumber)" />
  </Target>

  <!-- Generate BuildInfo.g.vb for all builds -->
  <Target Name="GenerateBuildInfo" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <BuildCounterFile>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\build-counter.txt</BuildCounterFile>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <WriteLinesToFile Condition="!Exists('$(BuildCounterFile)')" File="$(BuildCounterFile)" Overwrite="true" Lines="0" />

    <ReadLinesFromFile File="$(BuildCounterFile)">
      <Output TaskParameter="Lines" ItemName="BuildCounterLines2" />
    </ReadLinesFromFile>

    <!-- In Debug, use the existing file value.
         In Release, keep the incremented value already set above. -->
    <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)' != 'Release'">
      <BuildNumber>%(BuildCounterLines2.Identity)</BuildNumber>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <PropertyGroup>
      <BuildNumber Condition="'$(BuildNumber)' == ''">0</BuildNumber>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <MakeDir Directories="$([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName('$(BuildInfoFile)'))" />

    <WriteLinesToFile File="$(BuildInfoFile)" Overwrite="true" Lines="Option Strict On&#xD;&#xA;Option Explicit On&#xD;&#xA;&#xD;&#xA;Friend Module BuildInfo&#xD;&#xA;    Friend Const ProductVersion As String = &quot;$(ProductVersion)&quot;&#xD;&#xA;    Friend Const BuildNumber As String = &quot;$(BuildNumber)&quot;&#xD;&#xA;&#xD;&#xA;    Friend ReadOnly Property DisplayVersion As String&#xD;&#xA;        Get&#xD;&#xA;            Return &quot;AMiOffice v&quot; &amp; ProductVersion &amp; &quot; (Build &quot; &amp; BuildNumber &amp; &quot;)&quot;&#xD;&#xA;        End Get&#xD;&#xA;    End Property&#xD;&#xA;End Module&#xD;&#xA;" />

    <ItemGroup>
      <Compile Remove="$(BuildInfoFile)" />
      <Compile Include="$(BuildInfoFile)" Visible="false" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>

</Project>
```

## What changed
This line:

```xml
<BuildNumber>$([System.Int32]::Parse('%(BuildCounterLines.Identity)') + 1)</BuildNumber>
```

was replaced with:

```xml
<CurrentBuildNumber>%(BuildCounterLines.Identity)</CurrentBuildNumber>
<CurrentBuildNumber Condition="'$(CurrentBuildNumber)' == ''">0</CurrentBuildNumber>
<BuildNumber>$([MSBuild]::Add($(CurrentBuildNumber), 1))</BuildNumber>
```

## Why
`Publish` is more sensitive about property-expression evaluation.  
`MSBuild::Add(...)` is usually safer there than `System.Int32::Parse(...) + 1`.

## If you want the smallest possible edit
You can replace only this part:

```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <BuildNumber>$([System.Int32]::Parse('%(BuildCounterLines.Identity)') + 1)</BuildNumber>
</PropertyGroup>
```

with:

```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <CurrentBuildNumber>%(BuildCounterLines.Identity)</CurrentBuildNumber>
  <CurrentBuildNumber Condition="'$(CurrentBuildNumber)' == ''">0</CurrentBuildNumber>
  <BuildNumber>$([MSBuild]::Add($(CurrentBuildNumber), 1))</BuildNumber>
</PropertyGroup>
```

If publish still errors after that, paste the new exact message and I’ll narrow it further.

I'm pasting in the end of the day master prompt, please review and follow the instructions there, if there  is any new data from today that needs to be included, please add it where you feel necessary: 

## Copilot

# 1. Executive Summary

Today’s work focused primarily on **main menu triage, placeholder/menu continuity, VB WinForms stability, and deciding what not to tackle yet** in the ongoing AMi modernization effort. The session stayed centered on preserving **legacy DOS familiarity** while unblocking forward progress in **AMiWinForms**, with some indirect project/build-system implications that matter for continuity.

A major objective today was to keep the **Main Menu option `(3) Miscellaneous Menu` visible and navigable** in the VB application even though its real functionality is not yet implemented. The decision was made **not** to remove or hide `(3)` from the main menu. Instead, the VB app should preserve DOS-style navigation and menu completeness by allowing the user to click `(3)` and open a real submenu screen, but that submenu should clearly communicate that it is **for future use / not yet implemented**.

Initial work attempted to add a `FormMiscMenu` placeholder form. That immediately exposed a series of **Visual Basic / Roslyn compiler crashes** under **.NET SDK 10.0.300**, including internal CLR / compiler fatal errors during parse, metadata emission, and standalone signature / attribute processing. These failures were not typical syntax errors; they were compiler-internal crashes. Troubleshooting found that one contributing issue was the project file’s explicit VB global imports block:
- `System`
- `System.Windows.Forms`
- `System.Drawing`

Removing that `<Import Include="..."/>` block from the SDK-style `.vbproj` allowed the project to build cleanly again. This was a meaningful technical finding because the compiler stack traces pointed directly into **VB command-line global import parsing** (`ParseOneImportsDirective`, `ParseImportsStatement`, `ParseGlobalImports`), and removal of the global imports block resolved that class of failure.

A second stability finding was that **new standalone form definitions** seemed more likely to trigger Roslyn instability unless they followed a pattern already known to work in the codebase. `FormMiscMenu` only became stable once it was rewritten to closely mirror the structure of an existing working inherited menu form, specifically **`FormLedgerMenu`**. The final stable `FormMiscMenu.vb` was implemented as a **code-only form** inheriting `DosMenuFormBase`, with the local designer file and `.resx` excluded from compilation in the project file:
- `FormMiscMenu.Designer.vb` removed from compile
- `FormMiscMenu.resx` removed from embedded resources

The final placeholder implementation preserves the menu option on the main menu, opens a real submenu, and uses a title eventually refined to:
- `MISC. MENU (FUTURE USE)`

This title was a deliberate UI wording decision after iterating through:
- `MISCELLANEOUS MENU - PLACEHOLDER`
- `MISC. MENU (FOR FUTURE USE)`
- final chosen simplification: `MISC. MENU (FUTURE USE)`

The internal submenu buttons were implemented as placeholders:
- A–F placeholder items
- each intentionally calls `NotYet(...)`

This preserves expected DOS-era menu-navigation structure while clearly signaling incomplete functionality.

There was also a behavior clarification around main menu click handling. The `FormMainMenu.vb` code was reviewed, including:
- `BuildMenu()`
- `AddMenuButton(...)`
- `HandleMenuKey(...)`
- `Case "3"` launching `FormMiscMenu`
- button click delegation via `HandleMenuKey(CStr(btn.Tag))`

That review confirmed that `(3)` in the main menu is correctly wired to open the new submenu through the same navigation pipeline used by other keys, and that the “Not Yet Implemented” response seen after clicking `(3)` was actually expected behavior of the **submenu’s internal placeholder buttons**, not evidence that the main menu launch wiring was wrong.

On planning/prioritization, the team revisited the remaining items from the earlier prioritized group of menu options. Current status of the original “1–5” bucket became:
- `3 Miscellaneous Menu` -> addressed for now as a working placeholder
- `H Quick Message Flashing` -> investigated earlier but intentionally skipped for now
- `N Rolodex` -> reviewed at the DOS layout level and found to be **more convoluted than expected**, so it was explicitly **earmarked for tomorrow**
- `F Price List Program` -> now the strongest likely next candidate
- `A Shop Card Generator` -> still likely more complex / workflow-heavy than `F`

A strategic decision was made **not to force Rolodex today** after reviewing its DOS layout and seeing that it likely has more complicated navigation/data interactions than initially hoped. That is important continuity context for tomorrow: Rolodex is not abandoned, but it has been consciously deferred because it appears more involved and needs a fresher session.

Finally, a publish-time MSBuild problem was identified in the `.vbproj` build-number increment logic. Publishing failed on:
- `The expression "[System.Int32]::Parse('32') + 1" cannot be evaluated.`

That came from the custom build counter target in the project file. A safer alternative using MSBuild property functions was proposed:
- replacing `System.Int32::Parse(...) + 1`
- with `MSBuild::Add($(CurrentBuildNumber), 1)`

This issue belongs to project/build infrastructure rather than functional UI, but it is important because it currently blocks publish even if the app builds in Visual Studio.

Overall, today moved the project forward by:
1. preserving the DOS main menu structure more faithfully,
2. adding a stable placeholder submenu for `(3)`,
3. discovering and fixing a key `.vbproj` VB compiler crash trigger,
4. identifying a reliable pattern for future inherited menu forms,
5. narrowing next work priorities,
6. and capturing that Rolodex needs a dedicated follow-up session.

# 7. Key Technical Findings

1. **The `.vbproj` VB global imports block was a real stability problem.**  
   Removing:
   - `<Import Include="System" />`
   - `<Import Include="System.Windows.Forms" />`
   - `<Import Include="System.Drawing" />`
   resolved one set of Roslyn/VB compiler crashes.

2. **Roslyn/VB under .NET SDK 10.0.300 is fragile enough that certain new form patterns can trigger internal compiler errors.**  
   Errors appeared in:
   - parse/global imports paths
   - metadata emission
   - standalone signature handling
   - custom-attribute emission

3. **A known-good existing form pattern matters.**  
   Rewriting `FormMiscMenu` to closely resemble `FormLedgerMenu` stabilized it.

4. **For code-only inherited forms, excluding local designer artifacts is acceptable and useful.**  
   The project now removes:
   - `FormMiscMenu.Designer.vb`
   - `FormMiscMenu.resx`

5. **`FormMainMenu` click handling is unified and not the source of the `(3)` confusion.**  
   Buttons call `HandleMenuKey(CStr(btn.Tag))`, so click and keyboard paths are consistent.

6. **The apparent “still getting Not Yet Implemented on (3)” issue was a workflow misunderstanding, not a wiring failure.**  
   `(3)` successfully opens `FormMiscMenu`; placeholder submenu buttons intentionally show the message.

7. **Rolodex is more complicated than hoped.**  
   After looking at the DOS layout, it was deemed convoluted enough to defer to tomorrow.

8. **Publish is currently blocked by custom MSBuild expression logic.**  
   The failing expression:
   - `[System.Int32]::Parse('32') + 1`
   should likely be replaced by MSBuild-native arithmetic.

9. **We intentionally did not modify `DosMenuFormBase` title rendering.**  
   A request to place smaller subtitle text on a new line under the main title was declined for now in favor of a simple title-string change.

it looks like the script to scan and find .md files in downloads, extract/split them, save them to the repo and sync the repo is not working. pasting file and run results here: 

## Copilot

Yes — the script is failing because that `switch` block is written with **regex-style cases but without `-Regex` on the `switch` statement**. In PowerShell, pattern cases like `'^jan-' { ... }` are valid only when the `switch` is using regex matching; otherwise the parser treats that layout as invalid in this context. Microsoft’s `about_Switch` docs show that regex cases require `switch -Regex (...) { ... }`. ([learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/about/about_switch?view=powershell-7.5&utm_source=openai))

## What to change

At or just above **line 465**, you likely have something like this:

```powershell
switch ($monthFolder) {
    '^jan-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jan', 'january' }
    '^feb-' { $monthFolder -replace '^feb', 'february' }
    '^mar-' { $monthFolder -replace '^mar', 'march' }
    '^apr-' { $monthFolder -replace '^apr', 'april' }
    '^may-' { $monthFolder -replace '^may', 'may' }
    '^jun-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jun', 'june' }
    '^jul-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jul', 'july' }
    '^aug-' { $monthFolder -replace '^aug', 'august' }
    '^sep-' { $monthFolder -replace '^sep', 'september' }
    '^oct-' { $monthFolder -replace '^oct', 'october' }
    '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november' }
    '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december' }
}
```

Change it to:

```powershell
switch -Regex ($monthFolder) {
    '^jan-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jan', 'january'; break }
    '^feb-' { $monthFolder -replace '^feb', 'february'; break }
    '^mar-' { $monthFolder -replace '^mar', 'march'; break }
    '^apr-' { $monthFolder -replace '^apr', 'april'; break }
    '^may-' { $monthFolder -replace '^may', 'may'; break }
    '^jun-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jun', 'june'; break }
    '^jul-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jul', 'july'; break }
    '^aug-' { $monthFolder -replace '^aug', 'august'; break }
    '^sep-' { $monthFolder -replace '^sep', 'september'; break }
    '^oct-' { $monthFolder -replace '^oct', 'october'; break }
    '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november'; break }
    '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december'; break }
    default { $monthFolder }
}
```

## Even safer version
If you’re assigning to a variable, use:

```powershell
$normalizedMonthFolder = switch -Regex ($monthFolder) {
    '^jan-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jan', 'january'; break }
    '^feb-' { $monthFolder -replace '^feb', 'february'; break }
    '^mar-' { $monthFolder -replace '^mar', 'march'; break }
    '^apr-' { $monthFolder -replace '^apr', 'april'; break }
    '^may-' { $monthFolder -replace '^may', 'may'; break }
    '^jun-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jun', 'june'; break }
    '^jul-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jul', 'july'; break }
    '^aug-' { $monthFolder -replace '^aug', 'august'; break }
    '^sep-' { $monthFolder -replace '^sep', 'september'; break }
    '^oct-' { $monthFolder -replace '^oct', 'october'; break }
    '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november'; break }
    '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december'; break }
    default { $monthFolder }
}
```

## If you want the simplest possible fix
Skip `switch` entirely and use a map:

```powershell
$monthMap = @{
    'jan' = 'january'
    'feb' = 'february'
    'mar' = 'march'
    'apr' = 'april'
    'may' = 'may'
    'jun' = 'june'
    'jul' = 'july'
    'aug' = 'august'
    'sep' = 'september'
    'oct' = 'october'
    'nov' = 'november'
    'dec' = 'december'
}

if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
    $abbr = $Matches[1].ToLower()
    $normalizedMonthFolder = $monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr]
} else {
    $normalizedMonthFolder = $monthFolder
}
```

## My recommendation
Use the **map version** if you want robustness.  
Use `switch -Regex` if you want the smallest edit.

```
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateScript({ Test-Path $_ })]
    [string]$RepoPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [datetime]$TargetDate = (Get-Date),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations",

    [string[]]$ScanPaths = @(

        "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$BranchName = "upload-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateRange(100, 10000)]
    [int]$ChunkLineCount = 2000,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$SkipGit,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Silent
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message"
}

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
}

function Get-DatePatterns {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    return @(
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }
}

function Get-ExportFilesForDate {
    param(
        [string[]]$Paths,
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $datePatterns = Get-DatePatterns -Date $Date
    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            continue
        }

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer } |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip" } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        $results += $files
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([object[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    return $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [object]$ZipFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [object[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [object[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName
        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = Get-NormalizedBaseName (($GroupFiles | Select-Object -First 1).Name)
    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$Today
    )

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    return Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -like "*_master-history.md" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1
}

function Build-MasterHistoryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$DailyBasePath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $today = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    $previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $DailyBasePath -Today $today
    $latestImportSource = if ($ImportSource) { $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

    $content = @()
    $content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
    $content += ""
    $content += "- Date: $today"
    $content += "- Last Updated: $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
    $content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $content += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $content += "- Source Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $content += "- Extracted To: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
        $content += ""
    }

    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Previous Running History"
    $content += ""

    if ($previousHistory) {
        $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Today's Latest Export"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $detectedVersionSource = if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) { $ImportSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $ImportSource.ImportFile.Name }

        $content += "- Source File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += "- Last Write Time: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
        $content += "- File Type: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
        $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
        $content += ""
        $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
        $content += ""

        try {
            $raw = Get-Content -Path $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw
            $content += $raw
        }
        catch {
            $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
            $content += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        $content += ""
        $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No export file for target date was found in the scan paths._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## New Notes"
    $content += ""
    $content += "_Add today's notes below._"
    $content += ""

    Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    return $historyFile
}

function Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$TargetFolder,
        [string]$MasterHistoryPath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $dateString = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $summaryPath = Join-Path $TargetFolder "${dateString}_executive-summary.md"

    $summary = @()
    $summary += "# Executive Summary - $dateString"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Source Overview"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- Master History: $MasterHistoryPath"

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $summary += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        $summary += "- Import File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $summary += "- Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $summary += "- Extracted Folder: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
    }
    else {
        $summary += "- No import source detected for the target date."
    }

    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Notes"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- This file is an operator-facing summary placeholder."
    $summary += "- Replace or expand this with a handoff summary after review."
    $summary += "- Recommended follow-up: ask Copilot to summarize the imported history into a project handoff."
    $summary += ""

    Set-Content -Path $summaryPath -Value $summary -Encoding UTF8
    return $summaryPath
}

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return $null
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -like "${baseName}_part_*.txt" } |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }

    return $partsFolder
}

function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    return switch -Regex ($monthFolder) {
        '^jan-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jan', 'january' }
        '^feb-' { $monthFolder -replace '^feb', 'february' }
        '^mar-' { $monthFolder -replace '^mar', 'march' }
        '^apr-' { $monthFolder -replace '^apr', 'april' }
        '^may-' { $monthFolder -replace '^may', 'may' }
        '^jun-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jun', 'june' }
        '^jul-' { $monthFolder -replace '^jul', 'july' }
        '^aug-' { $monthFolder -replace '^aug', 'august' }
        '^sep-' { $monthFolder -replace '^sep', 'september' }
        '^oct-' { $monthFolder -replace '^oct', 'october' }
        '^nov-' { $monthFolder -replace '^nov', 'november' }
        '^dec-' { $monthFolder -replace '^dec', 'december' }
        default { $monthFolder }
    }
}

function Assert-GitRepo {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        throw "RepoPath is not a Git repository: $Path"
    }
}

# Main flow
$targetDateString = $TargetDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
$todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $targetDateString
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

Assert-GitRepo -Path $RepoPath

Write-Info "Scanning export files for $targetDateString"
$exports = Get-ExportFilesForDate -Paths $ScanPaths -Date $TargetDate
$latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $exports
$importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

if ($importSource) {
    Write-Info "Selected import source: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
}
else {
    Write-Info "No import source found for $targetDateString"
}

$masterHistory = Build-MasterHistoryFile -Date $TargetDate -DailyBasePath $DailyBasePath -ImportSource $importSource
Write-Info "Built master history: $masterHistory"

$monthRecoveryFolder = Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName -Date $TargetDate
$repoSubfolder = Join-Path ("${monthRecoveryFolder}-recovery") $targetDateString
$repoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $repoSubfolder
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $repoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
Write-Info "Copied master history to repo folder"

if ($importSource -and $importSource.ExtractPath -and (Test-Path $importSource.ExtractPath)) {
    $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $importSource.ExtractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object {
            -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt"
        }

    foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
    }

    Write-Info "Copied extracted reviewable files to repo folder"
}

$summaryPath = Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile -Date $TargetDate -TargetFolder $repoTargetFolder -MasterHistoryPath $masterHistory -ImportSource $importSource
Write-Info "Built executive summary: $summaryPath"

$markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
    $partsFolder = Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $repoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
    if ($partsFolder) {
        Write-Info "Split markdown file into parts: $partsFolder"
    }
}

if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
}

if (-not $SkipGit) {
    Push-Location $RepoPath
    try {
        git checkout $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName" }

        git pull origin $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName" }

        git add $repoSubfolder

        $status = git status --porcelain
        if (-not $status) {
            Write-Info "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
        }

        $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $targetDateString"
        git commit -m $commitMessage
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git commit failed." }

        git push origin $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git push failed." }

        Write-Info "Synced chat history to repo: $repoSubfolder"
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}
else {
    Write-Info "SkipGit specified; files prepared but not committed/pushed."
}
```

## Copilot

The `switch -Regex` syntax in your pasted file is actually fine. The parse error is likely because you're running this in **Windows PowerShell 5.1**, and `return switch -Regex (...) { ... }` is one of those constructs that can parse badly depending on host/version/context.

## Direct fix
Rewrite `Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName` without `switch`.

Replace your entire function with this:

```powershell
function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    $monthMap = @{
        'jan' = 'january'
        'feb' = 'february'
        'mar' = 'march'
        'apr' = 'april'
        'may' = 'may'
        'jun' = 'june'
        'jul' = 'july'
        'aug' = 'august'
        'sep' = 'september'
        'oct' = 'october'
        'nov' = 'november'
        'dec' = 'december'
    }

    if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
        $abbr = $matches[1].ToLower()
        return ($monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr])
    }

    return $monthFolder
}
```

## Why this is better
It avoids parser weirdness entirely and is easier to maintain.

## One more thing: your command line is missing a required parameter
Your script defines:

```powershell
[Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
[string]$RepoPath
```

But your run command was:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "H:\AM\Scripts\Sync-CoPilotChatHistory.ps1" -Silent
```

That does **not** supply `-RepoPath`.

So after fixing the parse error, your next problem will be that PowerShell will prompt for or fail on `RepoPath`.

You need to run it like:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "H:\AM\Scripts\Sync-CoPilotChatHistory.ps1" -RepoPath "H:\path\to\your\repo" -Silent
```

## Also likely bug in your Git flow
This line:

```powershell
git add $repoSubfolder
```

may fail or behave inconsistently if `$repoSubfolder` contains backslashes or is treated oddly by git from the repo root.

Safer:

```powershell
git add -- $repoSubfolder
```

So change:

```powershell
git add $repoSubfolder
```

to:

```powershell
git add -- $repoSubfolder
```
