```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateScript({ Test-Path $_ })]
    [string]$RepoPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [datetime]$TargetDate = (Get-Date),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string[]]$ScanPaths = @(
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
        "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$BranchName = "upload-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateRange(100, 10000)]
    [int]$ChunkLineCount = 2000,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$SkipGit,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Silent
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message"
}

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
}

function Get-DatePatterns {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    return @(
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }
}

function Get-ExportFilesForDate {
    param(
        [string[]]$Paths,
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $datePatterns = Get-DatePatterns -Date $Date
    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            continue
        }

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer } |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip" } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        $results += $files
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([object[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    return $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [object]$ZipFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [object[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [object[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName
        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = Get-NormalizedBaseName (($GroupFiles | Select-Object -First 1).Name)
    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$Today
    )

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    return Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -like "*_master-history.md" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1
}

function Build-MasterHistoryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$DailyBasePath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $today = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    $previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $DailyBasePath -Today $today
    $latestImportSource = if ($ImportSource) { $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

    $content = @()
    $content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
    $content += ""
    $content += "- Date: $today"
    $content += "- Last Updated: $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
    $content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $content += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $content += "- Source Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $content += "- Extracted To: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
        $content += ""
    }

    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Previous Running History"
    $content += ""

    if ($previousHistory) {
        $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Today's Latest Export"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $detectedVersionSource = if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) { $ImportSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $ImportSource.ImportFile.Name }

        $content += "- Source File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += "- Last Write Time: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
        $content += "- File Type: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
        $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
        $content += ""
        $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
        $content += ""

        try {
            $raw = Get-Content -Path $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw
            $content += $raw
        }
        catch {
            $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
            $content += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        $content += ""
        $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No export file for target date was found in the scan paths._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## New Notes"
    $content += ""
    $content += "_Add today's notes below._"
    $content += ""

    Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    return $historyFile
}

function Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$TargetFolder,
        [string]$MasterHistoryPath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $dateString = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $summaryPath = Join-Path $TargetFolder "${dateString}_executive-summary.md"

    $summary = @()
    $summary += "# Executive Summary - $dateString"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Source Overview"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- Master History: $MasterHistoryPath"

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $summary += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        $summary += "- Import File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $summary += "- Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $summary += "- Extracted Folder: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
    }
    else {
        $summary += "- No import source detected for the target date."
    }

    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Notes"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- This file is an operator-facing summary placeholder."
    $summary += "- Replace or expand this with a handoff summary after review."
    $summary += "- Recommended follow-up: ask Copilot to summarize the imported history into a project handoff."
    $summary += ""

    Set-Content -Path $summaryPath -Value $summary -Encoding UTF8
    return $summaryPath
}

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return $null
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -like "${baseName}_part_*.txt" } |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }

    return $partsFolder
}

function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    $monthMap = @{
        'jan' = 'january'
        'feb' = 'february'
        'mar' = 'march'
        'apr' = 'april'
        'may' = 'may'
        'jun' = 'june'
        'jul' = 'july'
        'aug' = 'august'
        'sep' = 'september'
        'oct' = 'october'
        'nov' = 'november'
        'dec' = 'december'
    }

    if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
        $abbr = $matches[1].ToLower()
        return ($monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr])
    }

    return $monthFolder
}

function Assert-GitRepo {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        throw "RepoPath is not a Git repository: $Path"
    }
}

# Main flow
$targetDateString = $TargetDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
$todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $targetDateString
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

Assert-GitRepo -Path $RepoPath

Write-Info "Scanning export files for $targetDateString"
$exports = Get-ExportFilesForDate -Paths $ScanPaths -Date $TargetDate
$latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $exports
$importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

if ($importSource) {
    Write-Info "Selected import source: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
}
else {
    Write-Info "No import source found for $targetDateString"
}

$masterHistory = Build-MasterHistoryFile -Date $TargetDate -DailyBasePath $DailyBasePath -ImportSource $importSource
Write-Info "Built master history: $masterHistory"

$monthRecoveryFolder = Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName -Date $TargetDate
$repoSubfolder = Join-Path ("${monthRecoveryFolder}-recovery") $targetDateString
$repoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $repoSubfolder
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $repoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
Write-Info "Copied master history to repo folder"

if ($importSource -and $importSource.ExtractPath -and (Test-Path $importSource.ExtractPath)) {
    $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $importSource.ExtractPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object {
            -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt"
        }

    foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
    }

    Write-Info "Copied extracted reviewable files to repo folder"
}

$summaryPath = Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile -Date $TargetDate -TargetFolder $repoTargetFolder -MasterHistoryPath $masterHistory -ImportSource $importSource
Write-Info "Built executive summary: $summaryPath"

$markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
    $partsFolder = Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $repoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
    if ($partsFolder) {
        Write-Info "Split markdown file into parts: $partsFolder"
    }
}

if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
}

if (-not $SkipGit) {
    Push-Location $RepoPath
    try {
        git checkout $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName" }

        git pull origin $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName" }

        git add -- $repoSubfolder

        $status = git status --porcelain
        if (-not $status) {
            Write-Info "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
        }

        $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $targetDateString"
        git commit -m $commitMessage
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git commit failed." }

        git push origin $BranchName
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git push failed." }

        Write-Info "Synced chat history to repo: $repoSubfolder"
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}
else {
    Write-Info "SkipGit specified; files prepared but not committed/pushed."
}
```

1. defaults the remote expectation to `testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history`
2. can **auto-detect the local repo path** by searching under likely folders
3. verifies that the detected repo’s `origin` points to `testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history`
4. uses that repo automatically if `-RepoPath` is omitted

That way you do **not** need to fish around manually.

---

# Full replacement script

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RepoPath = "",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [datetime]$TargetDate = (Get-Date),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string[]]$ScanPaths = @(
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
        "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$BranchName = "upload-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateRange(100, 10000)]
    [int]$ChunkLineCount = 2000,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$ExpectedGitHubRepo = "testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string[]]$RepoSearchRoots = @(
        "H:\AM",
        "$env:USERPROFILE\source\repos",
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\GitHub",
        "$env:USERPROFILE\GitHub",
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Repos"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$SkipGit,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Silent
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-WarnMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[WARN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-ErrMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[ERROR] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
}

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
}

function Get-DatePatterns {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    return @(
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }
}

function Get-ExportFilesForDate {
    param(
        [string[]]$Paths,
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $datePatterns = Get-DatePatterns -Date $Date
    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            Write-WarnMsg "Scan path not found: $path"
            continue
        }

        Write-Info "Scanning path: $path"

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip" } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        if ($files) {
            Write-Info "Found $($files.Count) matching export file(s) in $path"
            $results += $files
        }
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([object[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    Write-Info "Best export candidate: $($best.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Best normalized group: $bestNormalized"
    Write-Info "Best detected version: $bestVersion"

    return $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [object]$ZipFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    Write-Info "Expanded zip: $($ZipFile.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Extracted to: $extractPath"

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [object[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [object[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName
        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = Get-NormalizedBaseName (($GroupFiles | Select-Object -First 1).Name)
    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$Today
    )

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    return Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*_master-history.md" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1
}

function Build-MasterHistoryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$DailyBasePath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $today = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    $previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $DailyBasePath -Today $today
    $latestImportSource = if ($ImportSource) { $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

    $content = @()
    $content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
    $content += ""
    $content += "- Date: $today"
    $content += "- Last Updated: $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
    $content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $content += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $content += "- Source Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $content += "- Extracted To: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
        $content += ""
    }

    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Previous Running History"
    $content += ""

    if ($previousHistory) {
        $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Today's Latest Export"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $detectedVersionSource = if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) { $ImportSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $ImportSource.ImportFile.Name }

        $content += "- Source File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += "- Last Write Time: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
        $content += "- File Type: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
        $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
        $content += ""
        $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
        $content += ""

        try {
            $raw = Get-Content -Path $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw
            $content += $raw
        }
        catch {
            $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
            $content += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        $content += ""
        $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No export file for target date was found in the scan paths._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## New Notes"
    $content += ""
    $content += "_Add today's notes below._"
    $content += ""

    Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    return $historyFile
}

function Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$TargetFolder,
        [string]$MasterHistoryPath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $dateString = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $summaryPath = Join-Path $TargetFolder "${dateString}_executive-summary.md"

    $summary = @()
    $summary += "# Executive Summary - $dateString"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Source Overview"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- Master History: $MasterHistoryPath"

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $summary += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        $summary += "- Import File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $summary += "- Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $summary += "- Extracted Folder: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
    }
    else {
        $summary += "- No import source detected for the target date."
    }

    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Notes"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- This file is an operator-facing summary placeholder."
    $summary += "- Replace or expand this with a handoff summary after review."
    $summary += "- Recommended follow-up: ask Copilot to summarize the imported history into a project handoff."
    $summary += ""

    Set-Content -Path $summaryPath -Value $summary -Encoding UTF8
    return $summaryPath
}

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return $null
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "${baseName}_part_*.txt" } |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }

    return $partsFolder
}

function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    $monthMap = @{
        'jan' = 'january'
        'feb' = 'february'
        'mar' = 'march'
        'apr' = 'april'
        'may' = 'may'
        'jun' = 'june'
        'jul' = 'july'
        'aug' = 'august'
        'sep' = 'september'
        'oct' = 'october'
        'nov' = 'november'
        'dec' = 'december'
    }

    if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
        $abbr = $matches[1].ToLower()
        return ($monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr])
    }

    return $monthFolder
}

function Get-GitOriginUrl {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        return $null
    }

    Push-Location $Path
    try {
        $origin = git remote get-url origin 2>$null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            return $null
        }
        return ($origin | Select-Object -First 1)
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}

function Test-RepoMatchesExpectedRemote {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$ExpectedRepo
    )

    $origin = Get-GitOriginUrl -Path $Path
    if (-not $origin) {
        return $false
    }

    return $origin -match [regex]::Escape($ExpectedRepo)
}

function Find-LocalRepoPath {
    param(
        [string[]]$SearchRoots,
        [string]$ExpectedRepo
    )

    foreach ($root in $SearchRoots) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $root)) {
            continue
        }

        Write-Info "Searching for local repo under: $root"

        $repos = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Directory -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName ".git") }

        foreach ($repo in $repos) {
            if (Test-RepoMatchesExpectedRemote -Path $repo.FullName -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedRepo) {
                Write-Info "Matched local repo: $($repo.FullName)"
                return $repo.FullName
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Resolve-RepoPath {
    param(
        [string]$RepoPath,
        [string[]]$SearchRoots,
        [string]$ExpectedRepo
    )

    if ($RepoPath) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $RepoPath)) {
            throw "RepoPath does not exist: $RepoPath"
        }

        if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $RepoPath ".git"))) {
            throw "RepoPath is not a Git repository: $RepoPath"
        }

        if (-not (Test-RepoMatchesExpectedRemote -Path $RepoPath -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedRepo)) {
            $origin = Get-GitOriginUrl -Path $RepoPath
            throw "RepoPath does not point to expected remote '$ExpectedRepo'. Origin is: $origin"
        }

        return $RepoPath
    }

    $detected = Find-LocalRepoPath -SearchRoots $SearchRoots -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedRepo
    if ($detected) {
        return $detected
    }

    throw "Could not auto-detect a local clone for GitHub repo '$ExpectedRepo'. Please pass -RepoPath explicitly."
}

try {
    $RepoPath = Resolve-RepoPath -RepoPath $RepoPath -SearchRoots $RepoSearchRoots -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedGitHubRepo
    Write-Info "Using local repo path: $RepoPath"
    Write-Info "Expected GitHub repo: $ExpectedGitHubRepo"

    $targetDateString = $TargetDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $targetDateString
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Write-Info "Scanning export files for $targetDateString"
    $exports = Get-ExportFilesForDate -Paths $ScanPaths -Date $TargetDate
    $latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $exports
    $importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

    if ($importSource) {
        Write-Info "Selected import source: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        Write-Info "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    }
    else {
        Write-WarnMsg "No import source found for $targetDateString"
    }

    $masterHistory = Build-MasterHistoryFile -Date $TargetDate -DailyBasePath $DailyBasePath -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built master history: $masterHistory"

    $monthRecoveryFolder = Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName -Date $TargetDate
    $repoSubfolder = Join-Path ("${monthRecoveryFolder}-recovery") $targetDateString
    $repoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $repoSubfolder
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $repoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
    Write-Info "Copied master history to repo folder: $repoTargetFolder"

    if ($importSource -and $importSource.ExtractPath -and (Test-Path $importSource.ExtractPath)) {
        $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $importSource.ExtractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt" }

        foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
        }

        Write-Info "Copied extracted reviewable files to repo folder"
    }

    $summaryPath = Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile -Date $TargetDate -TargetFolder $repoTargetFolder -MasterHistoryPath $masterHistory -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built executive summary: $summaryPath"

    $markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
        $partsFolder = Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $repoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
        if ($partsFolder) {
            Write-Info "Split markdown file into parts: $partsFolder"
        }
    }

    if (-not $Silent) {
        Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
    }

    if (-not $SkipGit) {
        Push-Location $RepoPath
        try {
            git checkout $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName" }

            git pull origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName" }

            git add -- $repoSubfolder

            $status = git status --porcelain
            if (-not $status) {
                Write-Info "No changes to commit."
                exit 0
            }

            $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $targetDateString"
            git commit -m $commitMessage
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git commit failed." }

            git push origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git push failed." }

            Write-Info "Synced chat history to repo: $repoSubfolder"
        }
        finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
    }
    else {
        Write-Info "SkipGit specified; files prepared but not committed/pushed."
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-ErrMsg "========== SCRIPT FAILED =========="
    Write-ErrMsg $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Full error details:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ($_ | Format-List * -Force | Out-String)
    Write-Host ""
    Read-Host "Press Enter to close"
}
```

---

## What this changes

### 1. Remote repo expectation is now built in
It now expects the GitHub repo to be:

```text
testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history
```

### 2. Local repo path can be omitted
If you don’t pass `-RepoPath`, it will search likely roots and find the local clone whose `origin` matches that GitHub repo.

### 3. It verifies the correct repo
So it won’t accidentally write into some unrelated local repo.

### 4. It won’t close instantly on failure
It now has a top-level `try/catch` with a pause.


```powershell

```

### Full run with git
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "H:\AM\Scripts\Sync-CoPilotChatHistory.ps1"
```

## Important note
This only works **if you already have a local clone** of `testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history` somewhere under one of these search roots:

- `H:\AM`
- `%USERPROFILE%\source\repos`
- `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\GitHub`
- `%USERPROFILE%\GitHub`
- `%USERPROFILE%\Repos`

If you **do not** already have a local clone, the script will now tell you clearly.

If you want, next I can give you a second version that will also:
- **create the branch if it doesn’t exist**, and/or
- **clone the repo automatically if no local clone is found**.

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [datetime]$TargetDate = (Get-Date),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string[]]$ScanPaths = @(
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
        "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$BranchName = "upload-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateRange(100, 10000)]
    [int]$ChunkLineCount = 2000,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$SkipGit,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Silent
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoPath = "C:\Users\CapnKirk\source\repos\Co-Pilot-Chat-History"
$ExpectedGitHubRepo = "testsubject117/co-pilot-chat-history"

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-WarnMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[WARN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-ErrMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[ERROR] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
}

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
}

function Get-DatePatterns {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    return @(
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }
}

function Get-ExportFilesForDate {
    param(
        [string[]]$Paths,
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $datePatterns = Get-DatePatterns -Date $Date
    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            Write-WarnMsg "Scan path not found: $path"
            continue
        }

        Write-Info "Scanning path: $path"

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip" } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        if ($files) {
            Write-Info "Found $($files.Count) matching export file(s) in $path"
            $results += $files
        }
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([object[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    Write-Info "Best export candidate: $($best.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Best normalized group: $bestNormalized"
    Write-Info "Best detected version: $bestVersion"

    return $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [object]$ZipFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    Write-Info "Expanded zip: $($ZipFile.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Extracted to: $extractPath"

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [object[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [object[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName
        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = Get-NormalizedBaseName (($GroupFiles | Select-Object -First 1).Name)
    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$Today
    )

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    return Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*_master-history.md" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1
}

function Build-MasterHistoryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$DailyBasePath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $today = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    $previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $DailyBasePath -Today $today
    $latestImportSource = if ($ImportSource) { $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

    $content = @()
    $content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
    $content += ""
    $content += "- Date: $today"
    $content += "- Last Updated: $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
    $content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $content += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $content += "- Source Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $content += "- Extracted To: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
        $content += ""
    }

    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Previous Running History"
    $content += ""

    if ($previousHistory) {
        $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Today's Latest Export"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $detectedVersionSource = if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) { $ImportSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $ImportSource.ImportFile.Name }

        $content += "- Source File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += "- Last Write Time: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
        $content += "- File Type: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
        $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
        $content += ""
        $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
        $content += ""

        try {
            $raw = Get-Content -Path $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw
            $content += $raw
        }
        catch {
            $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
            $content += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        $content += ""
        $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No export file for target date was found in the scan paths._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## New Notes"
    $content += ""
    $content += "_Add today's notes below._"
    $content += ""

    Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    return $historyFile
}

function Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$TargetFolder,
        [string]$MasterHistoryPath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $dateString = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $summaryPath = Join-Path $TargetFolder "${dateString}_executive-summary.md"

    $summary = @()
    $summary += "# Executive Summary - $dateString"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Source Overview"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- Master History: $MasterHistoryPath"

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $summary += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        $summary += "- Import File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $summary += "- Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $summary += "- Extracted Folder: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
    }
    else {
        $summary += "- No import source detected for the target date."
    }

    $summary += ""
    $summary += "## Notes"
    $summary += ""
    $summary += "- This file is an operator-facing summary placeholder."
    $summary += "- Replace or expand this with a handoff summary after review."
    $summary += "- Recommended follow-up: ask Copilot to summarize the imported history into a project handoff."
    $summary += ""

    Set-Content -Path $summaryPath -Value $summary -Encoding UTF8
    return $summaryPath
}

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return $null
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "${baseName}_part_*.txt" } |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }

    return $partsFolder
}

function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    $monthMap = @{
        'jan' = 'january'
        'feb' = 'february'
        'mar' = 'march'
        'apr' = 'april'
        'may' = 'may'
        'jun' = 'june'
        'jul' = 'july'
        'aug' = 'august'
        'sep' = 'september'
        'oct' = 'october'
        'nov' = 'november'
        'dec' = 'december'
    }

    if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
        $abbr = $matches[1].ToLower()
        return ($monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr])
    }

    return $monthFolder
}

function Get-GitOriginUrl {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        return $null
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        return $null
    }

    Push-Location $Path
    try {
        $origin = git remote get-url origin 2>$null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            return $null
        }

        return ($origin | Select-Object -First 1)
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}

function Assert-RepoIsCorrect {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$ExpectedRepo
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        throw "Local repo path does not exist: $Path"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        throw "Local repo path is not a Git repository: $Path"
    }

    $origin = Get-GitOriginUrl -Path $Path
    if (-not $origin) {
        throw "Could not read git origin from repo: $Path"
    }

    if ($origin -notmatch [regex]::Escape($ExpectedRepo)) {
        throw "Repo origin does not match expected GitHub repo '$ExpectedGitHubRepo'. Actual origin: $origin"
    }
}

try {
    Write-Info "Using local repo path: $RepoPath"
    Write-Info "Expected GitHub repo: $ExpectedGitHubRepo"

    Assert-RepoIsCorrect -Path $RepoPath -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedGitHubRepo

    $targetDateString = $TargetDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $targetDateString
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Write-Info "Scanning export files for $targetDateString"
    $exports = Get-ExportFilesForDate -Paths $ScanPaths -Date $TargetDate
    $latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $exports
    $importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

    if ($importSource) {
        Write-Info "Selected import source: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        Write-Info "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    }
    else {
        Write-WarnMsg "No import source found for $targetDateString"
    }

    $masterHistory = Build-MasterHistoryFile -Date $TargetDate -DailyBasePath $DailyBasePath -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built master history: $masterHistory"

    $monthRecoveryFolder = Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName -Date $TargetDate
    $repoSubfolder = Join-Path ("${monthRecoveryFolder}-recovery") $targetDateString
    $repoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $repoSubfolder
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $repoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
    Write-Info "Copied master history to repo folder: $repoTargetFolder"

    if ($importSource -and $importSource.ExtractPath -and (Test-Path $importSource.ExtractPath)) {
        $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $importSource.ExtractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt" }

        foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
        }

        Write-Info "Copied extracted reviewable files to repo folder"
    }

    $summaryPath = Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile -Date $TargetDate -TargetFolder $repoTargetFolder -MasterHistoryPath $masterHistory -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built executive summary: $summaryPath"

    $markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
        $partsFolder = Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $repoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
        if ($partsFolder) {
            Write-Info "Split markdown file into parts: $partsFolder"
        }
    }

    if (-not $Silent) {
        Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
    }

    if (-not $SkipGit) {
        Push-Location $RepoPath
        try {
            git checkout $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName" }

            git pull origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName" }

            git add -- $repoSubfolder

            $status = git status --porcelain
            if (-not $status) {
                Write-Info "No changes to commit."
                exit 0
            }

            $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $targetDateString"
            git commit -m $commitMessage
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git commit failed." }

            git push origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git push failed." }

            Write-Info "Synced chat history to repo: $repoSubfolder"
        }
        finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
    }
    else {
        Write-Info "SkipGit specified; files prepared but not committed/pushed."
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-ErrMsg "========== SCRIPT FAILED =========="
    Write-ErrMsg $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Full error details:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ($_ | Format-List * -Force | Out-String)
    Write-Host ""
    Read-Host "Press Enter to close"
}
```

## @testsubject117

ok, I was able to run that and it seemed successful. only thing is, it opens a notepad file and leaves it open. is this the full .md file? does it open it so it can parse and split? why doesn't it close the notepad window?

## Copilot

No — **Notepad is not used for parsing or splitting**.

## Direct answer
The script opens Notepad only for **you to review the generated master history file manually**.

This line does it:

```powershell
Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
```

So:

- parsing happens in PowerShell
- zip extraction happens in PowerShell
- `.md` discovery happens in PowerShell
- file splitting happens in PowerShell
- Notepad is just a viewer

## What file is it opening?
It opens this generated file:

```text
<DailyBasePath>\<yyyy-MM-dd>\<yyyy-MM-dd>_master-history.md
```

Example shape:

```text
H:\AM\DailyConversations\2026-05-21\2026-05-21_master-history.md
```

That file contains:
- header metadata
- previous running history
- the latest imported export content
- a notes section

So yes, it may be **very large**, and it may include the imported markdown content inline.

## Why doesn’t Notepad close?
Because `Start-Process` launches Notepad and **does not wait for it or manage its lifetime**. It just opens the file and leaves it for you.

That is normal behavior.

## If you do not want Notepad to open
You have two easy options.

### Option 1: always keep it closed
Change this block:

```powershell
if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
}
```

to:

```powershell
if (-not $Silent) {
    Write-Info "Master history file created: $masterHistory"
}
```

That keeps the console message but does not launch Notepad.

---

### Option 2: only open it when you explicitly ask
Add a new switch parameter like:

```powershell
[Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
[switch]$OpenMasterHistory
```

Then change:

```powershell
if (-not $Silent) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
}
```

to:

```powershell
if ($OpenMasterHistory) {
    Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
}
elseif (-not $Silent) {
    Write-Info "Master history file created: $masterHistory"
}
```

Then Notepad opens only if you run with:

```powershell
-OpenMasterHistory
```

## Best recommendation
Since this is an automation/sync script, I recommend **removing the Notepad launch entirely**.

Use this replacement:

```powershell
if (-not $Silent) {
    Write-Info "Master history file created: $masterHistory"
}
```

## Short answer
- **No**, Notepad is not required for parsing/splitting.
- **Yes**, it is probably opening the generated master `.md` file.
- It stays open because `Start-Process` just launches Notepad for manual review.
- If you want, remove that line and replace it with a log message.

If you want, I can give you the **entire file one more time** with the Notepad launch removed.

## @testsubject117

ok, so the file that opens in notepad is the full, non split end of day export of the chat, or just one of the many pieces it was split into?

## Copilot

It’s the **full generated master history file**, **not** one of the split parts.

## Specifically
This line opens:

```powershell
Start-Process notepad.exe $masterHistory
```

And `$masterHistory` is created here:

```powershell
$historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
```

So the file opened in Notepad is:

```text
yyyy-MM-dd_master-history.md
```

## What that file contains
It includes:

- metadata/header
- previous running history
- the latest imported export content
- notes section

So it is the **combined master file**.

## What gets split
Later, the script finds markdown files in the repo target folder:

```powershell
$markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder ...
```

and then splits each `.md` file into chunk files like:

```text
<baseName>_parts\<baseName>_part_001.txt
<baseName>_parts\<baseName>_part_002.txt
...
```

So the split pieces are saved separately as `.txt` files inside a `_parts` folder.

## Short answer
**The Notepad window is opening the full master `.md` file, not one of the split chunk files.**

If you want, I can also explain exactly **which files end up in the repo folder after one run**.

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [datetime]$TargetDate = (Get-Date),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DailyBasePath = "H:\AM\DailyConversations",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string[]]$ScanPaths = @(
        "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads",
        "H:\AM\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    ),

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$BranchName = "upload-chat-history",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateRange(100, 10000)]
    [int]$ChunkLineCount = 2000,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$SkipGit,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Silent
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoPath = "C:\Users\CapnKirk\source\repos\Co-Pilot-Chat-History"
$ExpectedGitHubRepo = "testsubject117/Co-Pilot-Chat-History"

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-WarnMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[WARN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-ErrMsg {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[ERROR] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
}

function Get-VersionNumber {
    param([string]$FileName)

    if ($FileName -match '\((\d+)\)(?=\.[^.]+$)') {
        return [int]$matches[1]
    }

    return 0
}

function Get-NormalizedBaseName {
    param([string]$FileName)

    $nameWithoutExtension = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($FileName)
    $normalized = $nameWithoutExtension -replace '\s*\(\d+\)$', ''
    return $normalized.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
}

function Get-DatePatterns {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    return @(
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("ddd_MMMM_d_yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
        $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy"),
        $Date.ToString("M-d-yyyy")
    ) | ForEach-Object {
        $_.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
    }
}

function Get-ExportFilesForDate {
    param(
        [string[]]$Paths,
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $datePatterns = Get-DatePatterns -Date $Date
    $results = @()

    foreach ($path in $Paths) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
            Write-WarnMsg "Scan path not found: $path"
            continue
        }

        Write-Info "Scanning path: $path"

        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".zip" } |
            Where-Object {
                $baseName = $_.BaseName.ToLower().Replace("-", "_").Replace(" ", "_")
                ($datePatterns | Where-Object { $baseName -like "*$_*" }).Count -gt 0
            }

        if ($files) {
            Write-Info "Found $($files.Count) matching export file(s) in $path"
            $results += $files
        }
    }

    return $results
}

function Get-LatestExportGroup {
    param([object[]]$Files)

    if (-not $Files -or $Files.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $ranked = $Files |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { Get-VersionNumber $_.Name }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    $best = $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
    $bestNormalized = Get-NormalizedBaseName $best.Name
    $bestVersion = Get-VersionNumber $best.Name

    Write-Info "Best export candidate: $($best.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Best normalized group: $bestNormalized"
    Write-Info "Best detected version: $bestVersion"

    return $Files | Where-Object {
        (Get-NormalizedBaseName $_.Name) -eq $bestNormalized -and
        (Get-VersionNumber $_.Name) -eq $bestVersion
    }
}

function Expand-ZipFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [object]$ZipFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$DestinationRoot
    )

    $extractFolderName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($ZipFile.Name)
    $extractPath = Join-Path $DestinationRoot $extractFolderName

    if (Test-Path $extractPath) {
        Remove-Item -Path $extractPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractPath -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZipFile.FullName -DestinationPath $extractPath -Force

    Write-Info "Expanded zip: $($ZipFile.FullName)"
    Write-Info "Extracted to: $extractPath"

    return $extractPath
}

function Get-MainMarkdownCandidate {
    param(
        [object[]]$MarkdownFiles,
        [string]$ExpectedBaseName
    )

    if (-not $MarkdownFiles -or $MarkdownFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $expected = $ExpectedBaseName.ToLower()

    $ranked = $MarkdownFiles |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = {
                $name = $_.BaseName.ToLower()
                if ($name -eq $expected) { 100 }
                elseif ($name -like "$expected*") { 90 }
                elseif ($name -match 'checklist|readme|guide|instruction|instructions') { 10 }
                else { 50 }
            }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true }

    return $ranked | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup {
    param(
        [object[]]$GroupFiles,
        [string]$TodayFolder
    )

    if (-not $GroupFiles -or $GroupFiles.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    $zipFile = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".zip" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($zipFile) {
        $extractRoot = Join-Path $TodayFolder "extracted"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $extractRoot -Force | Out-Null

        $extractPath = Expand-ZipFile -ZipFile $zipFile -DestinationRoot $extractRoot
        $expectedBaseName = Get-NormalizedBaseName $zipFile.Name

        $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

        $mdInside = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $mdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedBaseName
        if ($mdInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedMarkdown"
                ImportFile    = $mdInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }

        $jsonInside = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
            Sort-Object `
                @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
                @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($jsonInside) {
            return [PSCustomObject]@{
                SourceType    = "ExtractedJson"
                ImportFile    = $jsonInside
                ContainerFile = $zipFile
                ExtractPath   = $extractPath
            }
        }
    }

    $standaloneMdFiles = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    $expectedStandaloneBase = Get-NormalizedBaseName (($GroupFiles | Select-Object -First 1).Name)
    $standaloneMd = Get-MainMarkdownCandidate -MarkdownFiles $standaloneMdFiles -ExpectedBaseName $expectedStandaloneBase

    if ($standaloneMd) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneMarkdown"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneMd
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    $standaloneJson = $GroupFiles |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".json" } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{ Expression = { $_.Length }; Descending = $true },
            @{ Expression = { $_.LastWriteTime }; Descending = $true } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($standaloneJson) {
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            SourceType    = "StandaloneJson"
            ImportFile    = $standaloneJson
            ContainerFile = $null
            ExtractPath   = $null
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$Today
    )

    $previousFolder = Get-ChildItem -Path $BasePath -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -lt $Today } |
        Sort-Object Name -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $previousFolder) {
        return $null
    }

    return Get-ChildItem -Path $previousFolder.FullName -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*_master-history.md" } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
        Select-Object -First 1
}

function Build-MasterHistoryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$DailyBasePath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $today = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $today
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $historyFile = Join-Path $todayFolder "${today}_master-history.md"
    $previousHistory = Get-LatestPreviousHistoryFile -BasePath $DailyBasePath -Today $today
    $latestImportSource = if ($ImportSource) { $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName } else { "None" }

    $content = @()
    $content += "# Daily Copilot Running History"
    $content += ""
    $content += "- Date: $today"
    $content += "- Last Updated: $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))"
    $content += "- Latest Import Source: $latestImportSource"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $content += "- Import Source Type: $($ImportSource.SourceType)"
        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {
            $content += "- Source Archive: $($ImportSource.ContainerFile.FullName)"
        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {
            $content += "- Extracted To: $($ImportSource.ExtractPath)"
        }
        $content += ""
    }

    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Previous Running History"
    $content += ""

    if ($previousHistory) {
        $content += Get-Content -Path $previousHistory.FullName
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No previous running history file was found._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## Today's Latest Export"
    $content += ""

    if ($ImportSource) {
        $detectedVersionSource = if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) { $ImportSource.ContainerFile.Name } else { $ImportSource.ImportFile.Name }

        $content += "- Source File: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        $content += "- Last Write Time: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.LastWriteTime)"
        $content += "- File Type: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.Extension)"
        $content += "- Detected Version: $(Get-VersionNumber $detectedVersionSource)"
        $content += ""
        $content += "===== BEGIN IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
        $content += ""

        try {
            $raw = Get-Content -Path $ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName -Raw
            $content += $raw
        }
        catch {
            $content += "[ERROR] Failed to read import file: $($ImportSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
            $content += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        $content += ""
        $content += "===== END IMPORTED EXPORT ====="
    }
    else {
        $content += "_No export file for target date was found in the scan paths._"
    }

    $content += ""
    $content += "---"
    $content += ""
    $content += "## New Notes"
    $content += ""
    $content += "_Add today's notes below._"
    $content += ""

    Set-Content -Path $historyFile -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    return $historyFile
}

function Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile {
    param(
        [datetime]$Date,
        [string]$TargetFolder,
        [string]$MasterHistoryPath,
        [object]$ImportSource
    )

    $dateString = $Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $summaryPath = Join-Path $TargetFolder "${dateString}_executive-summary.md"

        if ($ImportSource.ContainerFile) {

        }
        if ($ImportSource.ExtractPath) {

    $summary += ""
```
