```powershell
    return $summaryPath
}

function Split-TextFileIntoParts {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OutputRoot,

        [int]$LinesPerPart = 2000
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceFile)) {
        return $null
    }

    $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($SourceFile)
    $partsFolder = Join-Path $OutputRoot ($baseName + "_parts")

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $partsFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Get-ChildItem -Path $partsFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like "${baseName}_part_*.txt" } |
        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $partNumber = 1

    Get-Content -Path $SourceFile | ForEach-Object {
        $chunk.Add($_)

        if ($chunk.Count -ge $LinesPerPart) {
            $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
            $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
            $chunk = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
            $partNumber++
        }
    }

    if ($chunk.Count -gt 0) {
        $partPath = Join-Path $partsFolder ("{0}_part_{1:D3}.txt" -f $baseName, $partNumber)
        $chunk | Set-Content -Path $partPath -Encoding UTF8
    }

    return $partsFolder
}

function Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName {
    param([datetime]$Date)

    $monthFolder = $Date.ToString("MMM-yyyy").ToLower()

    $monthMap = @{
        'jan' = 'january'
        'feb' = 'february'
        'mar' = 'march'
        'apr' = 'april'
        'may' = 'may'
        'jun' = 'june'
        'jul' = 'july'
        'aug' = 'august'
        'sep' = 'september'
        'oct' = 'october'
        'nov' = 'november'
        'dec' = 'december'
    }

    if ($monthFolder -match '^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)-') {
        $abbr = $matches[1].ToLower()
        return ($monthFolder -replace "^(?i)$abbr", $monthMap[$abbr])
    }

    return $monthFolder
}

function Get-GitOriginUrl {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        return $null
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        return $null
    }

    Push-Location $Path
    try {
        $origin = git remote get-url origin 2>$null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            return $null
        }

        return ($origin | Select-Object -First 1)
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}

function Assert-RepoIsCorrect {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$ExpectedRepo
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        throw "Local repo path does not exist: $Path"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git"))) {
        throw "Local repo path is not a Git repository: $Path"
    }

    $origin = Get-GitOriginUrl -Path $Path
    if (-not $origin) {
        throw "Could not read git origin from repo: $Path"
    }

    if ($origin -notmatch [regex]::Escape($ExpectedRepo)) {
        throw "Repo origin does not match expected GitHub repo '$ExpectedGitHubRepo'. Actual origin: $origin"
    }
}

function Save-EodBackupCopy {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$SourceFile,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [datetime]$Date
    )

    $backupFolder = "M:\Personal\Work Related\ESC\2026\AM\Visual Basic Conversion Project\Backed up CoPilot Sessions"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupFolder -Force | Out-Null

    $fileName = "Saved - Exported EOD Chat Session {0}.txt" -f $Date.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy")
    $destinationPath = Join-Path $backupFolder $fileName

    Copy-Item -Path $SourceFile -Destination $destinationPath -Force

    return $destinationPath
}

try {
    Write-Info "Using local repo path: $RepoPath"
    Write-Info "Expected GitHub repo: $ExpectedGitHubRepo"

    Assert-RepoIsCorrect -Path $RepoPath -ExpectedRepo $ExpectedGitHubRepo

    $targetDateString = $TargetDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
    $todayFolder = Join-Path $DailyBasePath $targetDateString
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $todayFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Write-Info "Scanning export files for $targetDateString"
    $exports = Get-ExportFilesForDate -Paths $ScanPaths -Date $TargetDate
    $latestGroup = Get-LatestExportGroup -Files $exports
    $importSource = Get-BestImportSourceFromGroup -GroupFiles $latestGroup -TodayFolder $todayFolder

    if ($importSource) {
        Write-Info "Selected import source: $($importSource.ImportFile.FullName)"
        Write-Info "Import type: $($importSource.SourceType)"
    }
    else {
        Write-WarnMsg "No import source found for $targetDateString"
    }

    $masterHistory = Build-MasterHistoryFile -Date $TargetDate -DailyBasePath $DailyBasePath -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built master history: $masterHistory"

    $backupCopyPath = Save-EodBackupCopy -SourceFile $masterHistory -Date $TargetDate
    Write-Info "Saved EOD backup copy: $backupCopyPath"

    $monthRecoveryFolder = Get-MonthRecoveryFolderName -Date $TargetDate
    $repoSubfolder = Join-Path ("${monthRecoveryFolder}-recovery") $targetDateString
    $repoTargetFolder = Join-Path $RepoPath $repoSubfolder
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $repoTargetFolder -Force | Out-Null

    Copy-Item -Path $masterHistory -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
    Write-Info "Copied master history to repo folder: $repoTargetFolder"

    if ($importSource -and $importSource.ExtractPath -and (Test-Path $importSource.ExtractPath)) {
        $filesToCopy = Get-ChildItem -Path $importSource.ExtractPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -in ".md", ".json", ".txt" }

        foreach ($file in $filesToCopy) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $repoTargetFolder -Force
        }

        Write-Info "Copied extracted reviewable files to repo folder"
    }

    $summaryPath = Build-ExecutiveSummaryFile -Date $TargetDate -TargetFolder $repoTargetFolder -MasterHistoryPath $masterHistory -ImportSource $importSource
    Write-Info "Built executive summary: $summaryPath"

    $markdownFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $repoTargetFolder -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".md" }

    foreach ($mdFile in $markdownFiles) {
        $partsFolder = Split-TextFileIntoParts -SourceFile $mdFile.FullName -OutputRoot $repoTargetFolder -LinesPerPart $ChunkLineCount
        if ($partsFolder) {
            Write-Info "Split markdown file into parts: $partsFolder"
        }
    }

    if (-not $SkipGit) {
        Push-Location $RepoPath
        try {
            git checkout $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to checkout branch $BranchName" }

            git pull origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to pull branch $BranchName" }

            git add -- $repoSubfolder

            $status = git status --porcelain
            if (-not $status) {
                Write-Info "No changes to commit."
                exit 0
            }

            $commitMessage = "Add chat history files for $targetDateString"
            git commit -m $commitMessage
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git commit failed." }

            git push origin $BranchName
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git push failed." }

            Write-Info "Synced chat history to repo: $repoSubfolder"
        }
        finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
    }
    else {
        Write-Info "SkipGit specified; files prepared but not committed/pushed."
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-ErrMsg "========== SCRIPT FAILED =========="
    Write-ErrMsg $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Full error details:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ($_ | Format-List * -Force | Out-String)
    Write-Host ""
    Read-Host "Press Enter to close"
}
```

## @testsubject117

1. Executive Summary
Today’s work focused primarily on main menu triage, placeholder/menu continuity, VB WinForms stability, and deciding what not to tackle yet in the ongoing AMi modernization effort. The session stayed centered on preserving legacy DOS familiarity while unblocking forward progress in AMiWinForms, with some indirect project/build-system implications that matter for continuity.
A major objective today was to keep the Main Menu option (3) Miscellaneous Menu visible and navigable in the VB application even though its real functionality is not yet implemented. The decision was made not to remove or hide (3) from the main menu. Instead, the VB app should preserve DOS-style navigation and menu completeness by allowing the user to click (3) and open a real submenu screen, but that submenu should clearly communicate that it is for future use / not yet implemented.
Initial work attempted to add a FormMiscMenu placeholder form. That immediately exposed a series of Visual Basic / Roslyn compiler crashes under .NET SDK 10.0.300, including internal CLR / compiler fatal errors during parse, metadata emission, and standalone signature / attribute processing. These failures were not typical syntax errors; they were compiler-internal crashes. Troubleshooting found that one contributing issue was the project file’s explicit VB global imports block:
•	System
•	System.Windows.Forms
•	System.Drawing
Removing that <Import Include="..."/> block from the SDK-style .vbproj allowed the project to build cleanly again. This was a meaningful technical finding because the compiler stack traces pointed directly into VB command-line global import parsing (ParseOneImportsDirective, ParseImportsStatement, ParseGlobalImports), and removal of the global imports block resolved that class of failure.
A second stability finding was that new standalone form definitions seemed more likely to trigger Roslyn instability unless they followed a pattern already known to work in the codebase. FormMiscMenu only became stable once it was rewritten to closely mirror the structure of an existing working inherited menu form, specifically FormLedgerMenu. The final stable FormMiscMenu.vb was implemented as a code-only form inheriting DosMenuFormBase, with the local designer file and .resx excluded from compilation in the project file:
•	FormMiscMenu.Designer.vb removed from compile
•	FormMiscMenu.resx removed from embedded resources
The final placeholder implementation preserves the menu option on the main menu, opens a real submenu, and uses a title eventually refined to:
•	MISC. MENU (FUTURE USE)
This title was a deliberate UI wording decision after iterating through:
•	MISCELLANEOUS MENU - PLACEHOLDER
•	MISC. MENU (FOR FUTURE USE)
•	final chosen simplification: MISC. MENU (FUTURE USE)
The internal submenu buttons were implemented as placeholders:
•	A–F placeholder items
•	each intentionally calls NotYet(...)
This preserves expected DOS-era menu-navigation structure while clearly signaling incomplete functionality.
There was also a behavior clarification around main menu click handling. The FormMainMenu.vb code was reviewed, including:
•	BuildMenu()
•	AddMenuButton(...)
•	HandleMenuKey(...)
•	Case "3" launching FormMiscMenu
•	button click delegation via HandleMenuKey(CStr(btn.Tag))
That review confirmed that (3) in the main menu is correctly wired to open the new submenu through the same navigation pipeline used by other keys, and that the “Not Yet Implemented” response seen after clicking (3) was actually expected behavior of the submenu’s internal placeholder buttons, not evidence that the main menu launch wiring was wrong.
On planning/prioritization, the team revisited the remaining items from the earlier prioritized group of menu options. Current status of the original “1–5” bucket became:
•	3 Miscellaneous Menu -> addressed for now as a working placeholder
•	H Quick Message Flashing -> investigated earlier but intentionally skipped for now
•	N Rolodex -> reviewed at the DOS layout level and found to be more convoluted than expected, so it was explicitly earmarked for tomorrow
•	F Price List Program -> now the strongest likely next candidate
•	A Shop Card Generator -> still likely more complex / workflow-heavy than F
A strategic decision was made not to force Rolodex today after reviewing its DOS layout and seeing that it likely has more complicated navigation/data interactions than initially hoped. That is important continuity context for tomorrow: Rolodex is not abandoned, but it has been consciously deferred because it appears more involved and needs a fresher session.
Finally, a publish-time MSBuild problem was identified in the .vbproj build-number increment logic. Publishing failed on:
•	The expression "[System.Int32]::Parse('32') + 1" cannot be evaluated.
That came from the custom build counter target in the project file. A safer alternative using MSBuild property functions was proposed:
•	replacing System.Int32::Parse(...) + 1
•	with MSBuild::Add($(CurrentBuildNumber), 1)
This issue belongs to project/build infrastructure rather than functional UI, but it is important because it currently blocks publish even if the app builds in Visual Studio.
Overall, today moved the project forward by:
1.	preserving the DOS main menu structure more faithfully,
2.	adding a stable placeholder submenu for (3),
3.	discovering and fixing a key .vbproj VB compiler crash trigger,
4.	identifying a reliable pattern for future inherited menu forms,
5.	narrowing next work priorities,
6.	and capturing that Rolodex needs a dedicated follow-up session.

## Copilot

This is very useful. The scan substantially sharpens the picture.

## Bottom line
Your earlier statement was **directionally right but too narrow**.

The four files are still central:

- `INVOICE.CHK`
- `LEDGER.CUR`
- `CHECK.INV`
- `OTHER.CHK`

But the repo scan strongly suggests the real parity target is **broader end-to-end accounting mutation behavior**, not just “write these four files somehow.”

## Most important takeaways from the DOS scan

### 1. The DOS app is modular and menu-driven
Key DOS modules now look like:

- `START.ASC` → chains into main menu
- `MAINM.ASC` / `M.ASC` → main dispatch hub
- `INVOICE_.ASC` → invoice generation/update
- `LEDGER.ASC` → checks / cash receipts / check↔invoice linkage
- `BOOT.ASC` → void/update/period-end maintenance
- `B.BAS` / `BI.BAS` → cash disbursements/AP
- `PHONE.ASC` → rolodex/contact subsystem
- `ENTIRE.ASC` → invoice inquiry/reporting

That means the VB port should continue to think in terms of **legacy workflow modules**, not generic CRUD screens.

---

### 2. `LEDGER.ASC` is the key DOS source for your current checks work
This is the most relevant DOS file for:

- `FormAddChecks.vb`
- check posting
- check deletion
- invoice/check cross-reference
- “other checks”
- ledger posting semantics

So if the current resume point is around:

- `CompanyInfo.vb`
- `CompanyLookupService.vb`
- `FormAddChecks.vb`

then **`LEDGER.ASC` is almost certainly the primary DOS behavior source-of-truth**.

---

### 3. The “biggest remaining gap” is probably orchestration parity
The scan shows all four parity-critical files are deeply coupled inside the DOS flow:

- posting a check writes:
  - `LEDGER.CUR`
  - `CHECK.INV`
  - updates `INVOICE.CHK`
- deleting a check rewrites/reset logic across:
  - `LEDGER.CUR`
  - `CHECK.INV`
  - `INVOICE.CHK`
- “other checks” has its own side path:
  - `OTHER.CHK`

So the gap is likely **not** just individual reader/writer support anymore.

The real missing piece is more likely:

- exact sequencing
- consistency across multiple files
- delete/reset behavior
- invoice paid/unpaid flag transitions
- matching the DOS posting rules and prompts

---

### 4. There are more accounting side effects than the four core files
The DOS scan explicitly calls out additional write-coupled files:

- `JOURNAL.CUR`
- `LOGBOOK.<YY>`
- `INVOICE.NUM`
- `LASTINVO.ICE`
- `MONTH.INV`
- `VOIDS.DAT`

So if we only focus on the four check-related files, we may still miss broader accounting parity.

That matters especially if:
- invoice creation is already partly ported
- void/update logic matters
- later reconciliation depends on those auxiliary files

---

### 5. Company lookup in DOS is more concrete now
The scan gives likely DOS equivalents for your VB resume-point files:

#### `CompanyInfo.vb`
Likely corresponds to:
- `REALNAME.DAT`
- `PRC\<CODE>.PRC`

#### `CompanyLookupService.vb`
Likely corresponds to DOS behaviors like:
- open/check existence of `PRC\<company>.PRC`
- fallback prefix matching using PRC directory listing
- related name/contact lookup behavior via rolodex files

#### `FormAddChecks.vb`
Likely corresponds directly to:
- `LEDGER.ASC` add-check flow
- invoice selection/validation
- balance checking
- posting updates
- delete/reset behavior

## @testsubject117

how many file parts can I send at one time?

## Copilot

You can usually send **one reasonably sized part at a time most safely**.

## Practical recommendation
For these big chat-history files, send:

- **1 part per message** if the part is large
- **2–3 parts in one message** only if they’re modest in size and not huge walls of text

## Best workflow
To avoid truncation or missing context:

1. send **part 1**
2. I summarize / extract key state
3. send **part 2**
4. repeat until we reach the Thursday stopping point

## If you want me to track continuity across parts
Label them clearly, like:

- `Part 041`
- `Part 042`
- `Part 043`

That way I can keep the thread straight.

## Rule of thumb
If a pasted block feels “very long” in your editor, **just send one part at a time**.

## Best answer
For reliability: **send 1 part per message**.  
If the files are small enough, **2 at most** is usually fine.

- `.md`
- `.txt`

Avoid needing:
- giant `.json` files
- zipped archives
- odd filenames with too many spaces/parentheses

## Naming recommendations
Use consistent names like:

```text
2026-05-26_master-history.md
2026-05-26_master-history_part_001.txt
```

That is much easier to scan than mixed naming styles.

## Important repo settings
### Make it:
- **Public** if you want easiest access
- default branch: `main`
- no need for Actions, Projects, Issues, or Wiki

### Fine to include:
- `README.md`
- folders by date

### Avoid if possible:
- huge binary files
- nested clutter
- duplicate copies of the same chat under multiple names

## Ideal README
A tiny `README.md` is helpful, e.g.:

````markdown name=README.md
# Co-Pilot Chat Review

This repo contains extracted chat history for review.

## Layout
- `2026-05-26/parts/` = split text parts
- `2026-05-26/2026-05-26_master-history.md` = full merged version

Primary review target:
- 2026-05-26
````

## Best for me to review
The easiest setup for me is:

1. new repo is public
2. files are on `main`
3. `2026-05-26` folder exists at repo root
4. split text files are in `parts/`
5. no giant unrelated files mixed in

## Example final structure
```text
Co-Pilot-Chat-Review/
  README.md
  2026-05-26/
    2026-05-26_master-history.md
    parts/
      2026-05-26_master-history_part_001.txt
      2026-05-26_master-history_part_002.txt
      ...
      2026-05-26_master-history_part_081.txt
```

## Extra tip
If your goal is “find where we left off on Thursday,” also add a small note file like:

```text
2026-05-26/review-target.txt
```

with something like:
- “Please review the latest continuity point from Thursday’s AMiWinForms / AMiDataStore discussion.”

- **public**
- **default branch = main**
- **date folders at repo root**
- **plain `.txt` / `.md` files only**
- **no extra clutter**

## @testsubject117

if I used the web page to upload files and saw their progress why are they not appearing in the repo?

## Copilot

Most likely: the upload reached the **staging page**, but the final **Commit changes** step wasn’t completed on the branch you expected.

On GitHub’s web uploader, seeing upload progress does **not** always mean the files are already in the repo. Usually the flow is:

1. choose/upload files
2. GitHub uploads them in the browser
3. you review the changes
4. you must click **Commit changes**
5. optionally choose branch / PR target

If step 4 didn’t complete, the files won’t appear in the repo tree.

## Other common reasons
### 1. Uploaded to a different branch
You may have uploaded to:
- a new branch GitHub created automatically
- a branch other than `main`

### 2. Commit failed silently in browser flow
Sometimes:
- page refresh
- auth/session timeout
- browser hiccup
- navigating away before commit

can leave you thinking the upload finished when it actually didn’t finalize.

### 3. Uploaded into a different folder than expected
The files might be in:
- a nested folder
- a typo’d path
- a drag/drop-created folder path you didn’t expect

### 4. Large batch / browser issue
With many files, GitHub web upload can be flaky:
- uploader shows progress
- but final tree/commit doesn’t land cleanly

## How to verify immediately
In the GitHub web UI, check:

- **Commits** tab: is there a new commit?
- branch selector: are you on `main`?
- **Code** tab: do the files appear in the tree?
- browser banner: did GitHub say “created a commit” or “open a pull request”?

## Fastest proof
If the upload really committed, you should see:
- a recent commit in repo history
- your files in the code tree
- possibly your username on the latest commit

## Best fix
If you want reliability, use Git locally instead of browser upload for large batches.

## Short answer
Because on GitHub web upload, **file upload progress is not the same as a completed commit**.  
The most likely cause is that the final **Commit changes** step either didn’t happen, happened on another branch, or didn’t complete successfully.

- **A** = append to existing Misc text

- fax content is likely stored via Misc conventions
- DOS provides inline instructions during data entry

# Recommended structure

## 1. `FrmRolodexMenu`
Purpose:

- entered from Main Menu via `(N)`
- handles inline workflows for:
  - Print Phone Book
  - Print Labels
  - Test Entire Rolodex for Errors

  - Delete
  - Look Up
  - Modify

  - Zip Codes

  - `****** ROLODEX MENU ******`
  - top-right date
  - menu items A–I, Z
- capture single-key commands
- maintain bottom prompt/status area for inline menu workflows
- return to main menu on `Z` or `Esc`

---

## 2. `FrmRolodexPersonPrompt`
Purpose:
- reusable prompt-flow screen for person record workflows

Use modes like:
- Add
- Modify
- DeleteLookup
- LookupPerson
- ConfirmRecord
- ReviewRecord

You can do this either with:
- one form + mode enum
or
- multiple small forms

### My recommendation
Use **one reusable form** with a mode enum and workflow engine.

### Why
Because these screens all share:
- black DOS background
- monospaced text
- progressive transcript-style prompts
- one active input
- summary display
- Y/N style confirmation

---

## 3. `RolodexPromptEngine`
Purpose:
- non-UI workflow logic for prompt sequences

This is the most important class if you want speed without chaos.

### Handles
- current step
- prompt text
- default value logic
- validation
- transcript lines
- transitions between steps
- review/confirm stage

#### Add Person

- Confirm

#### Modify Person
Same steps, but with:
- Enter = existing value

- final review

- candidate record display
- delete confirm

#### Lookup Person

## 4. `RolodexPersonRecord`
Purpose:
- data model for a rolodex record

Suggested properties:
- `Name`

# Suggested `RolodexPromptEngine` flow definitions

## Add Person
```text
Title: <<<< ADD A PERSON >>>>

1. Person or Company Name: ?
2. Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] ?
3. City: ?
4. State [ENTER = CA] ?
5. Zip Code: ?
6. Area Code [ENTER = 818] ?
7. Phone Number ?
8. show fax instruction
9. Misc: ?
10. summary review
11. IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ?
12. save or return
```

## Modify Person
```text
1. search/select record
2. Modify this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ?
3. Person or Company Name: [ENTER = existing] ?
4. Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] [ENTER = existing] ?
5. City: [ENTER = existing] ?
6. State [ENTER = existing/default] ?
7. Zip Code [ENTER = existing] ?
8. Area Code [ENTER = existing] ?
9. Phone Number [ENTER = existing raw] ?
10. show fax instruction
11. Misc: [A = Append] [ENTER = existing] ?
12. summary review
13. Is this correct (Y/N) ?
14. save or discard
```

## Delete Person
```text
1. <<<< DELETE A PERSON >>>>
2. Enter 1st Part of Whole Name
3. Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ?
4. if match found, show record summary
5. Delete this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ?
6. delete or cancel
```

# UI composition suggestion for DOS-style prompt forms

## `FrmRolodexPrompt`
Use:
- one large read-only monospaced transcript surface
- one active input line or textbox at the bottom/current row

### Controls
- `lblTitle`
- `txtTranscript` or custom rendered text panel
- `txtInput`

### Better than many textboxes
Do **not** create one textbox per field if you want DOS parity.

Instead:
- transcript area shows prior prompts and answers
- single active input handles current step

This will make Add/Modify feel much more like DOS.

## 1) `RolodexPersonRecord.vb`

```vb name=RolodexPersonRecord.vb
Public Class RolodexPersonRecord
    Public Property PersonName As String = ""
    Public Property Street As String = ""
    Public Property City As String = ""
    Public Property StateCode As String = ""
    Public Property ZipCode As String = ""
    Public Property AreaCode As String = ""
    Public Property PhoneNumber As String = ""
    Public Property Misc As String = ""
    Public Property IsCustomer As Boolean = False

    Public Function GetDisplayLines() As List(Of String)
        Return New List(Of String) From {
            PersonName,
            Street,
            $"{City} , {StateCode}   {ZipCode}",
            $"({AreaCode}) {FormatPhone(PhoneNumber)}",
            Misc
        }
    End Function

    Public Shared Function FormatPhone(raw As String) As String
        Dim digits = New String((If(raw, "")).Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())

        If digits.Length = 7 Then
            Return $"{digits.Substring(0, 3)}-{digits.Substring(3, 4)}"
        End If

        Return raw
    End Function
End Class
```

## 4) `RolodexPromptEngine.vb`

This is intentionally simple so you can get moving today.

```vb name=RolodexPromptEngine.vb
Public Class RolodexPromptEngine
    Private ReadOnly _mode As RolodexPromptMode
    Private _stepIndex As Integer = 0

    Public Property WorkingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord
    Public Property Transcript As New List(Of String)

    Public Sub New(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional existingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        _mode = mode

        If existingRecord IsNot Nothing Then
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                .PersonName = existingRecord.PersonName,
                .Street = existingRecord.Street,
                .City = existingRecord.City,
                .StateCode = existingRecord.StateCode,
                .ZipCode = existingRecord.ZipCode,
                .AreaCode = existingRecord.AreaCode,
                .PhoneNumber = existingRecord.PhoneNumber,
                .Misc = existingRecord.Misc,
                .IsCustomer = existingRecord.IsCustomer
            }
        Else
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord()
        End If
    End Sub

    Public ReadOnly Property Title As String
        Get
            Select Case _mode
                Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                    Return "<<<< ADD A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                    Return "<<<< MODIFY A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                    Return "<<<< DELETE A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                    Return "<<<< LOOK UP A PERSON >>>>"
                Case Else
                    Return "<<<< ROLODEX >>>>"
            End Select
        End Get
    End Property

    Public Function GetCurrentPrompt() As String
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return GetAddPrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return GetModifyPrompt()
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function SubmitInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return SubmitAddInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return SubmitModifyInput(input)
            Case Else
                Return False
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function IsComplete() As Boolean
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return _stepIndex > 9
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return _stepIndex > 9
            Case Else
                Return True
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function GetReviewLines() As List(Of String)
        Return WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
    End Function

    Private Function GetAddPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return "Person or Company Name: ?"
            Case 1 : Return "Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing]?"
            Case 2 : Return "City: ?"
            Case 3 : Return "State [ENTER = CA] ?"
            Case 4 : Return "Zip Code: ?"
            Case 5 : Return "Area Code [ENTER = 818] ?"
            Case 6 : Return "Phone Number ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       "Misc: ?"
            Case 8 : Return "IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetModifyPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return $"Person or Company Name: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PersonName}] ?"
            Case 1 : Return $"Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Street}] ?"
            Case 2 : Return $"City: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.City}] ?"
            Case 3 : Return $"State [ENTER = {If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode), "CA", WorkingRecord.StateCode)}] ?"
            Case 4 : Return $"Zip Code [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.ZipCode} ] ?"
            Case 5 : Return $"Area Code [ ENTER = {WorkingRecord.AreaCode} ] ?"
            Case 6 : Return $"Phone Number [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber} ] ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       $"Misc: [A = Append] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Misc}] ?"
            Case 8 : Return "Is this correct (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitAddInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()
            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                Else
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If
            Case 2
                WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()
            Case 3
                WorkingRecord.StateCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "CA", input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            Case 4
                WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()
            Case 5
                WorkingRecord.AreaCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "818", input.Trim())
            Case 6
                WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())
            Case 7
                WorkingRecord.Misc = input.Trim()
            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _stepIndex += 1
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitModifyInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()
            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If
            Case 2
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()
            Case 3
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                ElseIf String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = "CA"
                End If
            Case 4
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()
            Case 5
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.AreaCode = input.Trim()
            Case 6
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())
                End If
            Case 7
                Dim value = input.Trim()
                If value.ToUpperInvariant() = "A" Then
                    ' placeholder for append mode trigger
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Misc = value
                End If
            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("Is this correct (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _stepIndex += 1
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function GetPromptSummaryLine(input As String) As String
        Dim prompt = GetCurrentPrompt()

        If prompt.Contains(Environment.NewLine) Then
            Dim parts = prompt.Split({Environment.NewLine}, StringSplitOptions.None)
            prompt = parts.Last()
        End If

        Return $"{prompt} {input}".TrimEnd()
    End Function
End Class
```

## 5) `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb`

This is your reusable DOS-style prompt form for Add/Modify first.

```vb name=FrmRolodexPrompt.vb
Public Class FrmRolodexPrompt
    Private ReadOnly _engine As RolodexPromptEngine

    Public Sub New(engine As RolodexPromptEngine)
        InitializeComponent()
        _engine = engine
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles MyBase.Load
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        lblTitle.Text = _engine.Title
        txtTranscript.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtTranscript.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtTranscript.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None
        txtTranscript.Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)
        txtTranscript.ReadOnly = True

        txtInput.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtInput.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtInput.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None
        txtInput.Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)

        RefreshTranscript()
        txtInput.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub txtInput_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs) Handles txtInput.KeyDown
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True

            Dim value = txtInput.Text
            txtInput.Clear()

            _engine.SubmitInput(value)

            If _engine.IsComplete() Then
                ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
                Return
            End If

            RefreshTranscript()
        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefreshTranscript()
        Dim lines As New List(Of String)
        lines.AddRange(_engine.Transcript)

        Dim prompt = _engine.GetCurrentPrompt()
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prompt) Then
            lines.Add(prompt)
        End If

        txtTranscript.Text = String.Join(Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine, lines)
        txtTranscript.SelectionStart = txtTranscript.TextLength
        txtTranscript.ScrollToCaret()
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Dim reviewLines = _engine.GetReviewLines()
        Dim reviewText = String.Join(Environment.NewLine, reviewLines)

        Dim result = MessageBox.Show(reviewText & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Accept this record?", "Rolodex", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question)

        If result = DialogResult.Yes Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
        End If

        Me.Close()
    End Sub
End Class
```

### `FrmRolodexPrompt` expected controls
Add these to the form designer:
- `lblTitle` (Label)
- `txtTranscript` (TextBox, multiline = True, scrollbars vertical)
- `txtInput` (TextBox)

Simple layout:
- `lblTitle` top
- `txtTranscript` fills most of form
- `txtInput` bottom

```vb name=FrmPagedTextViewer.vb
Public Class FrmPagedTextViewer
    Private _pages As New List(Of String)
    Private _pageIndex As Integer = 0

    Public Sub SetPages(pages As List(Of String))
        _pages = pages
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmPagedTextViewer_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles MyBase.Load
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        txtPage.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtPage.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtPage.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None
        txtPage.Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)
        txtPage.ReadOnly = True

        ShowPage()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmPagedTextViewer_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs) Handles MyBase.KeyDown
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            _pageIndex += 1

            If _pageIndex >= _pages.Count Then
                Me.Close()
                Return
            End If

            ShowPage()
        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPage()
        If _pages.Count = 0 Then
            txtPage.Text = ""
            Return
        End If

        txtPage.Text = _pages(_pageIndex)
    End Sub
End Class
```

## 9) `FrmRolodexMenu.vb`

This gets you wiring fast.

```vb name=FrmRolodexMenu.vb
Public Class FrmRolodexMenu
    Private _inlineMode As RolodexMenuInlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles MyBase.Load
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        lblTitle.Text = "****** ROLODEX MENU ******"
        lblDate.Text = "Todays Date: " & DateTime.Now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy")

        txtInline.BackColor = Color.Black
        txtInline.ForeColor = Color.White
        txtInline.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None
        txtInline.Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)
        txtInline.ReadOnly = True
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs) Handles MyBase.KeyPress
        Dim ch = Char.ToUpperInvariant(e.KeyChar)

        Select Case ch
            Case "A"c
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson)
            Case "B"c
                MessageBox.Show("Delete Person flow next.")
            Case "C"c
                MessageBox.Show("Look Up Person flow next.")
            Case "D"c
                Dim sample = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson, sample)
            Case "E"c
                StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()
            Case "F"c
                StartPrintLabelsFlow()
            Case "G"c
                OpenAreaCodes()
            Case "H"c
                OpenZipKey()
            Case "I"c
                StartErrorCheckFlow()
            Case "Z"c
                Me.Close()
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs) Handles MyBase.KeyDown
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenPrompt(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional record As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        Using frm As New FrmRolodexPrompt(New RolodexPromptEngine(mode, record))
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text = "E" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                         "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintLabelsFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text = "F" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                         "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartErrorCheckFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.ErrorCheck_Running
        txtInline.Text = "Checking Rolodex for Errors...     [ESC] to Exit" &
                         Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                         "Testing the Z's" &
                         Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                         "Hit [ENTER] to continue?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenAreaCodes()
        Dim svc As New RolodexAreaCodeService()
        Using frm As New FrmPagedTextViewer()
            frm.SetPages(svc.GetAllPages())
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenZipKey()
        Using frm As New FrmZipKeyPopup()
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub
End Class
```

### Controls expected
- `lblTitle`
- `lblDate`
- a label for static menu text, or hardcode a multiline label
- `txtInline` multiline textbox for inline prompt output

```vb name=MainMenuRolodexLaunch.vb
    frm.ShowDialog(Me)
```

## Copilot

Yes — these are fixable, and the root cause is simple:

## Direct cause
Most of your errors are because the code I gave references **designer-created controls** that do not exist yet on the forms.

Examples:
- `txtPage`
- `lblTitle`
- `lblDate`
- `txtInline`
- `txtTranscript`
- `txtInput`
- `pnlPopup`
- `lblZipContent`

So we have two ways to fix this:

1. **Create the controls in the WinForms Designer**, or  
2. **Create the controls in code manually**

Because you want speed, I recommend **fixing these forms by creating controls in code inside each form**. That avoids needing to stop and use the designer right now.

Also, `RolodexAreaCodeService.vb` has a syntax problem from multiline string formatting.

---

# Fastest fix plan

Replace the contents of these files with the versions below:

- `FrmPagedTextViewer.vb`
- `FrmRolodexMenu.vb`
- `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb`
- `FrmZipKeyPopup.vb`
- `RolodexAreaCodeService.vb`

These versions **self-create the controls**, so the undeclared-control errors go away.

## 1) Replace `FrmPagedTextViewer.vb`

```vb name=FrmPagedTextViewer.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmPagedTextViewer
    Inherits Form

    Private txtPage As TextBox
    Private _pages As New List(Of String)
    Private _pageIndex As Integer = 0

    Public Sub New()
        MyBase.New()
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Public Sub SetPages(pages As List(Of String))
        _pages = If(pages, New List(Of String))
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.Text = "Paged Viewer"
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(800, 600)
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        txtPage = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(txtPage)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmPagedTextViewer_Load
        AddHandler Me.KeyDown, AddressOf FrmPagedTextViewer_KeyDown
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmPagedTextViewer_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        ShowPage()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmPagedTextViewer_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            _pageIndex += 1

            If _pageIndex >= _pages.Count Then
                Me.Close()
                Return
            End If

            ShowPage()
        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPage()
        If _pages.Count = 0 Then
            txtPage.Text = ""
            Return
        End If

        txtPage.Text = _pages(_pageIndex)
    End Sub
End Class
```

## 2) Replace `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb`

```vb name=FrmRolodexPrompt.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexPrompt
    Inherits Form

    Private ReadOnly _engine As RolodexPromptEngine

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private txtTranscript As TextBox
    Private txtInput As TextBox

    Public Sub New(engine As RolodexPromptEngine)
        MyBase.New()
        _engine = engine
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Prompt"

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Height = 40,
            .Dock = DockStyle.Top,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
            .Padding = New Padding(10, 0, 0, 0)
        }

        txtInput = New TextBox() With {
            .Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Height = 28
        }

        txtTranscript = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(txtTranscript)
        Me.Controls.Add(txtInput)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Load
        AddHandler txtInput.KeyDown, AddressOf txtInput_KeyDown
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = _engine.Title
        RefreshTranscript()
        txtInput.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub txtInput_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True

            Dim value = txtInput.Text
            txtInput.Clear()

            _engine.SubmitInput(value)

            If _engine.IsComplete() Then
                ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
                Return
            End If

            RefreshTranscript()
        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefreshTranscript()
        Dim lines As New List(Of String)
        lines.AddRange(_engine.Transcript)

        Dim prompt = _engine.GetCurrentPrompt()
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prompt) Then
            lines.Add(prompt)
        End If

        txtTranscript.Text = String.Join(Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine, lines)
        txtTranscript.SelectionStart = txtTranscript.TextLength
        txtTranscript.ScrollToCaret()
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Dim reviewLines = _engine.GetReviewLines()
        Dim reviewText = String.Join(Environment.NewLine, reviewLines)

        Dim result = MessageBox.Show(
            reviewText & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Accept this record?",
            "Rolodex",
            MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
            MessageBoxIcon.Question
        )

        If result = DialogResult.Yes Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
        End If

        Me.Close()
    End Sub
End Class
```

```vb name=FrmRolodexMenu.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexMenu
    Inherits Form

    Private _inlineMode As RolodexMenuInlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private lblDate As Label
    Private lblMenu As Label
    Private txtInline As TextBox

    Public Sub New()
        MyBase.New()
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Menu"
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(10, 10),
            .Size = New Size(350, 30),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold)
        }

        lblDate = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(560, 10),
            .Size = New Size(300, 30),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleRight
        }

        lblMenu = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(10, 50),
            .Size = New Size(420, 260),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)
        }

        txtInline = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .Location = New Point(10, 320),
            .Size = New Size(860, 260),
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblDate)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblMenu)
        Me.Controls.Add(txtInline)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_Load
        AddHandler Me.KeyPress, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_KeyPress
        AddHandler Me.KeyDown, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_KeyDown
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = "****** ROLODEX MENU ******"
        lblDate.Text = "Todays Date: " & DateTime.Now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy")

        lblMenu.Text =
            "(A) Add a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(B) Delete a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(C) Look up a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(D) Modify a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(E) Print Phone Book" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(F) Print Labels" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(G) Look up Area Codes" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(H) Look up Zip Codes" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(I) Test Entire Rolodex for Errors" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(Z) Back to Main Menu"
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs)
        Dim ch = Char.ToUpperInvariant(e.KeyChar)

        Select Case ch
            Case "A"c
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson)
            Case "B"c
                MessageBox.Show("Delete Person flow next.")
            Case "C"c
                MessageBox.Show("Look Up Person flow next.")
            Case "D"c
                Dim sample = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson, sample)
            Case "E"c
                StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()
            Case "F"c
                StartPrintLabelsFlow()
            Case "G"c
                OpenAreaCodes()
            Case "H"c
                OpenZipKey()
            Case "I"c
                StartErrorCheckFlow()
            Case "Z"c
                Me.Close()
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenPrompt(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional record As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        Using frm As New FrmRolodexPrompt(New RolodexPromptEngine(mode, record))
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text =
            "E" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintLabelsFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text =
            "F" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartErrorCheckFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.ErrorCheck_Running
        txtInline.Text =
            "Checking Rolodex for Errors...     [ESC] to Exit" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Testing the Z's" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Hit [ENTER] to continue?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenAreaCodes()
        Dim svc As New RolodexAreaCodeService()

        Using frm As New FrmPagedTextViewer()
            frm.SetPages(svc.GetAllPages())
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenZipKey()
        Using frm As New FrmZipKeyPopup()
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub
End Class
```

```vb name=FrmZipKeyPopup.vb
            .ForeColor = Color.White,

        }
```

# Why these fixes work

## Control declaration errors
All fixed because the controls are now explicitly declared:
- `Private txtPage As TextBox`
- `Private lblTitle As Label`
- etc.

## `Handles` clause error
That happened because `txtInput` didn’t exist as a `WithEvents` designer field.  
Using `AddHandler` fixes that cleanly.

## `RolodexAreaCodeService` syntax errors
Those were from malformed multiline string/list initializer syntax.  
Now it’s standard VB string concatenation.

```
                                      ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpLeft)

                                  End Sub))

        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpLeft)
    End Sub

    Private Sub flpRight_SizeChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles flpRight.SizeChanged
        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpRight)
    End Sub

    Private Sub tmrClock_Tick(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles tmrClock.Tick
        UpdateHeaderClock()
    End Sub

    Private Sub UpdateHeaderClock()
        Dim now As DateTime = DateTime.Now

        lblDateTime.Text = _buildInfo & "          " &
                       now.ToString("dddd") & "  " &
                       now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy") & "          " &

    Private Sub BuildMenu()
        If flpLeft Is Nothing OrElse flpRight Is Nothing Then Return

        flpLeft.Controls.Clear()
        flpRight.Controls.Clear()

        ' Left column

        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "D", "View Sales Journal")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "E", "View Log Book")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "F", "Price List Program")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "G", "Print Records / Void Invoices")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "H", "Quick Message Flashing")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "I", "Backup Price List & Rolodex")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "J", "Print Out Customers Actual Names")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "K", "Cash Disbursements")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "L", "Business Expenses Account")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "M", "Quotation Form Generator")
        AddMenuButton(flpLeft, "N", "Rolodex")

        ' Right column
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "O", "Copy Spec Index")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "P", "Entire Ledger Viewing")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "Q", "Word Processor")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "R", "Find Word Processor Text")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "T", "Change Date or Time")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "X", "Typewriter Mode")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "Y", "Ed Dean's Personal Backup")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "Z", "Personal Calendar")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "1", "Mileage Tracking")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "2", "Product Purchasing")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "3", "Miscellaneous Menu")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "4", "Add Entries to Log Book")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "6", "Cadmium Cards")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "7", "Emergency PAYROLL System")
        AddMenuButton(flpRight, "?", "About AMiOffice Menu System")
    End Sub

    Private Function MakeHeaderLabel(text As String) As Label
        Dim lbl As New Label()
        lbl.AutoSize = False
        lbl.Height = 32
        lbl.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        lbl.Font = New Font(Me.Font, FontStyle.Bold)
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Margin = New Padding(3, 3, 3, 8)
        lbl.Width = 1000
        Return lbl
    End Function

    Private Sub AddMenuButton(panel As FlowLayoutPanel, key As String, text As String)
        Dim btn As New Button()

        btn.AutoSize = False
        btn.Height = 36
        btn.Font = New Font("Segoe UI", 12.0F, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point, CByte(0))
        btn.TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        btn.Text = "(" & key & ") " & text
        btn.Tag = key
        btn.Margin = New Padding(3, 3, 3, 6)

        btn.UseVisualStyleBackColor = False
        btn.BackColor = Color.Black
        btn.ForeColor = Color.White
        btn.FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat
        btn.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = Color.DimGray
        btn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 1
        btn.FlatAppearance.MouseOverBackColor = Color.FromArgb(32, 32, 32)
        btn.FlatAppearance.MouseDownBackColor = Color.FromArgb(64, 64, 64)
        btn.AutoEllipsis = True

        AddHandler btn.Click, Sub(sender, args) HandleMenuKey(CStr(btn.Tag))

        panel.Controls.Add(btn)
    End Sub

    Protected Overrides Sub OnResize(e As EventArgs)
        MyBase.OnResize(e)
        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpLeft)
        ResizeButtonsToPanel(flpRight)
    End Sub

    Private Sub ResizeButtonsToPanel(panel As FlowLayoutPanel)
        If panel Is Nothing Then Return

        Dim targetWidth As Integer =
            panel.ClientSize.Width -
            panel.Padding.Left - panel.Padding.Right -
            SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth - 6

        If targetWidth < 150 Then targetWidth = 150

        For Each c As Control In panel.Controls
            Dim btn = TryCast(c, Button)
            Dim lbl = TryCast(c, Label)

            If btn IsNot Nothing Then
                btn.Width = targetWidth
            ElseIf lbl IsNot Nothing Then
                lbl.Width = targetWidth
            End If
        Next
    End Sub

    Private Sub FormMainMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs) Handles Me.KeyPress
        Dim ch As String = e.KeyChar.ToString()
        If ch = vbCr OrElse ch = vbLf Then Return
        HandleMenuKey(ch)
    End Sub

    Private Sub HandleMenuKey(ch As String)
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(ch) Then Return

        Dim up As String = ch
        If up.Length = 1 AndAlso Char.IsLetter(up(0)) Then
            up = up.ToUpperInvariant()
        End If

        Select Case up
            Case "A" : NotYet("Shop Card Generator")
            Case "B" : NotYet("Invoice Generator")
            Case "C"
                Using f As New FormLedgerMenu()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using
            Case "D" : NotYet("View Sales Journal (SALES)")
            Case "E" : NotYet("View Log Book (LOGBOOK)")
            Case "F" : NotYet("Price List Program (plist)")
            Case "G" : NotYet("Print/Void Invoices (BOOT)")
            Case "H" : NotYet("Quick Message Flashing")

            Case "I"
                Try
                    Cursor = Cursors.WaitCursor
                    MigrationService.EnsureFoldersAndMigrateOnce()
                    BackupService.RunBackupPriceListAndRolodex()
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup complete." & Environment.NewLine & AppPaths.BackupDir,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
                Catch ex As Exception
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup failed: " & ex.Message,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
                Finally
                    Cursor = Cursors.Default
                End Try

            Case "J" : NotYet("Print Out Customers Actual Names (spool real names)")
            Case "K" : NotYet("Cash Disbursements (BILL)")
            Case "L" : NotYet("Business Expenses Account (password)")
            Case "M" : NotYet("Quotation Form Generator (QUOTE)")
            Case "N" : NotYet("Rolodex (PHONE)")

            Case "O" : NotYet("Copy Spec Index")
            Case "P" : NotYet("Entire Ledger Viewing (ENTIRE)")
            Case "Q" : NotYet("Word Processor")
            Case "R" : NotYet("Find Word Processor Text")

            Case "T" : NotYet("Change Date or Time")
            Case "X" : NotYet("Typewriter Mode")
            Case "Y" : NotYet("Ed Dean's Personal Backup")
            Case "Z"
                Using f As New FormPersonalCalendar()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "1"
                Using f As New FormMileageTracking()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using
            Case "2" : NotYet("Product Purchasing")
            Case "3"
                Using f As New FormMiscMenu()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using
            Case "4" : NotYet("Add Entries to Log Book")
            Case "6" : NotYet("Cadmium Cards")
            Case "7" : NotYet("Emergency PAYROLL System")

            Case "?"
                Using f As New FormAbout()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case Else
                ' ignore unknown keys
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub NotYet(feature As String)
        MessageBox.Show("Not implemented yet: " & feature, "Port status", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
    End Sub

End Class
```

```vb name=FormMainMenu.vb
            End If
        Next
    End Sub

    Private Sub FormMainMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs) Handles Me.KeyPress
        Dim ch As String = e.KeyChar.ToString()
        If ch = vbCr OrElse ch = vbLf Then Return
        HandleMenuKey(ch)
    End Sub

    Private Sub HandleMenuKey(ch As String)
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(ch) Then Return

        Dim up As String = ch
        If up.Length = 1 AndAlso Char.IsLetter(up(0)) Then
            up = up.ToUpperInvariant()
        End If

        Select Case up
            Case "A"
                NotYet("Shop Card Generator")

            Case "B"
                NotYet("Invoice Generator")

            Case "C"
                Using f As New FormLedgerMenu()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "D"
                NotYet("View Sales Journal (SALES)")

            Case "E"
                NotYet("View Log Book (LOGBOOK)")

            Case "F"
                NotYet("Price List Program (plist)")

            Case "G"
                NotYet("Print/Void Invoices (BOOT)")

            Case "H"
                NotYet("Quick Message Flashing")

            Case "I"
                Try
                    Cursor = Cursors.WaitCursor
                    MigrationService.EnsureFoldersAndMigrateOnce()
                    BackupService.RunBackupPriceListAndRolodex()
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup complete." & Environment.NewLine & AppPaths.BackupDir,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
                Catch ex As Exception
                    MessageBox.Show("Backup failed: " & ex.Message,
                                    "Backup", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error)
                Finally
                    Cursor = Cursors.Default
                End Try

            Case "J"
                NotYet("Print Out Customers Actual Names (spool real names)")

            Case "K"
                NotYet("Cash Disbursements (BILL)")

            Case "L"
                NotYet("Business Expenses Account (password)")

            Case "M"
                NotYet("Quotation Form Generator (QUOTE)")

            Case "N"
                Using f As New FrmRolodexMenu()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "O"
                NotYet("Copy Spec Index")

            Case "P"
                NotYet("Entire Ledger Viewing (ENTIRE)")

            Case "Q"
                NotYet("Word Processor")

            Case "R"
                NotYet("Find Word Processor Text")

            Case "T"
                NotYet("Change Date or Time")

            Case "X"
                NotYet("Typewriter Mode")

            Case "Y"
                NotYet("Ed Dean's Personal Backup")

            Case "Z"
                Using f As New FormPersonalCalendar()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "1"
                Using f As New FormMileageTracking()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "2"
                NotYet("Product Purchasing")

            Case "3"
                Using f As New FormMiscMenu()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case "4"
                NotYet("Add Entries to Log Book")

            Case "6"
                NotYet("Cadmium Cards")

            Case "7"
                NotYet("Emergency PAYROLL System")

            Case "?"
                Using f As New FormAbout()
                    f.ShowDialog(Me)
                End Using

            Case Else
                ' ignore unknown keys
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub NotYet(feature As String)
        MessageBox.Show("Not implemented yet: " & feature, "Port status", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information)
    End Sub

End Class
```

```vb name=FrmRolodexMenu.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexMenu
    Inherits Form

    Private _inlineMode As RolodexMenuInlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private lblDate As Label
    Private lblMenu As Label
    Private txtInline As TextBox

    Public Sub New()
        MyBase.New()
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Menu"
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(10, 10),
            .Size = New Size(350, 30),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold)
        }

        lblDate = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(560, 10),
            .Size = New Size(300, 30),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleRight
        }

        lblMenu = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Location = New Point(10, 50),
            .Size = New Size(420, 260),
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular)
        }

        txtInline = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .Location = New Point(10, 320),
            .Size = New Size(860, 260),
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblDate)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblMenu)
        Me.Controls.Add(txtInline)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_Load
        AddHandler Me.KeyPress, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_KeyPress
        AddHandler Me.KeyDown, AddressOf FrmRolodexMenu_KeyDown
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = "****** ROLODEX MENU ******"
        lblDate.Text = "Todays Date: " & DateTime.Now.ToString("MM-dd-yyyy")

        lblMenu.Text =
            "(A) Add a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(B) Delete a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(C) Look up a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(D) Modify a Person" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(E) Print Phone Book" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(F) Print Labels" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(G) Look up Area Codes" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(H) Look up Zip Codes" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(I) Test Entire Rolodex for Errors" & Environment.NewLine &
            "(Z) Back to Main Menu"
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs)
        If HandleInlineInput(e.KeyChar) Then
            Return
        End If

        Dim ch = Char.ToUpperInvariant(e.KeyChar)

        Select Case ch
            Case "A"c
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson)

            Case "B"c
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson)

            Case "C"c
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson)

            Case "D"c
                Dim sample = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }
                OpenPrompt(RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson, sample)

            Case "E"c
                StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()

            Case "F"c
                StartPrintLabelsFlow()

            Case "G"c
                OpenAreaCodes()

            Case "H"c
                OpenZipKey()

            Case "I"c
                StartErrorCheckFlow()

            Case "Z"c
                Me.Close()
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexMenu_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            If _inlineMode <> RolodexMenuInlineMode.None Then
                _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None
                txtInline.Clear()
                e.SuppressKeyPress = True
                Return
            End If

            Me.Close()
        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            If _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.ErrorCheck_Running Then
                txtInline.Text =
                    "Checking Rolodex for Errors...     [ESC] to Exit" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                    "Testing the Z's" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                    "Done. Returning to menu."
                _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None
                e.SuppressKeyPress = True
                Return
            End If
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Function HandleInlineInput(ch As Char) As Boolean
        If _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None Then Return False

        Dim up As Char = Char.ToUpperInvariant(ch)

        Select Case _inlineMode
            Case RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_CustomersOnly
                If up = "Y"c OrElse up = "N"c Then
                    txtInline.Text =
                        "E" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ? " & If(up = "Y"c, "Yes", "No") &
                        Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Do you want High Quality but slow print (Y/N) ?"
                    _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_HighQuality
                    Return True
                End If

            Case RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_HighQuality
                If up = "Y"c OrElse up = "N"c Then
                    Dim firstAnswer As String = ""
                    If txtInline.Text.Contains("customers only (Y/N) ? Yes") Then
                        firstAnswer = "Yes"
                    Else
                        firstAnswer = "No"
                    End If

                    txtInline.Text =
                        "E" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ? " & firstAnswer &
                        Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Do you want High Quality but slow print (Y/N) ? " & If(up = "Y"c, "Yes", "No") &
                        Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Enter the 1st letter of the people you want to print (Enter = All) (Esc = Quit)"
                    _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_FirstLetter
                    Return True
                End If

            Case RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_FirstLetter
                txtInline.Text &= Environment.NewLine &
                    "PRINTER IS NOT READY!, Get it ready and hit [ENTER]?"
                _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None
                Return True

            Case RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_CustomersOnly
                If up = "Y"c OrElse up = "N"c Then
                    txtInline.Text =
                        "F" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ? " & If(up = "Y"c, "Yes", "No") &
                        Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                        "Enter 1st Letter to start with [Enter = A]"
                    _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_FirstLetter
                    Return True
                End If

            Case RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_FirstLetter
                txtInline.Text &= Environment.NewLine &
                    "PRINTER IS NOT READY!, Get it ready and hit [ENTER]?"
                _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.None
                Return True
        End Select

        Return False
    End Function

    Private Sub OpenPrompt(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional record As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        Using frm As New FrmRolodexPrompt(New RolodexPromptEngine(mode, record))
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintPhoneBookFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintPhoneBook_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text =
            "E" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartPrintLabelsFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.PrintLabels_CustomersOnly
        txtInline.Text =
            "F" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Do you want to print your customers only (Y/N) ?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartErrorCheckFlow()
        _inlineMode = RolodexMenuInlineMode.ErrorCheck_Running
        txtInline.Text =
            "Checking Rolodex for Errors...     [ESC] to Exit" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Testing the Z's" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
            "Hit [ENTER] to continue?"
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenAreaCodes()
        Dim svc As New RolodexAreaCodeService()

        Using frm As New FrmPagedTextViewer()
            frm.SetPages(svc.GetAllPages())
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Sub OpenZipKey()
        Using frm As New FrmZipKeyPopup()
            frm.ShowDialog(Me)
        End Using
    End Sub
End Class
```
