```vb name=RolodexPromptEngine.vb
Public Class RolodexPromptEngine
    Private ReadOnly _mode As RolodexPromptMode
    Private _stepIndex As Integer = 0

    Public Property WorkingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord
    Public Property Transcript As New List(Of String)

    Public Sub New(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional existingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        _mode = mode

        If existingRecord IsNot Nothing Then
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                .PersonName = existingRecord.PersonName,
                .Street = existingRecord.Street,
                .City = existingRecord.City,
                .StateCode = existingRecord.StateCode,
                .ZipCode = existingRecord.ZipCode,
                .AreaCode = existingRecord.AreaCode,
                .PhoneNumber = existingRecord.PhoneNumber,
                .Misc = existingRecord.Misc,
                .IsCustomer = existingRecord.IsCustomer
            }
        Else
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord()
        End If
    End Sub

    Public ReadOnly Property Title As String
        Get
            Select Case _mode
                Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                    Return "<<<< ADD A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                    Return "<<<< MODIFY A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                    Return "<<<< DELETE A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                    Return "<<<< LOOK UP A PERSON >>>>"
                Case Else
                    Return "<<<< ROLODEX >>>>"
            End Select
        End Get
    End Property

    Public Function GetCurrentPrompt() As String
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return GetAddPrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return GetModifyPrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                Return GetDeletePrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return GetLookupPrompt()
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function SubmitInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return SubmitAddInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return SubmitModifyInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                Return SubmitDeleteInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return SubmitLookupInput(input)
            Case Else
                Return False
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function IsComplete() As Boolean
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return _stepIndex > 8
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return _stepIndex > 8
            Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                Return _stepIndex > 2
            Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return _stepIndex > 2
            Case Else
                Return True
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function GetReviewLines() As List(Of String)
        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson, RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson, RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson, RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
            Case Else
                Return New List(Of String)
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetAddPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return "Person or Company Name: ?"
            Case 1 : Return "Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] ?"
            Case 2 : Return "City: ?"
            Case 3 : Return "State [ENTER = CA] ?"
            Case 4 : Return "Zip Code: ?"
            Case 5 : Return "Area Code [ENTER = 818] ?"
            Case 6 : Return "Phone Number ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       "Misc: ?"
            Case 8 : Return "IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetModifyPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return $"Person or Company Name: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PersonName}] ?"
            Case 1 : Return $"Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Street}] ?"
            Case 2 : Return $"City: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.City}] ?"
            Case 3 : Return $"State [ENTER = {If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode), "CA", WorkingRecord.StateCode)}] ?"
            Case 4 : Return $"Zip Code [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.ZipCode} ] ?"
            Case 5 : Return $"Area Code [ ENTER = {WorkingRecord.AreaCode} ] ?"
            Case 6 : Return $"Phone Number [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber} ] ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       $"Misc: [A = Append] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Misc}] ?"
            Case 8 : Return "Is this correct (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetDeletePrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Return "Enter 1st Part of Whole Name" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ?"
            Case 1
                Return "Delete this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ?"
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetLookupPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Return "Enter 1st Part of Whole Name" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ?"
            Case 1
                Return "Is this the Person you are looking for (Y/N) ?"
            Case 2
                Return "[D] to Dial Number" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "[Shift] and [PrtSc] to Print"
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitAddInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()

            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                Else
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If

            Case 2
                WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()

            Case 3
                WorkingRecord.StateCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "CA", input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())

            Case 4
                WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()

            Case 5
                WorkingRecord.AreaCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "818", input.Trim())

            Case 6
                WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())

            Case 7
                WorkingRecord.Misc = input.Trim()

            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _stepIndex += 1
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitModifyInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()

            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If

            Case 2
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()

            Case 3
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                ElseIf String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = "CA"
                End If

            Case 4
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()

            Case 5
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.AreaCode = input.Trim()

            Case 6
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())
                End If

            Case 7
                Dim value = input.Trim()
                If value.ToUpperInvariant() = "A" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Misc = WorkingRecord.Misc & " "
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Misc = value
                End If

            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("Is this correct (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _stepIndex += 1
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitDeleteInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Dim search = input.Trim()

                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search) Then
                    search = "TEST"
                End If

                WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }

                Transcript.Add("Enter 1st Part of Whole Name")
                Transcript.Add("Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ? " & input.Trim())
                Transcript.Add("")
                For Each line In WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
                    Transcript.Add(line)
                Next

            Case 1
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("Delete this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ? " & input.Trim())

            Case Else
                Return False
        End Select

        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitLookupInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Dim search = input.Trim()

                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search) Then
                    search = "TEST"
                End If

                WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }

                Transcript.Add("Enter 1st Part of Whole Name")
                Transcript.Add("Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ? " & input.Trim())
                Transcript.Add("")
                For Each line In WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
                    Transcript.Add(line)
                Next

            Case 1
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("Is this the Person you are looking for (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())

            Case 2
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("[D] to Dial Number")
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("[Shift] and [PrtSc] to Print")

            Case Else
                Return False
        End Select

        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function GetPromptSummaryLine(input As String) As String
        Dim prompt = GetCurrentPrompt()

        If prompt.Contains(Environment.NewLine) Then
            Dim parts = prompt.Split({Environment.NewLine}, StringSplitOptions.None)
            prompt = parts(parts.Length - 1)
        End If

        Return $"{prompt} {input}".TrimEnd()
    End Function
End Class
```

## Direct fix
Replace `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb` with this improved version. It:

- creates a clearly visible bottom input area

```vb name=FrmRolodexPrompt.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexPrompt
    Inherits Form

    Private ReadOnly _engine As RolodexPromptEngine

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private txtTranscript As TextBox
    Private pnlInput As Panel
    Private lblInput As Label
    Private txtInput As TextBox

    Public Sub New(engine As RolodexPromptEngine)
        MyBase.New()
        _engine = engine
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Prompt"

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Height = 40,
            .Dock = DockStyle.Top,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
            .Padding = New Padding(10, 0, 0, 0)
        }

        pnlInput = New Panel() With {
            .Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
            .Height = 42,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Padding = New Padding(8, 8, 8, 8)
        }

        lblInput = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Dock = DockStyle.Left,
            .Width = 70,
            .Text = "Input:",
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft
        }

        txtInput = New TextBox() With {
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .TabIndex = 0
        }

        pnlInput.Controls.Add(txtInput)
        pnlInput.Controls.Add(lblInput)

        txtTranscript = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
            .TabStop = False
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(txtTranscript)
        Me.Controls.Add(pnlInput)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Load
        AddHandler Me.Shown, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown
        AddHandler Me.Activated, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Activated
        AddHandler Me.Click, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Click
        AddHandler txtTranscript.Click, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Click
        AddHandler txtInput.KeyDown, AddressOf txtInput_KeyDown
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = _engine.Title
        RefreshTranscript()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        FocusInput()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Activated(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        FocusInput()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        FocusInput()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FocusInput()
        txtInput.Select()
        txtInput.Focus()
        txtInput.SelectionStart = txtInput.TextLength
    End Sub

    Private Sub txtInput_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True

            Dim value = txtInput.Text
            txtInput.Clear()

            _engine.SubmitInput(value)

            If _engine.IsComplete() Then
                ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
                Return
            End If

            RefreshTranscript()
            FocusInput()

        ElseIf e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefreshTranscript()
        Dim lines As New List(Of String)
        lines.AddRange(_engine.Transcript)

        Dim prompt = _engine.GetCurrentPrompt()
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prompt) Then
            lines.Add(prompt)
        End If

        txtTranscript.Text = String.Join(Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine, lines)
        txtTranscript.SelectionStart = txtTranscript.TextLength
        txtTranscript.ScrollToCaret()
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Dim reviewLines = _engine.GetReviewLines()
        Dim reviewText = String.Join(Environment.NewLine, reviewLines)

        Dim result = MessageBox.Show(
            reviewText & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Accept this record?",
            "Rolodex",
            MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
            MessageBoxIcon.Question
        )

        If result = DialogResult.Yes Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
        End If

        Me.Close()
    End Sub
End Class
```

## Correct direction
The input must appear **inline at the prompt location**, immediately after the `?`, not in a separate modern field area.

So we should stop using:
- transcript textbox + bottom textbox

and instead use:
- a **custom-rendered DOS prompt surface**
- plus an **inline caret/input buffer**

## Fastest practical fix for today
The simplest way to get close to DOS behavior quickly is:

1. use a **single multiline textbox** for the whole screen
2. keep it focused
3. intercept keystrokes
4. append typed characters directly into the displayed prompt line
5. on Enter, submit the current inline buffer and redraw

That gives you:
- typing visually right after the question mark

- no detached input box

# Replace `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb` with this version

This version:
- removes the bottom input field
- uses one full-screen monospaced textbox
- lets the user type inline after the prompt
- handles Backspace, Enter, Escape
- keeps the DOS look much better

```vb name=FrmRolodexPrompt.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexPrompt
    Inherits Form

    Private ReadOnly _engine As RolodexPromptEngine

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private txtScreen As TextBox

    Private _currentInput As String = ""

    Public Sub New(engine As RolodexPromptEngine)
        MyBase.New()
        _engine = engine
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Prompt"

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Height = 40,
            .Dock = DockStyle.Top,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
            .Padding = New Padding(10, 0, 0, 0)
        }

        txtScreen = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
            .TabStop = False
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(txtScreen)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Load
        AddHandler Me.Shown, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown
        AddHandler Me.KeyPress, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyPress
        AddHandler Me.KeyDown, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyDown
        AddHandler txtScreen.Click, AddressOf RefocusScreen
        AddHandler Me.Click, AddressOf RefocusScreen
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = _engine.Title
        RefreshScreen()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        RefocusScreen(Nothing, EventArgs.Empty)
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefocusScreen(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Me.Activate()
        txtScreen.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs)
        If Char.IsControl(e.KeyChar) Then Return

        _currentInput &= e.KeyChar
        RefreshScreen()
        e.Handled = True
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Back Then
            If _currentInput.Length > 0 Then
                _currentInput = _currentInput.Substring(0, _currentInput.Length - 1)
                RefreshScreen()
            End If
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True

            Dim submitted = _currentInput
            _currentInput = ""

            _engine.SubmitInput(submitted)

            If _engine.IsComplete() Then
                ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
                Return
            End If

            RefreshScreen()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefreshScreen()
        Dim lines As New List(Of String)
        lines.AddRange(_engine.Transcript)

        Dim prompt = _engine.GetCurrentPrompt()
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prompt) Then
            lines.Add(AppendInlineInput(prompt, _currentInput))
        End If

        txtScreen.Text = String.Join(Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine, lines)
        txtScreen.SelectionStart = txtScreen.TextLength
        txtScreen.ScrollToCaret()
    End Sub

    Private Function AppendInlineInput(prompt As String, input As String) As String
        Dim parts = prompt.Split({Environment.NewLine}, StringSplitOptions.None)

        If parts.Length = 0 Then
            Return input
        End If

        parts(parts.Length - 1) &= " " & input

        Return String.Join(Environment.NewLine, parts)
    End Function

    Private Sub ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Dim reviewLines = _engine.GetReviewLines()
        Dim reviewText = String.Join(Environment.NewLine, reviewLines)

        Dim result = MessageBox.Show(
            reviewText & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Accept this record?",
            "Rolodex",
            MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
            MessageBoxIcon.Question
        )

        If result = DialogResult.Yes Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
        End If

        Me.Close()
    End Sub
End Class
```

---

## Why this is better
Now the typed text appears like:

```text
Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ? TEST
```

instead of in a separate field at the bottom.

That matches the DOS interaction style much better.

## Important limitation
This still uses a read-only textbox as a rendering surface, so it’s not a perfect terminal emulator. But visually and behaviorally it is much closer to DOS and is the right fast move for today.

# Replace `RolodexPromptEngine.vb` with this improved version

This specifically fixes:
- Delete flow branching
- Lookup flow branching
- completion logic after `N`, `Y`, or `Q`
- “stuck on screen” behavior

```vb name=RolodexPromptEngine.vb
Public Class RolodexPromptEngine
    Private ReadOnly _mode As RolodexPromptMode
    Private _stepIndex As Integer = 0
    Private _isComplete As Boolean = False

    Public Property WorkingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord
    Public Property Transcript As New List(Of String)

    Public Sub New(mode As RolodexPromptMode, Optional existingRecord As RolodexPersonRecord = Nothing)
        _mode = mode

        If existingRecord IsNot Nothing Then
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                .PersonName = existingRecord.PersonName,
                .Street = existingRecord.Street,
                .City = existingRecord.City,
                .StateCode = existingRecord.StateCode,
                .ZipCode = existingRecord.ZipCode,
                .AreaCode = existingRecord.AreaCode,
                .PhoneNumber = existingRecord.PhoneNumber,
                .Misc = existingRecord.Misc,
                .IsCustomer = existingRecord.IsCustomer
            }
        Else
            WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord()
        End If
    End Sub

    Public ReadOnly Property Title As String
        Get
            Select Case _mode
                Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                    Return "<<<< ADD A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                    Return "<<<< MODIFY A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                    Return "<<<< DELETE A PERSON >>>>"
                Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                    Return "<<<< LOOK UP A PERSON >>>>"
                Case Else
                    Return "<<<< ROLODEX >>>>"
            End Select
        End Get
    End Property

    Public Function GetCurrentPrompt() As String
        If _isComplete Then Return ""

        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return GetAddPrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return GetModifyPrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                Return GetDeletePrompt()
            Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return GetLookupPrompt()
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function SubmitInput(input As String) As Boolean
        If _isComplete Then Return False

        Select Case _mode
            Case RolodexPromptMode.AddPerson
                Return SubmitAddInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.ModifyPerson
                Return SubmitModifyInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.DeletePerson
                Return SubmitDeleteInput(input)
            Case RolodexPromptMode.LookupPerson
                Return SubmitLookupInput(input)
            Case Else
                Return False
        End Select
    End Function

    Public Function IsComplete() As Boolean
        Return _isComplete
    End Function

    Public Function GetReviewLines() As List(Of String)
        Return WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
    End Function

    Private Function GetAddPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return "Person or Company Name: ?"
            Case 1 : Return "Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] ?"
            Case 2 : Return "City: ?"
            Case 3 : Return "State [ENTER = CA] ?"
            Case 4 : Return "Zip Code: ?"
            Case 5 : Return "Area Code [ENTER = 818] ?"
            Case 6 : Return "Phone Number ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       "Misc: ?"
            Case 8 : Return "IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetModifyPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0 : Return $"Person or Company Name: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PersonName}] ?"
            Case 1 : Return $"Address Number & Street: [N = Nothing] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Street}] ?"
            Case 2 : Return $"City: [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.City}] ?"
            Case 3 : Return $"State [ENTER = {If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode), "CA", WorkingRecord.StateCode)}] ?"
            Case 4 : Return $"Zip Code [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.ZipCode}] ?"
            Case 5 : Return $"Area Code [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.AreaCode}] ?"
            Case 6 : Return $"Phone Number [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber}] ?"
            Case 7
                Return "When entering in a Fax #, put a 1 in front of it if it is not 818." & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Make sure there is a space after the #.      Example:  FAX:1805-222-3333" & Environment.NewLine &
                       Environment.NewLine &
                       $"Misc: [A = Append] [ENTER = {WorkingRecord.Misc}] ?"
            Case 8 : Return "Is this correct (Y/N) ?"
            Case Else : Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetDeletePrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Return "Enter 1st Part of Whole Name" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ?"
            Case 1
                Return "Delete this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ?"
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function GetLookupPrompt() As String
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                Return "Enter 1st Part of Whole Name" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ?"
            Case 1
                Return "Is this the Person you are looking for (Y/N) ?"
            Case 2
                Return "[D] to Dial Number" & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine &
                       "[Shift] and [PrtSc] to Print"
            Case Else
                Return ""
        End Select
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitAddInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()
            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                Else
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If
            Case 2
                WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()
            Case 3
                WorkingRecord.StateCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "CA", input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            Case 4
                WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()
            Case 5
                WorkingRecord.AreaCode = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input), "818", input.Trim())
            Case 6
                WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())
            Case 7
                WorkingRecord.Misc = input.Trim()
            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("IS THIS CORRECT (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _isComplete = True
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitModifyInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.PersonName = input.Trim()
            Case 1
                If input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() = "N" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = ""
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Street = input.Trim()
                End If
            Case 2
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.City = input.Trim()
            Case 3
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                ElseIf String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WorkingRecord.StateCode) Then
                    WorkingRecord.StateCode = "CA"
                End If
            Case 4
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.ZipCode = input.Trim()
            Case 5
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then WorkingRecord.AreaCode = input.Trim()
            Case 6
                If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input) Then
                    WorkingRecord.PhoneNumber = New String(input.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray())
                End If
            Case 7
                Dim value = input.Trim()
                If value.ToUpperInvariant() = "A" Then
                    WorkingRecord.Misc = WorkingRecord.Misc & " "
                ElseIf Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then
                    WorkingRecord.Misc = value
                End If
            Case 8
                Transcript.Add("Is this correct (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())
                _isComplete = True
                Return True
        End Select

        Transcript.Add(GetPromptSummaryLine(input))
        _stepIndex += 1
        Return True
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitDeleteInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }

                Transcript.Add("Enter 1st Part of Whole Name")
                Transcript.Add("Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ? " & input.Trim())
                Transcript.Add("")
                For Each line In WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
                    Transcript.Add(line)
                Next

                _stepIndex = 1
                Return True

            Case 1
                Dim answer = input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()

                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("Delete this Person (Y/N) [Q = Quit] ? " & input.Trim())

                Select Case answer
                    Case "Y"
                        Transcript.Add("")
                        Transcript.Add("Person deleted.")
                        _isComplete = True
                        Return True

                    Case "N", "Q"
                        Transcript.Add("")
                        Transcript.Add("Delete cancelled.")
                        _isComplete = True
                        Return True

                    Case Else
                        Transcript.Add("")
                        Transcript.Add("Please answer Y, N, or Q.")
                        Return True
                End Select
        End Select

        Return False
    End Function

    Private Function SubmitLookupInput(input As String) As Boolean
        Select Case _stepIndex
            Case 0
                WorkingRecord = New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = "TEST",
                    .Street = "100 MAIN ST.",
                    .City = "BURMA",
                    .StateCode = "CA",
                    .ZipCode = "91304",
                    .AreaCode = "661",
                    .PhoneNumber = "4780990",
                    .Misc = "TESTING"
                }

                Transcript.Add("Enter 1st Part of Whole Name")
                Transcript.Add("Person or Company Name [G = Global Search] ? " & input.Trim())
                Transcript.Add("")
                For Each line In WorkingRecord.GetDisplayLines()
                    Transcript.Add(line)
                Next

                _stepIndex = 1
                Return True

            Case 1
                Dim answer = input.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()

                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("Is this the Person you are looking for (Y/N) ? " & input.Trim())

                If answer = "Y" Then
                    _stepIndex = 2
                    Return True
                ElseIf answer = "N" Then
                    Transcript.Add("")
                    Transcript.Add("Lookup cancelled.")
                    _isComplete = True
                    Return True
                Else
                    Transcript.Add("")
                    Transcript.Add("Please answer Y or N.")
                    Return True
                End If

            Case 2
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("[D] to Dial Number")
                Transcript.Add("")
                Transcript.Add("[Shift] and [PrtSc] to Print")
                _isComplete = True
                Return True
        End Select

        Return False
    End Function

    Private Function GetPromptSummaryLine(input As String) As String
        Dim prompt = GetCurrentPrompt()

        If prompt.Contains(Environment.NewLine) Then
            Dim parts = prompt.Split({Environment.NewLine}, StringSplitOptions.None)
            prompt = parts(parts.Length - 1)
        End If

        Return $"{prompt} {input}".TrimEnd()
    End Function
End Class
```

# Replace `FrmRolodexPrompt.vb` with this version

This keeps the inline DOS-style typing and fixes the bad popup behavior.

```vb name=FrmRolodexPrompt.vb
Imports System.Drawing
Imports System.Windows.Forms

Public Class FrmRolodexPrompt
    Inherits Form

    Private ReadOnly _engine As RolodexPromptEngine

    Private lblTitle As Label
    Private txtScreen As TextBox

    Private _currentInput As String = ""

    Public Sub New(engine As RolodexPromptEngine)
        MyBase.New()
        _engine = engine
        InitializeRolodexUi()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InitializeRolodexUi()
        Me.BackColor = Color.Black
        Me.ForeColor = Color.White
        Me.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent
        Me.Size = New Size(900, 650)
        Me.KeyPreview = True
        Me.Text = "Rolodex Prompt"

        lblTitle = New Label() With {
            .AutoSize = False,
            .Height = 40,
            .Dock = DockStyle.Top,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 14.0F, FontStyle.Bold),
            .TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
            .Padding = New Padding(10, 0, 0, 0)
        }

        txtScreen = New TextBox() With {
            .Multiline = True,
            .ReadOnly = True,
            .BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None,
            .BackColor = Color.Black,
            .ForeColor = Color.White,
            .Font = New Font("Consolas", 12.0F, FontStyle.Regular),
            .Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
            .ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
            .TabStop = False
        }

        Me.Controls.Add(txtScreen)
        Me.Controls.Add(lblTitle)

        AddHandler Me.Load, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Load
        AddHandler Me.Shown, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown
        AddHandler Me.KeyPress, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyPress
        AddHandler Me.KeyDown, AddressOf FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyDown
        AddHandler txtScreen.Click, AddressOf RefocusScreen
        AddHandler Me.Click, AddressOf RefocusScreen
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Load(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        lblTitle.Text = _engine.Title
        RefreshScreen()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_Shown(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        RefocusScreen(Nothing, EventArgs.Empty)
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefocusScreen(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        Me.Activate()
        txtScreen.Focus()
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyPress(sender As Object, e As KeyPressEventArgs)
        If Char.IsControl(e.KeyChar) Then Return

        _currentInput &= e.KeyChar
        RefreshScreen()
        e.Handled = True
    End Sub

    Private Sub FrmRolodexPrompt_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs)
        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Back Then
            If _currentInput.Length > 0 Then
                _currentInput = _currentInput.Substring(0, _currentInput.Length - 1)
                RefreshScreen()
            End If
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Enter Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True

            Dim submitted = _currentInput
            _currentInput = ""

            _engine.SubmitInput(submitted)

            If _engine.IsComplete() Then
                HandleCompletedFlow()
                Return
            End If

            RefreshScreen()
            Return
        End If

        If e.KeyCode = Keys.Escape Then
            e.SuppressKeyPress = True
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub RefreshScreen()
        Dim lines As New List(Of String)
        lines.AddRange(_engine.Transcript)

        Dim prompt = _engine.GetCurrentPrompt()
        If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prompt) Then
            lines.Add(AppendInlineInput(prompt, _currentInput))
        End If

        txtScreen.Text = String.Join(Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine, lines)
        txtScreen.SelectionStart = txtScreen.TextLength
        txtScreen.ScrollToCaret()
    End Sub

    Private Function AppendInlineInput(prompt As String, input As String) As String
        Dim parts = prompt.Split({Environment.NewLine}, StringSplitOptions.None)

        If parts.Length = 0 Then
            Return input
        End If

        parts(parts.Length - 1) &= " " & input

        Return String.Join(Environment.NewLine, parts)
    End Function

    Private Sub HandleCompletedFlow()
        RefreshScreen()

        If RequiresAcceptancePrompt() Then
            ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
            Me.Close()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Function RequiresAcceptancePrompt() As Boolean
        Dim title = _engine.Title.ToUpperInvariant()

        If title.Contains("ADD A PERSON") Then Return True
        If title.Contains("MODIFY A PERSON") Then Return True

        Return False
    End Function

    Private Sub ShowReviewAndCloseIfAccepted()
        Dim reviewLines = _engine.GetReviewLines()
        Dim reviewText = String.Join(Environment.NewLine, reviewLines)

        Dim result = MessageBox.Show(
            reviewText & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Accept this record?",
            "Rolodex",
            MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
            MessageBoxIcon.Question
        )

        If result = DialogResult.Yes Then
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
        Else
            Me.DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel
        End If

        Me.Close()
    End Sub
End Class
```

## @testsubject117

to clarify, I think the .bas files that are used in dos will need to be copied over to \\invoice\mainmenu\data won't they?

## Copilot

Probably **some of them, yes — but not necessarily all `.BAS` files, and not necessarily as executable BASIC source**.

## Direct answer
If your WinForms port still depends on the DOS-era `.BAS` files for:
- seed data
- lookup tables
- legacy text/resources
- conversion input
- exact menu/help content

then yes, those files — or converted equivalents — need to be available under something like:

```text
\\invoice\mainmenu\data
```

or, in your Windows app, whatever the equivalent runtime data folder is.

But if a `.BAS` file is only:
- GW-BASIC program source
- old DOS control flow you are now rewriting in VB.NET

then you do **not** need to copy it just to “run” the WinForms app. `.BAS` is a GW-BASIC program format, not something a VB.NET WinForms app executes directly. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/Chapter%205.html?utm_source=openai))

## Best way to think about it
Split the DOS `.BAS` files into two categories:

### 1. `.BAS` files that are really **application logic**
Examples:
- main menu logic
- add/modify/delete workflows
- print routines
- DOS UI flow

These should be:
- **ported into VB.NET code**
- not copied over as runtime dependencies

### 2. `.BAS` files that are really **data containers or lookup assets**
Examples:
- embedded lists
- state/zip/area lookup content
- maybe seeded records or constants if the DOS app loaded them from disk

These likely need to be:
- copied into the WinForms app’s data folder, or
- extracted/converted into cleaner formats like `.txt`, `.csv`, `.json`, or app-managed data files

---

## For your specific case
Based on what you’ve described, the important question is:

### Is Rolodex data currently stored in DOS-era files that your new app is supposed to read?
If yes, then those source data files need to be present in your app’s data location, or migrated into a new storage format.

For example:
- person records
- phone book entries
- customer flags
- zip/area code datasets

## What I would *not* do blindly
I would **not** just dump every `.BAS` file into `\\invoice\mainmenu\data` and assume that solves it.

Why:
- many `.BAS` files are probably program code, not data
- some may be binary/protected GW-BASIC format
- WinForms won’t natively interpret them as executable logic anyway ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41167778/how-do-i-view-the-source-code-of-a-gw-basic-bas-file/41168561?utm_source=openai))

---

## Better rule
For each DOS `.BAS` file, ask:

- Is this **code** we are porting?
  - then rewrite in VB.NET
- Is this **data** the program reads at runtime?
  - then copy/convert it into the app data folder

---

## For today’s Rolodex issue
Your current delete/search problem is **not yet about copying `.BAS` files**.  
It’s because the WinForms code is still using a hardcoded placeholder record instead of a real repository.

So even if the DOS files belong in `\\invoice\mainmenu\data`, you still need code that:
- loads them
- parses them
- searches them
- saves updates back appropriately

---

## My recommendation
Yes, we should determine which legacy files belong in your Windows data folder. But first, we should identify:

1. **Which file in DOS actually stores Rolodex records**
2. **Which files store area/zip lookup data**
3. **Which `.BAS` files are only program source**

Once we know that, we can decide:
- copy as-is
- convert
- or reimplement in code

If you want, paste:

- screenshots / names of the `.BAS` files and data files in that folder

Then I can help you classify them into:
- **must copy**

- **can ignore**

## @testsubject117

in particular I was referring to the rolodex functionality. isn't there a .bas file that has the database?

## Copilot

Yes — **possibly**, but not by default in the way modern apps use a “database.”

In GW-BASIC-era apps, a `.BAS` file was usually:
- **program code**
- sometimes with **DATA statements embedded inside**
- occasionally with hardcoded records or seed tables

So a `.BAS` file *can* contain what looks like a database, but more often it contains:
- the code to read/write some separate data file, or
- lookup data embedded directly in source

## For Rolodex specifically
There are three likely possibilities:

### 1. The `.BAS` file is just the Rolodex program
Meaning:
- menus
- add/delete/modify logic
- file I/O code

And the actual records are stored in a separate file:
- `.DAT`
- `.TXT`
- `.DB`
- no extension / custom flat file

### 2. The `.BAS` file contains embedded starter data
Meaning:
- `DATA` statements
- arrays initialized in code
- lookup/reference lists

This is more common for:
- area codes
- zip/state tables
- constants
than for a live editable Rolodex database

### 3. The `.BAS` file itself is acting like a pseudo-database
Possible, but less ideal for an editable user Rolodex. That would mean:
- records are literally stored inside code lines or DATA blocks
- the program may rewrite/export them somehow

That’s possible, but I would not assume it without checking.

---

## Important distinction
If the users have been:
- adding people
- modifying people
- deleting people

for years in DOS, then the live Rolodex data is **very likely not meant to live only inside static source code**. It is more likely stored in a separate runtime data file that the BASIC program reads and writes.

## So the answer is:
**There may be a `.BAS` file that contains the Rolodex logic, but the actual editable database is more likely a separate data file.**

---

## What you need to find
Search the DOS folder for files related to:
- `PHONE`
- `ROLODEX`
- `PHONE.BAS`
- `PHONE.DAT`
- `PHONE.*`
- `ROLODEX.*`
- customer/name files
- random extensionless files with recent timestamps

Also inspect the BASIC source for lines like:
- `OPEN`
- `FIELD`
- `GET`
- `PUT`
- `INPUT #`
- `WRITE #`
- `LINE INPUT #`
- file names in quotes

Those will usually tell you what file actually stores the records.

---

## For example
If the BASIC file contains something like:

```basic
OPEN "PHONE.DAT" FOR RANDOM AS #1
```

or

```basic
OPEN "PHONE" FOR INPUT AS #1
```

then **that** is the real data store.

If it contains lots of:

```basic
DATA JOHN DOE,123 MAIN,...
```

then maybe the data is embedded.

---

## Best practical answer
So: **yes, there may be a `.BAS` involved, but I would not assume the `.BAS` itself is the live Rolodex database until we inspect the file references.**

If you can give me:
- the name of the Rolodex `.BAS` file, or
- the relevant section of that BASIC source, or

## @testsubject117

so how did the gw basic app store the rolodex?

## Copilot

Usually, a GW-BASIC Rolodex would store data in **disk files**, not inside the `.BAS` program itself. GW-BASIC supported two main styles: **sequential files** (written/read in order with `PRINT#`/`WRITE#` and `INPUT#`/`LINE INPUT#`) and **random-access files** (fixed-length records using `OPEN ... FOR RANDOM`, `FIELD`, `GET`, and `PUT`). ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/Chapter%205.html?utm_source=openai))

For something like a Rolodex that needs **add / find / modify / delete** by record, the classic pattern was often a **random-access file**: the BASIC program defined a fixed record layout with `FIELD`, loaded one record with `GET`, changed fields in a buffer, then saved it back with `PUT`. GW-BASIC’s docs explicitly describe random files as suitable for keyed record storage and show that records are addressed by record number rather than rereading the whole file. ([www-user.tu-chemnitz.de](https://www-user.tu-chemnitz.de/~heha/hs/chm/gwbasic.chm/Chapter5.html?utm_source=openai))

A simpler app could also use a **sequential text file**, where each contact is written one after another and the program scans from the top to find a match. But sequential files are less convenient for in-place edits, because updating one record often means rereading and rewriting much or all of the file. GW-BASIC documentation contrasts this with random-access storage, noting sequential data is stored “one item after another” and random-access files are better when you need record-oriented updates. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/Chapter%205.html?utm_source=openai))

So the likely answer is: **the GW-BASIC app probably stored Rolodex entries in a separate data file on disk, most likely a random-access flat file if it supported editing efficiently, or a sequential flat file if it was simpler.** The `.BAS` file usually contained the **logic** to read and write that file, not the live database itself. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/Chapter%205.html?utm_source=openai))

The fastest way to know for sure in your app is to inspect the Rolodex BASIC source and look for file statements such as:
- `OPEN "..." FOR RANDOM`
- `FIELD`
- `GET` / `PUT`
- or `OPEN "..." FOR INPUT/OUTPUT`, `WRITE#`, `INPUT#`, `LINE INPUT#`  
Those lines will tell you the exact filename and storage style the DOS app used. ([www-user.tu-chemnitz.de](https://www-user.tu-chemnitz.de/~heha/hs/chm/gwbasic.chm/Chapter5.html?utm_source=openai))

If you want, paste the Rolodex `.BAS` file or the lines with `OPEN`/`GET`/`PUT`, and I’ll tell you exactly what file is the real Rolodex database and how to port it.

## Copilot

Yes — `PHONE.BAS` is clearly the **Rolodex program**, and it also shows **exactly how the data was stored**.

## Bottom line
The Rolodex data was **not stored inside `PHONE.BAS` itself**.  
It was stored in a set of **per-letter sequential files** in the `PHONE` directory:

- `A.LST`
- `B.LST`
- ...
- `Z.LST`
- and also numeric starters:
- `0.LST` through `9.LST`

The program chooses the file by the **first character of the name** using `LEFT$(N$,1)+".LST"`. For Add, it appends a record to that file; for search/delete/modify, it opens the same per-letter file and scans each record with `INPUT#`. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/INPUTF.html?utm_source=openai))

## Exact evidence from your code
### Add writes to `<first-letter>.LST`
In line 850 and again at 990:

- `Q$=LEFT$(N$,1)+".LST"`
- `OPEN Q$ FOR INPUT AS 1`
- later:
- `OPEN Q$ FOR APPEND LOCK READ WRITE AS 1:WRITE#1,N$,A$,C$,S$,Z,A,P,M$:CLOSE 1`

That means a name like `PLUTO` is stored in:
- `P.LST`

and a name like `TEST` is stored in:
- `T.LST`

Because it uses `WRITE#`, each record is a sequential line of 8 fields:
1. name
2. address
3. city
4. state
5. zip
6. area code
7. phone number
8. misc

GW-BASIC `WRITE#` writes comma-delimited records and quotes strings so they can be read back reliably with `INPUT#`; your code uses exactly that pair. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/WRITEF.html?utm_source=openai))

### Delete / Lookup / Modify read the same `<first-letter>.LST`
At lines 1100 and 1130:

- `Q$=LEFT$(N2$,1)+".LST":OPEN Q$ FOR INPUT AS 1`
- `INPUT#1,N$,A$,C$,S$,Z,A,P,M$`

So when the user searches `PLUTO`, DOS opens:
- `P.LST`

and scans records from that file. It does **not** search a single monolithic Rolodex database file. It uses **one file per starting letter/number**. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/INPUTF.html?utm_source=openai))

### Delete / Modify rebuild the letter file using a temp file
At lines 1110, 1240–1270, and 1340:

- opens `<letter>.TMP` for output
- copies surviving records there
- then if changes were made:
  - `KILL LEFT$(N$,1)+".LST"`
  - `NAME LEFT$(N2$,1)+".TMP " AS LEFT$(N2$,1)+".LST"`

That confirms `.LST` files are the live database files, and `.TMP` files are temporary rebuild files during delete/modify. ([hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl](https://hwiegman.home.xs4all.nl/gw-man/INPUTF.html?utm_source=openai))

## So do you need to copy files to `\\invoice\mainmenu\data`?
**Yes — if you want the WinForms app to use the existing DOS Rolodex data, you need to copy the Rolodex `.LST` data files** into the Windows app’s data location, or otherwise migrate them there.

### Must-copy for Rolodex functionality
At minimum, copy the live Rolodex data files:
- `0.LST`–`9.LST` if they exist
- `A.LST`–`Z.LST`

These are the actual Rolodex database shards.

### Probably also copy if the corresponding features are used
- `REALNAME.DAT`  
  The print routines use this when printing “customers only.” See lines 2010–2030 and 2335–2340 where it opens `REALNAME.DAT` from the parent directory. If you want Print Phone Book / Print Labels customer-only behavior to work, this file matters.
- Area/zip helper executables/data:
  - Area code lookup uses `SHELL "areacode "+Q$` at line 2530, so it depends on an external `areacode` program/data being available.
  - Zip lookup uses `SHELL "ZIPKEY 2"` at line 423, so that depends on external `ZIPKEY` assets being present.

## What you do **not** need to copy just to use the Rolodex database
- `PHONE.BAS` itself is program logic, not the live record store.
- `.TMP` files are transient working files, not the source of truth.

## Why your WinForms test returned `TEST` instead of `PLUTO`
Because your current port is still using a hardcoded placeholder record. It is **not yet reading `P.LST` / `T.LST`** like DOS does.

## Practical recommendation
For the WinForms port, the next step should be:

1. Copy the legacy Rolodex data files into your Windows data folder:
   - `\\invoice\mainmenu\data\phone\A.LST` … `Z.LST` and any numeric `.LST` files
2. Implement a repository that:
   - determines target file from `Left(name, 1)`
   - reads records from the matching `.LST`
   - parses 8 fields per record
   - appends on add
   - rewrites file on delete/modify
3. Optionally also bring over:
   - `REALNAME.DAT`
   - area code / zip lookup assets if you want those features to match DOS

## One subtle but important detail
DOS stores only records from the corresponding first-letter file, so searching `PLUTO` should only look in `P.LST`, not scan all files, except for the special “Global Search” branch (`G`) which does a broader search via temp files and shell commands.

# 1) Add this new file: `RolodexRepository.vb`

```vb name=RolodexRepository.vb
Imports System
Imports System.Collections.Generic
Imports System.Globalization
Imports System.IO
Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO

Public Class RolodexRepository

    Private Shared ReadOnly BaseFolder As String = "\\invoice\mainmenu\data\phone"

    Public Function FindFirstByNamePrefix(search As String) As RolodexPersonRecord
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search) Then Return Nothing

        Dim normalized = search.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
        Dim filePath = GetFilePathForKey(normalized(0))

        If Not File.Exists(filePath) Then Return Nothing

        For Each record In ReadAllRecordsFromFile(filePath)
            If record IsNot Nothing AndAlso
               Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(record.PersonName) AndAlso
               record.PersonName.ToUpperInvariant().StartsWith(normalized, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                Return record
            End If
        Next

        Return Nothing
    End Function

    Public Function AddRecord(record As RolodexPersonRecord) As Boolean
        If record Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(record.PersonName) Then Return False

        EnsureBaseFolder()

        Dim filePath = GetFilePathForKey(record.PersonName.Trim()(0))
        Dim line = SerializeRecord(record)

        Using sw As New StreamWriter(filePath, True)
            sw.WriteLine(line)
        End Using

        Return True
    End Function

    Public Function DeleteFirstByNamePrefix(search As String) As Boolean
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search) Then Return False

        Dim normalized = search.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
        Dim filePath = GetFilePathForKey(normalized(0))

        If Not File.Exists(filePath) Then Return False

        Dim records = ReadAllRecordsFromFile(filePath)
        Dim removed As Boolean = False

        For i As Integer = 0 To records.Count - 1
            Dim r = records(i)
            If r IsNot Nothing AndAlso
               Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.PersonName) AndAlso
               r.PersonName.ToUpperInvariant().StartsWith(normalized, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                records.RemoveAt(i)
                removed = True
                Exit For
            End If
        Next

        If removed Then
            WriteAllRecordsToFile(filePath, records)
        End If

        Return removed
    End Function

    Public Function UpdateFirstByNamePrefix(search As String, updatedRecord As RolodexPersonRecord) As Boolean
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search) Then Return False
        If updatedRecord Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(updatedRecord.PersonName) Then Return False

        Dim normalized = search.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
        Dim sourcePath = GetFilePathForKey(normalized(0))

        If Not File.Exists(sourcePath) Then Return False

        Dim records = ReadAllRecordsFromFile(sourcePath)
        Dim matchIndex As Integer = -1

        For i As Integer = 0 To records.Count - 1
            Dim r = records(i)
            If r IsNot Nothing AndAlso
               Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.PersonName) AndAlso
               r.PersonName.ToUpperInvariant().StartsWith(normalized, StringComparison.Ordinal) Then
                matchIndex = i
                Exit For
            End If
        Next

        If matchIndex = -1 Then Return False

        Dim existing = records(matchIndex)
        records.RemoveAt(matchIndex)
        WriteAllRecordsToFile(sourcePath, records)

        Dim targetPath = GetFilePathForKey(updatedRecord.PersonName.Trim()(0))
        Dim targetRecords = ReadAllRecordsFromFile(targetPath)
        targetRecords.Add(updatedRecord)
        WriteAllRecordsToFile(targetPath, targetRecords)

        Return True
    End Function

    Public Function ReadAllRecordsForLetter(ch As Char) As List(Of RolodexPersonRecord)
        Dim filePath = GetFilePathForKey(ch)
        Return ReadAllRecordsFromFile(filePath)
    End Function

    Private Shared Sub EnsureBaseFolder()
        If Not Directory.Exists(BaseFolder) Then
            Directory.CreateDirectory(BaseFolder)
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function GetFilePathForKey(ch As Char) As String
        EnsureBaseFolder()

        Dim key As Char = Char.ToUpperInvariant(ch)

        If Not Char.IsLetterOrDigit(key) Then
            key = "0"c
        End If

        Return Path.Combine(BaseFolder, key & ".LST")
    End Function

    Private Function ReadAllRecordsFromFile(filePath As String) As List(Of RolodexPersonRecord)
        Dim results As New List(Of RolodexPersonRecord)

        If Not File.Exists(filePath) Then
            Return results
        End If

        For Each line In File.ReadAllLines(filePath)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) Then Continue For

            Dim record = ParseLine(line)
            If record IsNot Nothing Then
                results.Add(record)
            End If
        Next

        Return results
    End Function

    Private Sub WriteAllRecordsToFile(filePath As String, records As List(Of RolodexPersonRecord))
        EnsureBaseFolder()

        Using sw As New StreamWriter(filePath, False)
            For Each record In records
                sw.WriteLine(SerializeRecord(record))
            Next
        End Using
    End Sub

    Private Function ParseLine(line As String) As RolodexPersonRecord
        Try
            Using parser As New TextFieldParser(New StringReader(line))
                parser.SetDelimiters(",")
                parser.HasFieldsEnclosedInQuotes = True

                Dim fields = parser.ReadFields()
                If fields Is Nothing OrElse fields.Length < 8 Then Return Nothing

                Dim zipValue As Integer = 0
                Dim areaValue As Integer = 0
                Dim phoneValue As Long = 0

                Integer.TryParse(fields(4).Trim(), zipValue)
                Integer.TryParse(fields(5).Trim(), areaValue)
                Long.TryParse(fields(6).Trim(), phoneValue)

                Return New RolodexPersonRecord With {
                    .PersonName = fields(0).Trim(),
                    .Street = fields(1).Trim(),
                    .City = fields(2).Trim(),
                    .StateCode = fields(3).Trim(),
                    .ZipCode = If(zipValue = 0, "", zipValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    .AreaCode = If(areaValue = 0, "", areaValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    .PhoneNumber = If(phoneValue = 0, "", phoneValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)),
                    .Misc = fields(7).Trim()
                }
            End Using
        Catch
            Return Nothing
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Function SerializeRecord(record As RolodexPersonRecord) As String
        Dim name = Quote(record.PersonName)
        Dim street = Quote(record.Street)
        Dim city = Quote(record.City)
        Dim stateCode = Quote(record.StateCode)

        Dim zipValue As Integer = 0
        Dim areaValue As Integer = 0
        Dim phoneValue As Long = 0

        Integer.TryParse(OnlyDigits(record.ZipCode), zipValue)
        Integer.TryParse(OnlyDigits(record.AreaCode), areaValue)
        Long.TryParse(OnlyDigits(record.PhoneNumber), phoneValue)

        Dim misc = Quote(record.Misc)

        Return String.Join(",",
                           name,
                           street,
                           city,
                           stateCode,
                           zipValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                           areaValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                           phoneValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                           misc)
    End Function

    Private Function Quote(value As String) As String
        If value Is Nothing Then value = ""
        Return """" & value.Replace("""", """""") & """"
    End Function

    Private Function OnlyDigits(value As String) As String
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) Then Return ""

        Dim chars = value.Where(Function(c) Char.IsDigit(c)).ToArray()
        Return New String(chars)
    End Function

End Class
```
